channel.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · Global Health & Longevity Daily Briefing
channel.description: 每日汇总功能医学、长寿医学、精准营养、营养补剂与健康管理五大领域资讯，中英双语对照，每条附原始出处链接。

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-11-25
item.description: 2026-11-25 简报，共 20 条：南医大团队揭示迷走神经刺激抗癫痫的肠-脑轴机制；绍兴大学团队从万份肠道宏基因组锁定 159 种「共排斥菌」；Nature Communications：驱动 IBD 菌群失调的是炎症本身，而非疾病标签；3.6 年追踪单个患者：大肠杆菌「帝国」崩塌与摩根菌崛起；伦敦国王学院：RNA 剪接错误随年龄累积，遗传度升至 55%；澳门大学等筛选出天然 Senolytic：千金藤素选择性清除衰老细胞；「主动健康与衰老医学」六项团体标准发布，专家共识同步启动；湖南首家 VMC 标准化血管衰老管理中心落地长沙；北京八部门出台 12 项举措，支持特医食品研发与临床规范使用；AI 竞赛升温：个性化营养与临床试验正被重写；湖南人均日摄盐 13 克、烹调油超 40 克，专项行动定下 2027 目标；Gut：儿童期多吃水果与鱼，成年后克罗恩病风险分别降 34% 与 35%；福建全链条整治涉老保健食品：立案 125 起，罚没 67 万元；补剂品牌涌向医生主导诊所，92% 医务人员会推荐维生素；美妆与运动品牌集体跨界，补剂竞争从实验室转向日常场景；10 月维生素出口同比增 3.48%，VA、VE 价格低位持稳；大通县 308 支家庭医生团队覆盖 40.35 万人，签约率 91.43%；随州曾都「三双手」管慢病：从村卫生室到省级手术台不到一天；北京西长安街社区：3.6 万居民分级分类随访，65 岁以上签约率超 90%；聊城茌平入选国家级老年人失能失智预防干预试点
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 南医大团队揭示迷走神经刺激抗癫痫的肠-脑轴机制
    Chinese team uncovers the gut-brain mechanism behind vagus nerve stimulation in epilepsy
    珠江医院郭燕舞、孙海涛团队在 Cell Host & Microbe 发表研究，纵向采集患者术前及术后 6、12 个月粪便与血浆：术后产短链脂肪酸菌群富集，粪便丁酸下降、血浆丁酸升高，降幅与发作缓解正相关。机制为结肠 MCT1 转运丁酸、结状神经节 GPR41 经迷走神经上行激活孤束核，敲低 GPR41 或离断迷走神经均减弱保护效应。
    A team at Zhujiang Hospital tracked stool and plasma samples from epilepsy patients before and at 6 and 12 months after vagus nerve stimulation (VNS), publishing in Cell Host & Microbe. After VNS, short-chain fatty acid producers including Akkermansia were enriched, fecal butyrate fell while plasma butyrate rose, and the size of the fecal drop correlated with seizure relief. Mechanistically, colonic transporter MCT1 moves butyrate to the nodose ganglion, where receptor GPR41 signals up the vagus to the nucleus tractus solitarius; knocking down GPR41 or cutting the vagus abolished the protection.
  • 绍兴大学团队从万份肠道宏基因组锁定 159 种「共排斥菌」
    Population-scale gut metagenomics identifies 159 commensals that exclude resistant pathogens
    绍兴大学钱海丰团队在 Cell Host & Microbe 分析 12,238 份人类肠道宏基因组，筛出 159 种与耐药相关致病类群稳定负相关的共生菌，中位检出率 45.9%，多属毛螺菌科与瘤胃球菌科。对普氏栖粪杆菌 2,053 个基因组做深度学习挖掘，得 6,737 条候选抗菌肽；小鼠补充 15 天后耐药基因总丰度显著下降，菌群网络更稳健。
    Qian Haifeng's group at Shaoxing University analysed 12,238 human gut metagenomes and reported in Cell Host & Microbe 159 commensal species consistently negatively associated with antibiotic-resistance gene (ARG)-carrying pathogens. Median detection rate was 45.9 percent, with enrichment in Lachnospiraceae and Ruminococcaceae. Deep-learning mining of 2,053 Faecalibacterium prausnitzii genomes yielded 6,737 candidate antimicrobial peptides; in antibiotic-disturbed mice, 15 days of supplementation lowered total ARG abundance and improved network stability.
  • Nature Communications：驱动 IBD 菌群失调的是炎症本身，而非疾病标签
    In IBD, inflammation itself — not the disease label — drives dysbiosis
    研究用宏基因组中残留人类 DNA 的比例构建客观「炎症指数」，与粪便钙卫蛋白高度相关。炎症越重，菌群与健康人差异越大，该规律在健康对照中同样成立；匹配炎症水平后，IBD 患者与健康人的菌群差异显著缩小。菌株层面还发现，丰度上与 IBD 强相关的物种内部菌株分化反而不明显，患者肠道菌株的持久性显著降低。
    Researchers built an objective inflammation index from the share of human DNA left in metagenomic data, which correlated closely with fecal calprotectin. The more inflamed the gut, the larger the divergence from healthy microbiota — a pattern that also held in healthy controls; after matching inflammation levels, differences between IBD patients and controls shrank markedly. At strain level, species strongly linked to IBD showed less internal strain differentiation, and bacterial persistence in patients was significantly lower.
  • 3.6 年追踪单个患者：大肠杆菌「帝国」崩塌与摩根菌崛起
    A 3.6-year single-patient tracking captures the collapse of an E. coli empire
    高威大学 Ines Thiele 团队在 Gut Microbes 对一名结肠克罗恩病患者追踪 3.6 年、51 个时间点，构建个体化宿主-菌群代谢模型。其大肠杆菌丰度一度达健康均值 1670 倍，后在无药物干预下一个月内骤降近 80 倍，摩氏摩根菌升近 8 倍，更替紧随粪便乳铁蛋白与溶菌酶高峰；史氏甲烷短杆菌一度扩增 147 倍并与转氨酶联动。
    Ines Thiele's group at the University of Galway followed one patient with colonic Crohn's disease across 51 time points over 3.6 years, building a personalised host-microbiome metabolic model published in Gut Microbes. E. coli abundance reached 1,670 times the healthy average, then fell nearly 80-fold within a month without drug intervention as Morganella morganii rose about eight-fold; the switch followed peaks in fecal lactoferrin and lysozyme. Methanobrevibacter smithii expanded 147-fold and tracked liver enzymes.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 伦敦国王学院：RNA 剪接错误随年龄累积，遗传度升至 55%
    RNA splicing errors accumulate with age, with heritability rising to 55 percent
    TwinsUK 团队在 Nature Communications 分析 318 名女性双胞胎、939 份血样（32–80 岁，随访 6–8 年）：随时间推移内含子保留显著增加，发生变化的剪接事件中 87.6% 为增加。该特征遗传度由首访 44% 升至末访 55%，并与 SRSF4、ELAVL1、AGO1 表达下降、糖尿病状态及肾损伤标志物相关，GTEx 多组织数据方向一致。
    The TwinsUK team analysed 939 blood samples from 318 female twins aged 32 to 80, sampled at three or more time points over six to eight years, publishing in Nature Communications. Intron retention rose significantly over time, with 87.6 percent of changing events increasing. Heritability of the trait climbed from 44 percent at the first visit to 55 percent at the last, and higher retention was associated with lower SRSF4, ELAVL1 and AGO1 expression, diabetes status and kidney-disease markers; GTEx tissue data pointed the same way.
  • 澳门大学等筛选出天然 Senolytic：千金藤素选择性清除衰老细胞
    Cepharanthine identified as a natural senolytic that selectively clears senescent cells
    研究以衰老细胞表型筛选发现千金藤素（CEP）可选择性诱导衰老细胞凋亡：机制为并行调控 PI3K/AKT 与 PERK-ATF4-CHOP 两条通路，差异激活 PUMA/NOXA 并触发线粒体依赖的内源性凋亡。在斑马鱼、线虫、自然衰老鼠与早衰症小鼠中，CEP 均降低 SASP 水平、清除衰老细胞、改善器官功能并延长寿命，对健康细胞毒性较低。
    A phenotypic screen reported in Phytomedicine identified cepharanthine (CEP) as a compound that selectively drives senescent cells into apoptosis. It acts by regulating the PI3K/AKT and PERK-ATF4-CHOP pathways in parallel, differentially inducing PUMA and NOXA and triggering mitochondrial intrinsic apoptosis. In zebrafish, C. elegans, naturally aged mice and a Hutchinson-Gilford progeria mouse model, CEP reduced SASP levels, cleared senescent cells, improved organ function and extended lifespan, with low toxicity to healthy cells.
  • 「主动健康与衰老医学」六项团体标准发布，专家共识同步启动
    Six group standards issued for proactive health and ageing medicine in China
    六项团体标准均由北京老年医院牵头起草，系统性明确主动健康与衰老医学相关技术与服务的规范要求、质量底线和评价依据。同期启动《主动健康与衰老医学体系建设及技术应用专家共识》编制，由吉训明、程京、刘德培等院士指导、五十余位专家参与；沈阳药科大学抗衰老研究院与该院共建的临床医学中心签约揭牌。
    All six group standards were drafted under the lead of Beijing Geriatric Hospital, setting out technical requirements, quality baselines and evaluation criteria for proactive health and ageing-medicine services. Work also began on an expert consensus on building and applying such systems, guided by academicians including Ji Xunming, Cheng Jing and Liu Depei with more than 50 specialists. A clinical medicine centre jointly built by Shenyang Pharmaceutical University's anti-ageing institute and the hospital was inaugurated.
  • 湖南首家 VMC 标准化血管衰老管理中心落地长沙
    Hunan's first standardised vascular ageing centre opens in Changsha
    VMC 标准化血管衰老管理中心长沙区域分中心在长沙市第三医院启动，接入国家级标准化平台，聚焦血管衰老相关慢病的早筛、早防、早治，构建评估—干预—随访一体化路径并向基层下沉。同济医院张存泰指出血管衰老是脑卒中、冠心病、高血压的共同源头；该院特聘其任长沙市老年医学中心名誉主任，并开设血管衰老专病队列课程。
    A Changsha regional branch of the standardised Vascular Management Centre (VMC) launched at Changsha Third Hospital, plugging into a national platform for early screening, prevention and treatment of vascular-ageing-related chronic disease, with an assessment-intervention-follow-up pathway extending to grassroots clinics. Zhang Cuntai of Tongji Hospital described vascular ageing as a shared root of stroke, coronary disease and hypertension; the hospital appointed him honorary director of its geriatric centre and hosted a course on vascular-ageing cohorts.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 北京八部门出台 12 项举措，支持特医食品研发与临床规范使用
    Beijing issues 12 measures to back foods for special medical purposes
    《促进特殊医学用途配方食品创新发展若干措施》由北京市市场监管局等 8 部门联合印发，重点支持蛋白质定向水解、精准营养组方等关键技术，优先扶持临床急需、罕见病、婴幼儿类产品。文件支持食品、保健食品、药品企业跨界布局，并开展规范化使用试点，把特医食品纳入医院信息系统，实现遴选、采购、贮存、调配、评估全流程管理。
    Eight Beijing departments jointly issued measures to boost foods for special medical purposes (FSMP), targeting key technologies such as targeted protein hydrolysis and precision-nutrition formulations, with priority for clinically urgent, rare-disease and infant products. The policy encourages food, supplement and drug makers to enter the category and pilots standardised clinical use, bringing FSMP into hospital information systems so selection, procurement, storage, dispensing and evaluation are managed end to end.
  • AI 竞赛升温：个性化营养与临床试验正被重写
    The AI race intensifies: personalised nutrition and clinical trials are being rewritten
    伦敦 Nutra Healthspan 峰会上，Thorne、Radicle Science 与 Applied Laboratory Technologies 讨论 AI 落地：Thorne 的聊天机器人 Taia 基于精选语料而非开放网络构建，每条输出均受监控；Radicle 用智能体 AI 规划去中心化试验。与会者直言多数「个性化营养」只是人群分簇，AI 的局限在于被喂入的信息，复杂病例仍须专业人士介入。
    At the Nutra Healthspan Summit in London, executives from Thorne, Radicle Science and Applied Laboratory Technologies discussed how AI is actually being used. Thorne's chatbot Taia was built on curated sources rather than the open web and every message it sends is monitored; Radicle uses agentic AI to plan decentralised trials. Panellists conceded that most so-called personalised nutrition merely clusters people, that any AI is limited by what it is told, and that complex cases still need professionals.
  • 湖南人均日摄盐 13 克、烹调油超 40 克，专项行动定下 2027 目标
    Hunan eats 13 g of salt and over 40 g of cooking oil a day; action plan sets 2027 target
    湖南省疾控中心膳食监测显示，居民人均每日食盐约 13 克、烹调用油超 40 克，分别为推荐上限的两倍以上与明显超标。按《中国居民膳食指南（2022）》，成人每日盐不超 5 克、油 25–30 克，2–3 岁幼儿盐不超 2 克、4–6 岁不超 3 克。专项行动提出到 2027 年底盐油摄入在 2024 年基础上再降 10%，营养健康知识知晓率达 32%。
    Dietary monitoring by the Hunan CDC puts average daily salt intake at about 13 grams and cooking oil above 40 grams — more than double the salt ceiling and clearly over the oil range. The Chinese Dietary Guidelines (2022) cap adults at 5 g salt and 25-30 g oil a day, with children aged 2-3 limited to 2 g salt and those aged 4-6 to 3 g. A provincial action plan aims to cut both intakes another 10 percent from 2024 levels by end-2027 and lift nutrition literacy to 32 percent.
  • Gut：儿童期多吃水果与鱼，成年后克罗恩病风险分别降 34% 与 35%
    Fruit and fish in childhood linked to 34 and 35 percent lower Crohn's risk
    瑞典哥德堡大学等整合挪威、丹麦、瑞典三大出生队列近 11.2 万人，追踪 7–8 岁与 11–15 岁的食物摄入与成年早期 IBD 风险。儿童期高水果、高鱼类摄入分别使克罗恩病风险降 34% 与 35%，但高水果同时与溃疡性结肠炎风险升 54% 相关；青春期高水果仍降克罗恩病 43%，咸味零食则使总体 IBD 风险升 32%。
    Researchers from the University of Gothenburg and partners pooled three national birth cohorts in Norway, Denmark and Sweden covering nearly 112,000 people, linking food intake at ages 7-8 and 11-15 to IBD diagnosed in early adulthood. High fruit and high fish intake in childhood were associated with 34 and 35 percent lower Crohn's disease risk, though high fruit also tracked a 54 percent higher ulcerative colitis risk; in adolescence fruit still cut Crohn's risk 43 percent, while salty snacks raised overall IBD risk 32 percent.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 福建全链条整治涉老保健食品：立案 125 起，罚没 67 万元
    Fujian crackdown on supplements marketed to seniors files 125 cases
    福建省市场监管局联合工信、民政部门建立覆盖许可、生产、流通、网络销售的穿透式监管体系，累计出动 11057 人次，检查生产企业 21 户次、线下场所 5242 户次、网络主体 1448 户次，排查直播间与账号 304 个，专项抽检 386 批次。整治期间立案 125 起（网络涉老 41 起），罚没 67 万元，下架违规产品 23 款，1 起涉刑案件移送公安。
    Fujian's market regulator, working with industry and civil-affairs departments, built an end-to-end oversight system covering licensing, manufacturing, distribution and online sales. Inspectors made 11,057 site visits, checked 21 production sites, 5,242 physical outlets and 1,448 online sellers, reviewed 304 livestream rooms and accounts, and ran 386 targeted tests. The campaign filed 125 cases, 41 of them online and aimed at seniors, with 670,000 yuan in fines, 23 products delisted and one criminal case referred to police.
  • 补剂品牌涌向医生主导诊所，92% 医务人员会推荐维生素
    Supplement brands move into physician-led clinics as 92 percent of clinicians recommend vitamins
    Tonum Health 与医生主导的 Euvita Health 达成合作，把补充剂与功能营养产品嵌入由生物标志物分析、激素与肽类治疗、睡眠优化、运动指导组成的个性化方案，重点回应 GLP-1 减重人群的蛋白补充与保肌需求，其蛋白棒每份含 24 克蛋白。Sermo 调查显示 92% 医务人员会推荐维生素或补充剂，90% 称患者常来咨询，54% 反映相关提问明显增多。
    Tonum Health has partnered with Euvita Health, a physician-led platform combining biomarker analysis, hormone and peptide therapy, nutrition, sleep optimisation and fitness coaching, to embed its supplements and functional nutrition products in personalised programmes. The focus is protein and muscle preservation for people on GLP-1 drugs, including bars delivering 24 grams of protein per serving. A Sermo survey found 92 percent of clinicians recommend vitamins or supplements, 90 percent say patients often ask, and 54 percent report a marked rise in such questions.
  • 美妆与运动品牌集体跨界，补剂竞争从实验室转向日常场景
    Beauty and sportswear brands pile into supplements as competition shifts to daily life
    联合利华以约 12 亿美元收购软糖补剂品牌 Grüns，叠加 Olly、Liquid I.V.、SmartyPants 形成内服矩阵；宝洁收购消化健康品牌 Wonderbelly，资生堂、华熙生物、欧莱雅相继推口服美容，李宁入股运动营养品牌迈胜。2026 年上半年京东营养保健 GMV 约 151 亿元、同比增 10.2%，活跃品牌约 6150 个而 CR5 仅 24.2%，增长点正从叠加功能转向全生命周期管理。
    Unilever is buying gummy supplement brand Gruns for about US$1.2 billion, adding to Olly, Liquid I.V. and SmartyPants; P&G picked up digestive-health brand Wonderbelly, while Shiseido, Bloomage and L'Oreal pushed oral beauty lines and Li-Ning took a stake in sports-nutrition brand Maisheng. JD's nutrition and health GMV reached about 15.1 billion yuan in the first half of 2026, up 10.2 percent year on year, with roughly 6,150 active brands and a CR5 of just 24.2 percent — pushing growth logic from stacking functions toward lifecycle management.
  • 10 月维生素出口同比增 3.48%，VA、VE 价格低位持稳
    China vitamin exports up 3.48 percent in October as VA and VE prices hold at lows
    海关数据显示 2026 年 10 月中国维生素出口量同比增 3.48%、环比增 3.91%，1—10 月累计同比增 9.35%。维生素 A 主流价 52–56 元/公斤，10 月出口约 460 吨、同比减 19.61%；维生素 E 主流价 40–45 元/公斤，10 月出口约 8248 吨、同比减 19.13%。烟酰胺厂家挺价、部分停签停报，氯化胆碱报价小幅下调，下游以刚需采购为主，整体购销清淡。
    Customs data show China's vitamin export volume rose 3.48 percent year on year in October and 3.91 percent month on month, taking the January-October total 9.35 percent higher. Vitamin A held at 52-56 yuan per kilogram, with October exports of about 460 tonnes, down 19.61 percent year on year; vitamin E stood at 40-45 yuan per kilogram with exports near 8,248 tonnes, down 19.13 percent. Niacinamide suppliers held prices and some stopped quoting, choline chloride edged lower, and buying stayed largely hand-to-mouth.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 大通县 308 支家庭医生团队覆盖 40.35 万人，签约率 91.43%
    Datong county's 308 family-doctor teams cover 403,500 residents, 91.43 percent signed
    西宁市大通县深化紧密型县域医共体，落实「八统一」管理，建成 5 个县域医疗资源共享中心、新建 7 所标准化村卫生室，组建 308 支家庭医生签约团队，全人群签约率 91.43%、重点人群 94.59%。基层诊疗占比达 55%，2140 名在管大病患者救治率 100%，5071 名慢病患者签约履约全覆盖，累计摸排健康预警信息 8360 条。
    Datong county in Xining is deepening its tightly integrated county medical community under an eight-point unified management model, building five shared resource centres and seven new standardised village clinics, and forming 308 family-doctor teams. Signing rates reached 91.43 percent of all residents and 94.59 percent of priority groups. Primary-care visits now account for 55 percent of the total, all 2,140 managed patients with serious illness were treated, 5,071 chronic-disease patients were fully covered, and 8,360 health-warning alerts were screened.
  • 随州曾都「三双手」管慢病：从村卫生室到省级手术台不到一天
    Suizhou's three-hands model moves a patient from village clinic to surgery in a day
    曾都区以村医随访、区级影像与转诊、省级专家驻院「三双手」衔接：一名血压 226/138 的在管高血压患者从卫生室就诊到确诊蛛网膜下腔出血、转送手术全程不足一天。区内推行紧密型医共体人事、财务、业务「七统一」，专科医师编入家庭医生团队每周下沉坐诊，基层服务经历与职称晋升挂钩，并把风险标签用于差异化随访。
    Zengdu district links three sets of hands — village-doctor follow-up, county-level imaging and referral, and provincial specialists stationed on site. A managed hypertension patient presenting at 226/138 mmHg went from clinic visit to a confirmed subarachnoid haemorrhage and surgery in under a day. The district runs its integrated medical community under seven unified functions in staffing, finance and operations, assigns specialists to family-doctor teams for weekly sessions, ties grassroots service to promotion, and uses risk labels to tailor follow-up.
  • 北京西长安街社区：3.6 万居民分级分类随访，65 岁以上签约率超 90%
    Beijing community centre runs risk-tiered follow-up for 36,000 residents
    西长安街社区卫生服务中心服务 4.24 平方公里、约 3.6 万常住人口，65 岁以上老人家庭医生签约率超 90%。针对长处方与精细化管理矛盾、人户分离与候鸟式居住难题，中心按病情风险分级分类随访，把随访嵌入复诊、取药、体检环节，工作日接诊至晚八点并开周末门诊，还设脂肪肝专病门诊与三家医院绿色转诊通道。
    The Xichang'an Avenue community health centre covers 4.24 square kilometres and about 36,000 residents, with more than 90 percent of people over 65 signed up to a family doctor. To reconcile long prescriptions with close management, and to cope with residents who split time between homes, the centre tiers follow-up by risk, folds visits into repeat prescriptions, dispensing and check-ups, stays open until 8pm on weekdays with weekend clinics, and runs a fatty liver clinic plus green-channel referrals to three hospitals.
  • 聊城茌平入选国家级老年人失能失智预防干预试点
    Chiping district picked for national pilot on preventing disability and dementia
    茌平区成为 2026 年该项目全国新增的两个试点地区之一，聚焦 65–80 岁失能失智高危人群，依托社区与基层卫生网点把筛查、干预、照护指导串成一条线，让技术标准落到村、落到户。当地 60 岁以上人口占比超四分之一，已具备老年友善医疗与医养结合基础；启动会后专家还观摩了医防融合慢病智能一体化管理系统。
    Chiping district in Liaocheng is one of two new national pilot areas for 2026 on preventing disability and dementia, targeting high-risk people aged 65 to 80 and linking screening, intervention and caregiving guidance through communities and primary-care sites so standards reach villages and households. More than a quarter of local residents are over 60, and the district already has senior-friendly medical services and integrated care. Experts also reviewed an AI-enabled system merging prevention with chronic disease management.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-11-24
item.description: 2026-11-24 简报，共 20 条：冷激益生菌囊泡直攻肝脏：脂肪变性面积缩小逾75%，胆汁酸轴被重编程；骨桥蛋白联手双歧杆菌：修复婴儿肠道屏障的「里应外合」策略；脊柱骨密度低，脑白质老化更快：2086人影像分析给出「共享代谢驱动」线索；「三医整合」管慢病：把功能医学的溯源评估接进中医与常规用药之间；长寿生物医学张江论坛：抗衰目标是延长健康寿命，不是无限拉长生存年限；晚年才开始补丁酸盐仍延寿约10%：斯坦福小鼠实验显示心脏衰老被缓解；血检比肩腰穿：《自然·衰老》头对头研究验证血浆 p-tau217 识别脑内淀粉样蛋白；百岁老人共同点不是补品：每天快走7000步、心态平稳、有人可聊；算法个性化饮食没赢过常规建议：151人试验中糖化血红蛋白无差异；食养从「经验」走向「循证」：AI 四诊仪3~5分钟出体质报告，配体质餐与体质茶；长期高剂量味精损伤中性粒细胞抗菌力，且可经父系传给子代；健康活力年龄模型纳入24项可干预因素：把生活方式改善折算成健康寿命收益；22种「三新食品」获批：L-麦角硫因限量20毫克/日，母乳源CP-9进入婴幼儿菌种名单；61人6个月：多成分抗衰粉剂与血管功能改善相关，收缩压多降6.1毫米汞柱；睡眠补剂整体下滑，L-茶氨酸逆势增长：销售额2.47亿美元、在售单品却减少6%；锯棕榈的证据缺口：STEP与CAMUS均未胜过安慰剂，声称开始取决于「哪种提取物」；212支家医团队加三级康复阵地：荣成把卒中后遗症管到村口，累计省下4亿多元；700支团队、41.8万「三高」患者：鄂尔多斯把防治康管串成一条链；一家医院22支网格团队：秦都把家医签约做成「有人管、管到位」；290支团队覆盖到村：万源用「三方积分」破解签而不约，慢病规范管理率达87.23%
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 冷激益生菌囊泡直攻肝脏：脂肪变性面积缩小逾75%，胆汁酸轴被重编程
    Cold-shocked probiotic vesicles target the liver: steatosis area cut by over 75% as the bile-acid axis is reprogrammed
    贵州医科大学黄磊、刘林团队用冷休克制备罗伊氏乳杆菌胞外囊泡，口服后主要富集于肝脏。高脂饮食小鼠干预后肝内大脂肪空泡大幅减少，脂肪变性面积缩小超过75%，疾病活动度评分显著下降。机制上经PPARα抑制Cyp7a1、上调Cyp7b1使胆汁酸池回稳，肠绒毛高度恢复32%，ZO-1与闭合蛋白-1回升，TLR4/NF-κB炎症通路受抑。
    A team at Guizhou Medical University used cold shock to prepare extracellular vesicles from Lactobacillus rhamnosus; after oral dosing the vesicles concentrated in the liver. In high-fat-fed mice, large hepatic fat vacuoles shrank sharply, steatosis area fell by more than 75% and disease activity scores dropped. Via PPARα the treatment suppressed Cyp7a1 and raised Cyp7b1, stabilising the bile-acid pool; villus height recovered 32%, ZO-1 and occludin-1 rebounded and TLR4/NF-κB signalling was dampened.
  • 骨桥蛋白联手双歧杆菌：修复婴儿肠道屏障的「里应外合」策略
    Osteopontin joins bifidobacteria: an inside-out strategy to repair the infant gut barrier
    内蒙古农业大学孙志宏、高广琦团队发现，乳源骨桥蛋白与双歧杆菌联合使用可协同修复婴儿肠道屏障：骨桥蛋白先加固黏液层与紧密连接，双歧杆菌随后定植并提升短链脂肪酸水平，两者序贯配合使屏障完整性明显恢复。研究为婴幼儿肠屏障功能障碍的靶向合生制剂提供了机制依据与转化思路。
    Researchers at Inner Mongolia Agricultural University found that milk-derived osteopontin plus bifidobacteria synergistically repair the infant gut barrier: osteopontin first reinforces the mucus layer and tight junctions, then bifidobacteria colonise and raise short-chain fatty acid levels, together restoring barrier integrity. The work offers a mechanistic basis and translational route for targeted synbiotics against infant gut barrier dysfunction.
  • 脊柱骨密度低，脑白质老化更快：2086人影像分析给出「共享代谢驱动」线索
    Lower spinal bone density, faster white-matter ageing: imaging of 2,086 people points to shared metabolic drivers
    约翰斯·霍普金斯团队在《Radiology》发表MESA队列分析，用深度学习从2086人的平扫胸部CT估算胸椎骨密度，其中715人有脑MRI与认知数据、约408人有随访影像。基线骨密度较低者整体认知下降更快，胼胝体白质高信号累积更多，内囊前肢各向异性下降更明显。作者强调并非因果，可能源于胰岛素抵抗、血脂异常与绝经等共同代谢驱动。
    A Johns Hopkins team publishing in Radiology analysed the MESA cohort, using deep learning on non-contrast chest CT to estimate thoracic vertebral bone density in 2,086 people; 715 also had brain MRI and cognitive testing, and about 408 had follow-up imaging. Lower baseline density tracked with faster cognitive decline, more white-matter hyperintensity in the corpus callosum and a steeper drop in fractional anisotropy in the anterior limb of the internal capsule. The authors stress this is not causal and may reflect shared metabolic drivers such as insulin resistance, dyslipidaemia and menopause.
  • 「三医整合」管慢病：把功能医学的溯源评估接进中医与常规用药之间
    Managing chronic disease with three medicines: inserting functional medicine's root-cause assessment between TCM and guideline drugs
    大医本正第三届中医论坛上，主诊医师赵莺歌提出慢病管理要从「压指标」转向「追病根」。其模式以现代医学守住心梗、脑梗、肾衰等高风险，功能医学负责肠道菌群、食物不耐受等溯源评估与生活方式指导，中医以本草内服、外治、养生功法、药膳、情绪疏导补位。一例高血压十余年、已做支架与搭桥的患者，血压由150~200mmHg降至100~130mmHg。
    At a TCM forum, physician Zhao Yingge argued chronic-disease care must move from suppressing markers to tracing root causes. In the model, modern medicine guards against heart attack, stroke and renal failure, functional medicine supplies root-cause assessment of gut microbiota and food intolerance plus lifestyle guidance, and TCM adds herbal formulas, external therapies, exercise routines, medicated diets and emotional support. One patient with a decade of hypertension, stents and a bypass saw blood pressure fall from 150-200 mmHg to 100-130 mmHg.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 长寿生物医学张江论坛：抗衰目标是延长健康寿命，不是无限拉长生存年限
    Zhangjiang longevity forum: the goal is healthspan, not endlessly stretching lifespan
    论坛在上海科技大学举办，设现代衰老生物学、循证健康长寿管理、中医治未病三大方向。清华大学王钊指出衰老是生殖期后自然选择力量减弱的过程，提醒不要过度神化抗衰药物，遗传只是部分因素、生活方式与环境仍可调控；曙光医院张晓天以九种体质分型反对「千人一方」，提出青年减耗、中年调护、老年防变防残的分段思路。
    Held at ShanghaiTech University, the forum covered modern ageing biology, evidence-based longevity management and TCM preventive practice. Wang Zhao of Tsinghua described ageing as natural selection weakening after the reproductive period and warned against over-mythologising anti-ageing drugs, since genetics is only one factor and lifestyle and environment remain modifiable. Zhang Xiaotian of Shuguang Hospital rejected one-size-fits-all supplementation, proposing nine TCM body types and stage-specific strategies: reduce wear in youth, actively maintain in midlife, prevent disability in old age.
  • 晚年才开始补丁酸盐仍延寿约10%：斯坦福小鼠实验显示心脏衰老被缓解
    Starting butyrate in late life still extends lifespan about 10%: Stanford mice show slower cardiac ageing
    斯坦福团队预印本显示，从18月龄（相当于人类晚年）起在小鼠饮水中加丁酸钠，雌雄中位生存期均延长约10%，体脂与空腹血糖下降，自发活动、抓握力与转棒表现改善。血浆柠檬酸、α-酮戊二酸、琥珀酸降低，菌源吲哚-3-丙酸升高；左心室质量下降、心肌胶原沉积减少，线粒体超微结构与呼吸功能改善。
    In a preprint, Stanford researchers added sodium butyrate to drinking water from 18 months of age, roughly late life in humans. Median survival rose about 10% in both sexes, body fat and fasting glucose fell, and spontaneous activity, grip strength and rotarod performance improved. Plasma citrate, alpha-ketoglutarate and succinate dropped while microbial indole-3-propionate rose; left ventricular mass and myocardial collagen deposition fell, with better mitochondrial ultrastructure and respiration.
  • 血检比肩腰穿：《自然·衰老》头对头研究验证血浆 p-tau217 识别脑内淀粉样蛋白
    A blood test rivalling lumbar puncture: head-to-head Nature Aging study validates plasma p-tau217 for brain amyloid
    研究对比获监管许可的全自动血浆检测与脑脊液检测。在基层医疗队列、单阈值判读下，单测p-tau217准确率85%、p-tau217与Aβ42比值87%、脑脊液检测92%；校正多重比较后，单测显著低于脑脊液，而比值与之差异未达统计学显著。作者认为血浆标志物可减少不必要的腰穿与PET，加速抗淀粉样蛋白疗法的精准可及。
    The study compared fully automated, regulatory-cleared plasma assays with cerebrospinal fluid testing. In the primary-care cohort using a single threshold, accuracy was 85% for p-tau217 alone, 87% for the p-tau217/Aβ42 ratio and 92% for CSF; after multiple-comparison correction, p-tau217 alone was significantly below CSF while the ratio was not statistically different. The authors argue plasma markers can cut unnecessary lumbar punctures and PET scans and speed access to anti-amyloid therapy.
  • 百岁老人共同点不是补品：每天快走7000步、心态平稳、有人可聊
    What centenarians share is not supplements: 7,000 steps a day, a steady mood and people to talk to
    华东医院保志军以在院25位百岁老人（最高108岁）的观察为切入点提出四个习惯：每天连续快走6000~7000步并搭配抗阻训练；保持好心态与价值感；维持日常社交，独居者尤其要防认知下降；用拇指食指环小腿中段自测肌肉量。文章同时指出人类理论寿命约120岁，约40%的衰老特性由遗传决定，其余受疾病与环境影响。
    Drawing on 25 centenarians in his hospital, the oldest 108, Bao Zhijun of Huadong Hospital listed four habits: a continuous brisk walk of 6,000-7,000 steps daily plus resistance training; a steady mood and a sense of purpose; regular social contact, especially for those living alone; and a thumb-and-index finger ring around the mid-calf to self-check muscle mass. The article notes a theoretical human lifespan near 120 years, with about 40% of ageing traits set by genetics and the rest shaped by disease and environment.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 算法个性化饮食没赢过常规建议：151人试验中糖化血红蛋白无差异
    Algorithm-guided personalised diet fails to beat standard advice: no HbA1c difference in a 151-person trial
    悉尼单中心随机试验纳入151名糖尿病前期或早期2型糖尿病成人，全部起始二甲双胍缓释1.5克/日，随机接受机器学习算法饮食（综合临床、生活方式、血糖监测与菌群预测餐后血糖）或常规低脂高纤维指导。6个月糖化血红蛋白分别降0.26与0.29个百分点，组间差异不显著；体重、内脏脂肪均改善但彼此无优势，短期血糖波动降幅略大但不足以构成临床获益。
    A single-centre Sydney trial randomised 151 adults with prediabetes or early type 2 diabetes, all starting metformin XR 1.5 g daily, to machine-learning-guided diet advice (combining clinical, lifestyle, glucose-monitoring and microbiome data to predict postprandial glucose) or standard low-fat, high-fibre counselling. At six months HbA1c fell 0.26 versus 0.29 percentage points, a non-significant difference; weight and visceral fat improved in both without advantage, and slightly larger short-term glucose variability reductions were judged not clinically meaningful.
  • 食养从「经验」走向「循证」：AI 四诊仪3~5分钟出体质报告，配体质餐与体质茶
    Food-based wellness moves from experience to evidence: an AI four-diagnosis device issues a body-type report in 3-5 minutes
    东方食养文化节在北京前门启动，为期90天。现场以计算机视觉采集面诊与舌诊、声纹识别与智能传感完成问诊脉诊，依托超百万份真实临床案例训练的中医大模型，3~5分钟生成个人体质报告并同步给出调理饮食建议。中国医学科学院肿瘤医院吴健雄从外科视角提出，长期坚持「规范医疗＋个性化食养」的康复人群生存质量评分提升更明显。
    A 90-day Eastern food-therapy festival opened at Beijing's Qianmen. On site, computer vision captures facial and tongue diagnosis while voiceprint recognition and smart sensors handle inquiry and pulse reading; a TCM large model trained on over a million real clinical cases then produces a personal body-type report with dietary recommendations in three to five minutes. Wu Jianxiong of the Cancer Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, said patients combining standard care with personalised food therapy showed clearer gains in quality-of-life scores.
  • 长期高剂量味精损伤中性粒细胞抗菌力，且可经父系传给子代
    Long-term high-dose MSG impairs neutrophil killing and can pass down the paternal line
    广西中医药大学团队在《Food & Function》发表大鼠研究：雄性大鼠连续90天经饮水摄入高剂量味精（1.36克/只/日）后与未接触味精的雌鼠交配，两代循环中性粒细胞数量均显著减少，而脾脏、胸腺免疫器官指数无变化，提示源于外周代谢环境而非器官损伤。两代均持续高血糖并伴胰岛β细胞损伤，谷氨酸-葡萄糖轴被重塑。作者强调不代表常规膳食剂量有害。
    Published in Food & Function, the rat study gave males high-dose monosodium glutamate in drinking water for 90 days (1.36 g per animal daily) before mating them with unexposed females. Circulating neutrophils fell significantly in both generations while spleen and thymus indices were unchanged, pointing to the peripheral metabolic milieu rather than organ damage. Both generations stayed hyperglycaemic with islet beta-cell injury as the glutamate-glucose axis was remodelled. The authors stress this does not imply harm at normal dietary doses.
  • 健康活力年龄模型纳入24项可干预因素：把生活方式改善折算成健康寿命收益
    A health-vitality age model with 24 modifiable factors converts lifestyle gains into healthspan returns
    2026特殊食品大会「健康老龄化——从科学研究到创新应用」会议在南宁举行。中国疾控中心刘江美团队介绍健康活力年龄模型，纳入行为膳食、代谢、环境等24项可干预危险因素，面向全年龄段成人评估，把复杂风险转化为直观年龄，量化生活方式改善带来的健康寿命收益。北大王军波指出皮肤健康需蛋白质、脂类、维生素、矿物质共同支撑，口服营养干预应立足平衡膳食。
    At the 2026 Special Food Conference session on healthy ageing in Nanning, Liu Jiangmei's team from China CDC presented a health-vitality age model covering 24 modifiable risk factors across behaviour, diet, metabolism and environment, assessed in adults of all ages, turning complex risk into an intuitive age and quantifying healthspan gains from lifestyle change. Wang Junbo of Peking University noted skin health depends on protein, lipids, vitamins and minerals together, so oral nutrition support should rest on a balanced diet.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 22种「三新食品」获批：L-麦角硫因限量20毫克/日，母乳源CP-9进入婴幼儿菌种名单
    22 new food substances approved: L-ergothioneine capped at 20 mg/day, breast-milk-derived CP-9 joins infant strain list
    国家卫健委第7号公告批准4种新食品原料、14种食品添加剂新品种与4种食品相关产品。L-麦角硫因（纯度≥99.0克/100克）推荐食用量≤20毫克/日，婴幼儿、孕妇与哺乳期人群不宜食用；发酵法L-茶氨酸≤250毫克/日；母乳源动物双歧杆菌乳亚种CP-9列入《可用于婴幼儿食品的菌种名单》，我国自研婴幼儿菌株增至5株。
    National Health Commission Announcement No. 7 approved four new food raw materials, 14 new food additives and four food-contact substances. L-ergothioneine at 99.0 g/100 g purity or above carries a recommended intake of no more than 20 mg/day and is not advised for infants, pregnant or breastfeeding women; fermented L-theanine is capped at 250 mg/day; breast-milk-derived Bifidobacterium animalis subsp. lactis CP-9 entered the list of strains usable in infant food, lifting China's self-developed infant strains to five.
  • 61人6个月：多成分抗衰粉剂与血管功能改善相关，收缩压多降6.1毫米汞柱
    61 people, six months: a multi-ingredient anti-ageing powder linked to better vascular function and 6.1 mmHg lower systolic pressure
    萨里大学领衔的随机对照研究纳入61名40岁以上表面健康成人，服用含镁、氨基葡萄糖、姜提取物与维生素C的多成分粉剂或安慰剂6个月。干预组内皮功能改善、动脉僵硬度下降，收缩压比对照组多降6.1毫米汞柱，部分改善在服用1小时后即可观察到；两组低密度脂蛋白降幅无差异。研究未追踪实际心血管事件，作者称仍需更大规模试验。
    A randomised trial led by the University of Surrey gave 61 apparently healthy adults over 40 a multi-ingredient powder containing magnesium, glucosamine, ginger extract and vitamin C, or placebo, for six months. The active group showed improved endothelial function, lower arterial stiffness and systolic pressure 6.1 mmHg lower than controls, with some changes visible one hour after intake; LDL reductions did not differ. No clinical cardiovascular events were tracked and the authors call for larger trials.
  • 睡眠补剂整体下滑，L-茶氨酸逆势增长：销售额2.47亿美元、在售单品却减少6%
    Sleep supplements slip overall while L-theanine climbs: $247 million in sales but 6% fewer products on shelf
    Spate与NIQ数据显示，L-茶氨酸线上热度同比升148.8%，睡眠类含该成分产品销售额2.47亿美元（增9%）、销量1730万件（增10%），而在售单品数反降6%至199个；同期睡眠补剂大盘销售额下降1.2%。镁在睡眠场景销售额增79%至7420万美元、单品数增36%；褪黑素仍是最大品类，销售额12亿美元但下滑1%，单品数减6%。
    Spate and NIQ data show L-theanine's online popularity up 148.8% year on year, with sleep products containing it generating $247 million in sales (up 9%) and 17.3 million units (up 10%), even as the number of products selling fell 6% to 199; the wider sleep-aid category slipped 1.2% in dollars. Magnesium sleep aids jumped 79% to $74.2 million with 36% more products. Melatonin remains largest at $1.2 billion, down 1%, with 6% fewer products.
  • 锯棕榈的证据缺口：STEP与CAMUS均未胜过安慰剂，声称开始取决于「哪种提取物」
    Saw palmetto's evidence gap: STEP and CAMUS both failed placebo, so claims now hinge on which extract
    CPG Radar分析显示锯棕榈需求评分95/100，但半年下滑4%，约四分之三持异议者顾虑的是副作用。早期荟萃分析多基于小样本短周期，后续STEP（2006）、CAMUS（2011，用到三倍标准剂量）与2023年Cochrane综述均未见优于安慰剂。全球前列腺补剂市场预计由16.5亿美元增至2033年32.3亿美元；南瓜籽12个月1400余人研究中全籽有效、提取物无效。
    CPG Radar analysis puts saw palmetto demand at 95 out of 100 but down 4% in six months, with roughly three in four objectors citing side effects. Early meta-analyses rested on small, short trials; the larger STEP (2006) and CAMUS (2011, at triple the standard dose) studies and a 2023 Cochrane review found no benefit over placebo. The global prostate supplement market is projected to grow from $1.65 billion to $3.23 billion by 2033; in a 12-month study of over 1,400 men, whole pumpkin seed beat placebo while the extract did not.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 212支家医团队加三级康复阵地：荣成把卒中后遗症管到村口，累计省下4亿多元
    212 family-doctor teams and three tiers of rehab: Rongcheng manages stroke sequelae down to the village, saving over 400 million yuan
    荣成市以县域慢病综合防控为抓手，组建212支家庭医生团队，农村建档居民签约率89%，个性化签约覆盖6.6万名在管高血压患者，每季度面对面随访并代送药、代办报销。同步建市级康复中心、基层康复治疗室与中心村康复指导站，已为4105名卒中患者减轻照护负担，按单例约10万元估算累计省医疗开支4亿多元、节约医保基金2.6亿元。
    Rongcheng built 212 family-doctor teams under its county chronic-disease programme; 89% of registered rural residents are signed up, with personalised contracts covering 66,000 managed hypertension patients through quarterly in-person follow-up, medicine delivery and insurance paperwork. A three-tier rehabilitation network links a municipal centre, primary-care therapy rooms and village guidance stations, easing care burdens for 4,105 stroke patients and saving an estimated 400 million yuan in medical costs and 260 million yuan in insurance funds.
  • 700支团队、41.8万「三高」患者：鄂尔多斯把防治康管串成一条链
    700 teams and 418,000 patients with three highs: Ordos links prevention, treatment, rehab and management into one chain
    鄂尔多斯依托紧密型县域医共体建成慢病管理中心8个、分中心112个，规范管理「三高」患者41.8万余名；组建700支家庭医生团队，常住人口签约率83.2%、重点人群超91%，为符合条件者开具4至12周长期处方。65岁以上老人实行三色分级管理，二级以上医院全部设健康体重管理门诊、服务12570人次；慢病过早死亡率由2023年的12.95%降至2025年的8.57%。
    Using tight county medical alliances, Ordos has built eight chronic-disease centres and 112 sub-centres, managing 418,000-plus patients with hypertension, diabetes and dyslipidaemia. Seven hundred family-doctor teams cover 83.2% of residents and over 91% of priority groups, issuing 4-12 week prescriptions where eligible. Residents over 65 get three-colour risk stratification, all secondary and higher hospitals run weight-management clinics serving 12,570 visits, and premature chronic-disease mortality fell from 12.95% in 2023 to 8.57% in 2025.
  • 一家医院22支网格团队：秦都把家医签约做成「有人管、管到位」
    One hospital, 22 grid teams: Qindu turns family-doctor contracts into care that actually reaches people
    咸阳市秦都区推行固定集中签约、流动巡回签约、入户上门签约三种模式，市第一人民医院秦都医院组建「市一院专家＋中心家庭医生＋社区网格员」的22支网格化团队，覆盖14个社区居委会，服务涵盖14项国家基本公共卫生服务。除高血压、糖尿病筛查随访，还把床旁检验、留置胃管、导尿等居家护理纳入清单，并打通上级医院绿色通道。
    Qindu District in Xianyang runs three contracting models: fixed sites, mobile rounds and home visits. Its First People's Hospital branch formed 22 grid teams combining municipal specialists, community family doctors and neighbourhood grid workers, covering 14 residents' committees across the 14 national essential public-health services. Beyond hypertension and diabetes screening and follow-up, the menu includes bedside testing, nasogastric tubes and catheterisation at home, plus green-channel referrals to higher-level hospitals.
  • 290支团队覆盖到村：万源用「三方积分」破解签而不约，慢病规范管理率达87.23%
    290 teams reach every village: Wanyuan uses mutual scoring to fix contracts signed but never honoured, with 87.23% managed hypertension and diabetes
    四川万源依托紧密型县域医共体整合基层医务力量，组建290支家庭医生签约团队，实现乡镇街道与村社区全覆盖。古东关街道社区卫生服务中心的11支团队实行分片包保、网格化管理，创新「三方积分、互相激励、闭环运行」机制——居民、家庭医生、网格员互评互促。对行动不便等重点对象每年上门不少于4次、体检1次，全市慢病规范管理率达87.23%。
    Wanyuan in Sichuan consolidated primary-care staff through a tight county medical alliance, forming 290 family-doctor teams covering every township and village. The 11 teams at Gudongguan community health centre work by zone and grid under a three-way scoring mechanism in which residents, doctors and grid workers rate one another in a closed loop. Housebound priority patients get at least four home visits and one health check yearly, and standardised chronic-disease management has reached 87.23% citywide.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-11-23
item.description: 2026-11-23 简报，共 20 条：停药数年仍留“菌群指纹”：2500余人研究揭示常用药物长期重塑肠道；西北浆水里挖出“抗癌帮手”：GR-4益生菌与PD-1联用增效减毒；乙酸盐当“指挥官”：经FFAR2指令中性粒细胞分泌IL-22减轻结肠炎；丁酸梭菌载双药：先护脑再护肠，同步缓解肠炎与焦虑抑郁；阿尔茨海默“清理系统”被找到缺口：CASS4基因失灵让斑块失控扩散；一片降压药激活棕色脂肪：氯沙坦另辟代谢通路，10万人影像牵连情绪；45页综述拆解抗衰老药三派：清除、平抑、逆转各有各的坑；MIND饮食吃得越像，表观遗传时钟走得越慢：1740人队列证据；同样是20克蛋白，只有瘦猪肉碎让“双亮氨酸”飙起来；中国一年16.9万例癌症死亡与“吃”有关：红肉多、奶少、全谷物少排前三；抗炎饮食不靠“超级食物”：营养科主任给出四条原则；Nature：家用菌群检测火了，但“标准健康菌群”根本不存在；“闪电入睡”的网红褪黑素：剂量超标两三倍，进口身份也是假的；保健食品家底摊开：注册1.4万个、备案2.7万个，前三功能占了一半；直播、私域、AI营销怎么管：多方共议食品保健食品宣传合规；双十一保健品销售额同比增8%：年轻客群渗透加深，监管趋严利好头部；糖尿病指南2026版：首提MLCK综合征，糖化≥7.5%可直接起始联合；老年友好社区长什么样：1400平方米嵌入式养老中心＋慢病智能监测；山区县怎么把家医签“实”：63支团队＋红黄绿三色管控入选全国18案例；换医院不用重做检查：一座县级市上传660万份检验结果后的账本
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 停药数年仍留“菌群指纹”：2500余人研究揭示常用药物长期重塑肠道
    Microbial fingerprints persist years after stopping common drugs, 2,500-person study finds
    爱沙尼亚塔尔图大学团队分析生物样本库2500余人的粪便与处方记录，发现抗抑郁药、β受体阻滞剂、质子泵抑制剂与苯二氮䓬类均与菌群改变相关，相当一部分在停药数年后仍可检出“微生物指纹”。同属苯二氮䓬的地西泮与阿普唑仑扰动强度并不相同，该类药物的影响量级可与广谱抗生素相比。研究者提醒，解读菌群数据必须纳入既往用药史。
    Researchers at the University of Tartu analysed stool samples and prescription histories from more than 2,500 Estonian Biobank participants. Antidepressants, beta-blockers, proton pump inhibitors and benzodiazepines were all linked to microbiome changes, and many left detectable microbial fingerprints years after patients stopped taking them. Diazepam and alprazolam, both benzodiazepines, differed in how strongly they disrupted bacteria, and the class as a whole rivaled broad-spectrum antibiotics. The team urges clinicians to factor past prescriptions into microbiome interpretation.
  • 西北浆水里挖出“抗癌帮手”：GR-4益生菌与PD-1联用增效减毒
    Probiotic from northwest China's fermented 'jiangshui' boosts PD-1 therapy in gastric cancer models
    兰州大学生命科学学院李祥锴团队联合兰大二院，从西北传统发酵食品“浆水”中分离出植物乳杆菌GR-4，在荷瘤小鼠中观察到：单用GR-4抑瘤有限，单用PD-1抑制剂虽抑瘤却明显掉体重，两者联用对肿瘤控制最佳且显著缓解消耗。成果发表于Frontiers in Immunology，首次证实该菌与PD-1的协同价值，但团队强调仍处基础研究阶段。
    A team led by Li Xiangkai at Lanzhou University, working with the university's second hospital, isolated Lactobacillus plantarum GR-4 from jiangshui, a traditional fermented food from northwest China. In tumour-bearing mice, GR-4 alone suppressed tumours only modestly, and PD-1 blockade alone shrank tumours but caused marked weight loss; the combination produced the best tumour control while easing wasting. Published in Frontiers in Immunology, the work is the first to show synergy between this strain and PD-1 inhibitors, though the team stresses it remains preclinical.
  • 乙酸盐当“指挥官”：经FFAR2指令中性粒细胞分泌IL-22减轻结肠炎
    Acetate directs neutrophils via FFAR2 to release IL-22 and dampen colitis
    坎皮纳斯州立大学与圣路易斯华盛顿大学团队在PNAS报告：膳食纤维发酵产生的乙酸，经中性粒细胞表面FFAR2受体指令其生产修复性细胞因子IL-22，从而缓解小鼠DSS结肠炎。反直觉的是，乙酸干预后结肠中性粒细胞数量不降反升；一旦清除中性粒细胞，乙酸的护肠作用完全消失。流式分析显示约20%的IL-22阳性细胞竟是中性粒细胞，且在ILC3缺陷小鼠中保护依旧。
    Teams at UNICAMP and Washington University in St. Louis reported in PNAS that acetate, produced when gut bacteria ferment dietary fibre, instructs neutrophils through the FFAR2 receptor to make the repair cytokine IL-22, easing DSS colitis in mice. Counter-intuitively, neutrophil numbers in the colon rose after acetate treatment; depleting neutrophils abolished all protection. Flow analysis showed about 20 percent of IL-22-positive cells were neutrophils, and protection persisted in mice lacking ILC3s, marking an independent, non-redundant role.
  • 丁酸梭菌载双药：先护脑再护肠，同步缓解肠炎与焦虑抑郁
    Dual-drug Clostridium butyricum delivery eases colitis and anxiety together in mice
    郑州大学王蕾团队构建序贯递送系统：以丁酸梭菌为底盘，表面载5-氨基水杨酸，外层裹含吲哚-3-乙酸（IAA）的肠溶聚合物。小肠pH升至5.5以上时外壳先溶，IAA入血靶向大脑、恢复海马α7nAChR与胆碱能抗炎通路；核心抵达结肠后再释放5-ASA。切断膈下迷走神经后IAA的护肠效应几乎消失，提示其经迷走神经远程调控肠道炎症。
    Wang Lei's group at Zhengzhou University built a sequential delivery system using Clostridium butyricum as the chassis, loaded on its surface with 5-aminosalicylic acid and wrapped in an enteric polymer containing indole-3-acetic acid (IAA). Above pH 5.5 in the small intestine the shell dissolves first, releasing IAA into the blood to act on the brain, restoring hippocampal alpha7nAChR and the cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway; the core then reaches the colon and releases 5-ASA. Cutting the subdiaphragmatic vagus abolished IAA's gut protection, showing remote control via the nerve.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 阿尔茨海默“清理系统”被找到缺口：CASS4基因失灵让斑块失控扩散
    Alzheimer's cleanup flaw traced to CASS4 gene in microglia
    弗吉尼亚大学团队在Journal of Experimental Medicine报告，长期与阿尔茨海默病风险相关的CASS4基因主要作用于小胶质细胞而非神经元。基因功能受损时，小胶质细胞包裹、压实β淀粉样斑块的能力下降，斑块更快扩散，邻近神经元受损、认知恶化。研究者提出，CASS4活性缺陷或可作早期生物标志物，恢复其功能可能成为新治疗方向，但现有证据来自小鼠。
    Researchers at UVA Health reported in the Journal of Experimental Medicine that CASS4, a gene repeatedly linked to Alzheimer's risk, acts mainly in microglia rather than neurons. When the gene was disrupted in mice, microglia lost the ability to surround and compact amyloid-beta plaques, allowing them to spread faster, damaging nearby neurons and worsening cognition. The team suggests defective CASS4 activity could serve as an early biomarker and that boosting its function may offer a therapeutic route, though the evidence remains mouse-based.
  • 一片降压药激活棕色脂肪：氯沙坦另辟代谢通路，10万人影像牵连情绪
    Losartan switches on brown fat through a pathway separate from blood pressure
    洛克菲勒大学团队在Nature发表：常用降压药氯沙坦可在小鼠中激活棕色脂肪，提高耗氧与能量消耗而体重稳定，且激活通路与降压通路彼此独立，理论上可拆分开发。团队另分析逾10万名患者PET/CT，发现可检出棕色脂肪者血糖血脂、心功能与炎症指标更好，焦虑抑郁比例更低，但骨质疏松与部分皮肤病比例更高，SSRI则似抑制棕色脂肪。
    A Rockefeller University team reported in Nature that losartan, a widely used blood pressure drug, activates brown fat in mice, raising oxygen consumption and energy expenditure while body weight stayed stable. Crucially, the fat-activating pathway is distinct from the blood-pressure one, suggesting the effects could be separated in future drugs. Analysing PET/CT from over 100,000 patients, the team found those with detectable brown fat had better glycaemic, lipid, cardiac and inflammatory profiles and lower rates of anxiety and depression, but higher rates of osteoporosis and some skin conditions; SSRIs appeared to suppress brown fat.
  • 45页综述拆解抗衰老药三派：清除、平抑、逆转各有各的坑
    45-page review sorts anti-aging drugs into clear, suppress and reverse camps
    一篇发表于Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy、45页548篇文献的综述把抗衰老干预分为三派：直接清除衰老细胞、抑制其SASP炎症分泌、把衰老细胞逆转回年轻状态。三者各有硬伤——清除易误伤正常细胞，平抑停药易反弹，逆转存在致瘤风险，作者主张以纳米递送精准投喂并联合用药。文中同时点出通讯作者与营养补充剂企业存在利益关联，尿石素A、麦角硫因等结论证据强度需打折。
    A 45-page review with 548 references in Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy groups anti-aging interventions into three camps: clearing senescent cells outright, suppressing their inflammatory SASP secretion, and reprogramming them back toward youth. Each has a catch: clearance can hit healthy cells, suppression rebounds after stopping, and reprogramming carries tumorigenic risk, so the authors argue for nanoparticle-guided delivery and combination regimens. The piece also notes the corresponding authors' ties to supplement companies, cautioning that positive findings for urolithin A and ergothioneine rest on early-stage data.
  • MIND饮食吃得越像，表观遗传时钟走得越慢：1740人队列证据
    Closer MIND diet adherence linked to slower epigenetic aging in 1,740 adults
    一项发表于medRxiv的队列研究，把1740名美国“健康与退休研究”参与者2013年的膳食数据与2016年的DNA甲基化数据对接：MIND饮食依从性每提高1个标准差，PhenoAge加速衰老减少0.4年（95%CI −0.8至−0.1）、GrimAge减少0.3年，甲基化衰老“步速”亦下降，校正BMI与选择性加权后仍成立。属观察性关联，不能证明因果，也未发现特定亚群获益更多。
    A medRxiv cohort study linked 2013 dietary data to 2016 DNA methylation measures in 1,740 participants of the US Health and Retirement Study. Each one-standard-deviation higher MIND diet score was associated with 0.4 fewer years of PhenoAge acceleration (95% CI -0.8 to -0.1), 0.3 fewer years of GrimAge acceleration, and a slower methylation pace of aging, with associations persisting after BMI adjustment and selection weighting. The design is observational, so causality is unproven, and causal forests found no subgroup benefiting reproducibly more.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 同样是20克蛋白，只有瘦猪肉碎让“双亮氨酸”飙起来
    Same 20 g of protein, but only lean pork raised dileucine in a randomized trial
    伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校随机对照研究（Molecular Nutrition & Food Research）让健康年轻人在抗阻训练后分别摄入等蛋白（约20克）的低脂瘦猪肉碎、高脂猪肉碎、黑豆米饭、游离氨基酸饮料或纯碳水饮料。唯有瘦猪肉碎使血中双亮氨酸在90—120分钟显著高于基线，且其峰值与肌肉蛋白合成改善显著正相关，而游离亮氨酸未见此关联，提示食物基质改变吸收形态。
    A randomized crossover-style trial from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, published in Molecular Nutrition & Food Research, gave healthy young adults one of five interventions after resistance exercise, each matched to about 20 g of protein: lean minced pork, high-fat pork, black beans with rice, a free amino acid beverage, or a carbohydrate-only drink. Only lean pork produced a significant rise in blood dileucine at 90 to 120 minutes, and dileucine peaks correlated with improved muscle protein synthesis, whereas free leucine did not, pointing to food matrix effects.
  • 中国一年16.9万例癌症死亡与“吃”有关：红肉多、奶少、全谷物少排前三
    Diet linked to 168,740 cancer deaths in China, with red meat, low dairy and low whole grains topping the list
    赣南医科大学团队基于GBD 2023中国数据估算：2023年膳食危险因素归因癌症死亡168740例（95%UI 5.9万—31.4万），损失约409.6万DALY；年龄标化死亡率年均下降3.09%，但绝对负担因老龄化并未同步下降。危险因素前三位是红肉过多、奶类不足、全谷物不足，结直肠癌负担最重，男性与老年人更吃亏。属建模估算，区间很宽，不能推成个体风险。
    Using GBD 2023 estimates for China, a Gannan Medical University team calculated 168,740 cancer deaths attributable to dietary risk factors in 2023 (95% UI 58,920 to 314,397) and about 4.10 million DALYs lost. Age-standardised mortality fell 3.09 percent a year, yet absolute burden did not track it down because of population ageing. Excess red meat, insufficient dairy and insufficient whole grains ranked as the top three risks, colorectal cancer carried the largest burden, and men and older adults were hit harder. It is a modelled estimate with wide intervals, not individual risk.
  • 抗炎饮食不靠“超级食物”：营养科主任给出四条原则
    Anti-inflammatory eating is not about superfoods: a dietitian's four principles
    广东省人民医院临床营养科主任马文君指出，抗炎饮食要调控的是没有明显痛感的慢性低度炎症，而非感冒发烧、伤口红肿类急性炎症。她提出四条原则：食物多样化、优先新鲜天然食材、减少加工食品与快餐、保证足量蔬果；建议植物性食物约占全天三分之二，用全谷杂粮替换部分精白米面，规律摄入豆类与菌菇，并限制红肉、含糖饮料、油炸食品与酒精。
    Ma Wenjun, head of clinical nutrition at Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital, said anti-inflammatory eating targets chronic low-grade inflammation that produces no obvious pain, not the acute inflammation of a fever or a red wound. She set out four principles: eat a variety of foods, favour fresh whole ingredients, cut processed foods and fast food, and ensure ample vegetables and fruit. She suggested plant foods make up about two-thirds of daily intake, swapping some refined grains for whole grains and pseudo-cereals, eating legumes and mushrooms regularly, and limiting red meat, sugary drinks, fried food and alcohol.
  • Nature：家用菌群检测火了，但“标准健康菌群”根本不存在
    Nature: home microbiome tests are booming, but there is no standard healthy microbiome
    Nature报道，面向消费者的肠道微生物组居家检测快速兴起，但采样方式、细胞破壁提取、参考数据库与菌种判定阈值各家不一，结果难以横向比较。更根本的问题是学界并不存在“标准健康菌群”基线，个体肠道生态差异极大；参照人群若选错，还会给出误导性建议。文章认为，仅出于好奇下单的消费者，把钱花在膳食纤维与多样化饮食上更实际。
    Nature reports that consumer home microbiome tests are proliferating, yet companies differ in sampling, lysis and extraction methods, reference databases and species-calling thresholds, making results hard to compare. More fundamentally, science has no standard healthy microbiome baseline: individual gut ecosystems vary enormously, and a poorly chosen reference population can yield misleading advice. For consumers buying a kit out of curiosity, the article suggests the money is better spent on dietary fibre and a more varied diet.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • “闪电入睡”的网红褪黑素：剂量超标两三倍，进口身份也是假的
    Viral melatonin products found at two to three times the legal dose, with faked import status
    央视《财经调查》曝光：多款网红褪黑素以“进口普通食品”“膳食补充剂”类目上架，却在直播与短视频中宣称“闪电入睡”“改善睡眠”，实测含量超我国保健食品原料目录规定的成人每日1—3毫克两至三倍，部分还瞄准青少年，而目录明确将少年儿童列为不适宜人群。有厂商以7万—8万元打包海外商标、境外空转与报关，为超标产品伪造进口身份。
    CCTV's Finance Investigation found that several viral melatonin products are listed as imported ordinary foods or dietary supplements while being promoted in livestreams and short videos as fast-acting sleep aids. Testing showed melatonin at two to three times China's permitted adult dose of 1 to 3 mg per day, and some products target teenagers even though the ingredient catalogue lists children as unsuitable. Manufacturers reportedly charge 70,000 to 80,000 yuan to package overseas trademarks, offshore logistics loops and customs paperwork, faking an imported identity for over-dosed products.
  • 保健食品家底摊开：注册1.4万个、备案2.7万个，前三功能占了一半
    China's supplement registry: 14,000 approved, 27,000 filed, and half in just three claims
    国家食检中心审评员原黎兰在第23届中国国际保健博览会上披露：1996年至今累计注册保健食品1.4万余个，2017年5月至今备案2.7万余个，全国获生产许可企业1800余家。她同时点出三大短板——产品同质化突出，增强免疫力、缓解体力疲劳、辅助降血脂三项功能占批准产品一半以上；保健概念泛滥致消费者难辨识；跨境电商增长迅猛、消费需求外流。
    Speaking at the 23rd China International Health Industry Expo, reviewer Yuan Lilan of the National Center for Food Safety Risk Assessment's testing body said China has approved more than 14,000 registered health foods since 1996 and filed over 27,000 since May 2017, with more than 1,800 manufacturers holding production licences. She flagged three weaknesses: severe product homogenisation, with immune support, fatigue relief and lipid-lowering claims covering over half of approved products; rampant vague health concepts that confuse consumers; and rapid cross-border e-commerce growth that pulls demand offshore.
  • 直播、私域、AI营销怎么管：多方共议食品保健食品宣传合规
    Livestreams, private channels and AI marketing in the dock at food and supplement compliance forum
    中国市场监管报社主办的“坚守营销宣传底线”交流会在京举行，聚焦直播、私域、AI营销等新业态下食品与保健食品虚假夸大宣传治理。总局广告监管司、食品生产经营司、特殊食品司负责人分别就网络食品销售虚假宣传专项整治、食品安全主体责任落实、广告法规边界解读监管要求；地方局分享全链条风险分级与特殊食品抽检经验，呼吁政府、行业、企业、媒体协同共治。
    A forum hosted by the China Market Regulation News in Beijing examined how to curb false and exaggerated claims for foods and health foods across livestreaming, private traffic and AI-driven marketing, as part of the 2026 National Food Safety Awareness Week. Officials from the advertising, food production and special foods departments of the State Administration for Market Regulation outlined a special campaign against false online food claims, corporate responsibility requirements and the legal boundary for food and supplement advertising, while local regulators shared risk-tiered oversight and special-food sampling practices.
  • 双十一保健品销售额同比增8%：年轻客群渗透加深，监管趋严利好头部
    Supplements up 8% year on year over Double 11 as younger buyers pile in
    券商研报援引监测数据称，2026年双十一保健品销售额同比增长8%，年轻群体渗透率提升，叠加监管趋严，利好头部品牌集中度提升；同期量贩零食正从门店扩张转向规模与效率双驱动。研报把这两个细分列为具备产业趋势性机会的方向，并建议关注高ROE、高分红龙头。食品饮料板块三季报风险已集中释放，四季度起低基数效应逐步显现。
    A brokerage research note citing monitoring data said supplement sales grew 8 percent year on year during the 2026 Double 11 shopping festival, with younger consumers raising penetration, while tighter regulation favours consolidation among leading brands. Mass-market snack retail, meanwhile, is shifting from store expansion to scale-and-efficiency driven growth. The note lists both segments as offering structural trend opportunities and recommends high-ROE, high-dividend leaders, adding that risk in the food and beverage sector was largely released in third-quarter results.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 糖尿病指南2026版：首提MLCK综合征，糖化≥7.5%可直接起始联合
    China's 2026 diabetes guideline introduces MLCK syndrome and upfront combination therapy
    中华医学会糖尿病学分会大会公布《中国糖尿病防治指南（2026版）》要点：章节由20章扩充至27章，首次提出代谢—肝脏—心血管—肾脏（MLCK）综合征概念并建立0—4期分层监测；新增糖化血红蛋白≥7.5%或高于个体化目标1.5%的起始联合治疗路径；体重管理按减重5%、10%、15%分层，并把腰围、腰高比纳入目标；同时新增人工智能、干细胞治疗与肌少症管理。
    At the Chinese Diabetes Society congress, highlights of the 2026 China guideline for diabetes prevention and treatment were released. Chapters expanded from 20 to 27, and the guideline introduces the metabolic-liver-cardiovascular-kidney (MLCK) syndrome with a 0 to 4 staging and monitoring framework. A new upfront combination pathway applies when HbA1c is 7.5 percent or higher, or 1.5 percent above an individualised target. Weight goals are tiered at 5, 10 and 15 percent loss and now include waist circumference and waist-to-height ratio, alongside new sections on AI, stem cell therapy and sarcopenia.
  • 老年友好社区长什么样：1400平方米嵌入式养老中心＋慢病智能监测
    What an age-friendly community looks like: embedded care centres and smart chronic disease monitoring
    全国老龄工作会议提出建设老年友好社会后，央视走访浙江庆元、桐乡等地：庆元县同心社区通过加装坡道与栏杆完成公共区域适老化改造，建成1400平方米嵌入式居家养老中心，提供助餐、助浴、助医、助急服务，并为老人建立电子健康档案，开展慢病智能监测与家庭医生定期随访；桐乡则以“邻里小铺”推动低龄老人服务高龄老人。
    After the national conference on ageing called for building an age-friendly society, CCTV visited communities in Qingyuan and Tongxiang in Zhejiang. In Qingyuan's Tongxin community, ramps and handrails were added to public areas and a 1,400-square-metre embedded home-care centre now offers meals, bathing, medical help and emergency assistance. Residents have electronic health records, smart chronic disease monitoring and regular family doctor follow-ups. Tongxiang, meanwhile, uses neighbourhood shops to mobilise younger seniors to help older ones.
  • 山区县怎么把家医签“实”：63支团队＋红黄绿三色管控入选全国18案例
    Mountain county's family doctor model makes China's top 18 primary care cases
    2026年全国基层卫生高质量发展大会公布全国18个优秀创新案例，陕西山阳县《全人群全生命周期家庭医生签约健康管理》入选，是陕西唯一。该县以“1126”医共体为主线，组建63支复合型家医团队覆盖所有镇街，推行村医副院长与“县聘镇管村用”，对慢病实施红黄绿三色分级。目前县域就诊率94.69%、基层诊疗量占比65.5%以上、慢病规范管理率93.15%、满意度96%以上。
    At the 2026 national conference on high-quality primary health development, Shanyang county in Shaanxi was named among 18 outstanding innovation cases nationwide, the province's only entry, for its whole-population, whole-lifecycle family doctor contract model. Built around the county's 1126 medical community reform, it has formed 63 composite family doctor teams covering every township, introduced village-doctor deputy director roles and county-hired, township-managed staffing, and applies red-amber-green tiers for chronic disease. County-level visit rates now reach 94.69 percent, primary care accounts for over 65.5 percent of visits, standardised chronic disease management hits 93.15 percent and satisfaction exceeds 96 percent.
  • 换医院不用重做检查：一座县级市上传660万份检验结果后的账本
    One county city uploaded 6.6 million lab results so patients need not retest
    广东信宜市推进检查检验结果共享互认：市第二人民医院、怀乡中心卫生院接入省平台后累计上传检验结果660多万份、检查报告7万多份，医生调阅他院结果8000多次、互认5000多次，为患者节省约15.2万元。玉都街道社区卫生服务中心同步做实重点人群管理，截至11月19日高血压、糖尿病管理率均达100%，老年人管理率68%，0—6岁儿童86.19%。
    Xinyi in Guangdong is expanding mutual recognition of medical tests. After joining the provincial sharing platform, the city's second people's hospital and Huaixiang township health centre have uploaded more than 6.6 million lab results and over 70,000 imaging reports; doctors viewed other hospitals' results more than 8,000 times and accepted them over 5,000 times, saving patients about 152,000 yuan. Meanwhile Yudu subdistrict's community health centre reports 100 percent management rates for hypertension and diabetes as of 19 November, 68 percent for older adults and 86.19 percent for children aged 0 to 6.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-11-22
item.description: 2026-11-22 简报，共 20 条：限时进食防急性肝损伤：南医大团队揭示「肠菌产尿酸」新通路；上海科普大讲坛聚焦肠脑轴：LcS干预帕金森临床结果与「调神扶正」同台；脊髓损伤后肠道「氮循环」崩塌：19个关键菌种解释顽固性氮负平衡；华中农大团队：两种拟杆菌重塑菌群，吲哚联用酚酸清除耐药菌定植；莫纳什大学绘出免疫衰老基因蓝图：CD8⁺T细胞有三条老化路径；专访霍尔斯泰格：认知健康活到百岁，约六成能力归因于遗传；《先进科学》鼻喷mRNA让鼻上皮就地造BDNF，改善老年与AD小鼠记忆；《华尔街日报》述评：活得更久不等于活得更好，长寿产业该换考核指标；第三届精准营养与生命健康创新大会三亚开幕，四百余专家聚焦AI与菌群靶向；北大团队综述：地中海饮食与胃癌风险降29%、结直肠癌降10%—16%相关；893人研究：肠道微生物健康指数可作为整体健康的复合生物标志物；美国乳品协会：健康老龄化是乳清蛋白被忽视的市场，老年蛋白需求被低估；2026营养素循证与创新产业大会郑州落幕，首发AI智能体与《营养素生物代谢白皮书》；山西药店医保个账「白名单」：保健品不能刷，特医食品可用临时码结算；衡阳公布养老领域虚假宣传六起典型案例：蜂胶称「有炎必消」被罚；药食同源产业联盟长沙成立，团体标准制订启动并上线「鑫卫云药房」；长沙天心区深化矩阵式医联体，同步开办基层老年人健康管理指导中心培训班；聊城：全民健康信息平台连接2300余套终端，AI辅助诊断覆盖1700余种疾病；广州番禺：217个家庭医生团队守社区，钟村街「三师共管」体重门诊成样本；湖北老年医学基层适宜人才咸宁培训班开班，八位省市专家授课
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 限时进食防急性肝损伤：南医大团队揭示「肠菌产尿酸」新通路
    Time-Restricted Feeding Protects the Liver by Curbing Gut Bacterial Urate Production
    南方医科大学龚神海、新桥医院肖卫东、南医三院何懿与华南师大王璋团队11月18日在《Cell Reports Medicine》发表研究：限时进食降低肠道3-甲基组胺，抑制中间普雷沃菌生长，该菌经腺苷脱氨酶在肠道生成尿酸；尿酸再经LRCH1阻断PINK1/Parkin线粒体自噬而产生肝毒性。人群队列支持把限时进食作为肝损伤预防策略。
    A study published Nov 18 in Cell Reports Medicine by teams from Southern Medical University, Xinqiao Hospital, the Third Affiliated Hospital of SMU and South China Normal University shows time-restricted feeding lowers intestinal 3-methylhistamine, which curbs Prevotella intermedia; that bacterium makes urate via adenosine deaminase, and urate then blocks PINK1/Parkin mitophagy through LRCH1, injuring the liver. Human cohort data support time-restricted eating as a liver-protection strategy.
  • 上海科普大讲坛聚焦肠脑轴：LcS干预帕金森临床结果与「调神扶正」同台
    Shanghai Science Forum Takes On the Gut-Brain Axis, From an LcS Trial in Parkinson's to Mind-Body Regulation
    上海科普大讲坛以「菌衡自在、肠享健康」为题开讲。杨晓东介绍团队用副干酪乳酪杆菌代田株YIT9029干预帕金森病的临床研究：补充LcS可改善胃肠道症状、提升肠道乳酸杆菌丰度、降低粪便酪氨酸并升高血浆酪氨酸，而酪氨酸是多巴胺前体；田建辉则从「正虚伏毒、调神扶正」谈免疫微环境重塑。
    A Shanghai public science forum titled Gut Balance, Gut Health featured Yang Xiaodong describing clinical work in which Lactobacillus paracasei Shirota YIT9029 was given to Parkinson's patients: supplementation eased gastrointestinal symptoms, raised intestinal lactobacilli, lowered fecal tyrosine and raised plasma tyrosine, the precursor of dopamine. Tian Jianhui discussed rebuilding the immune microenvironment through the traditional idea of calming the mind and supporting vital qi.
  • 脊髓损伤后肠道「氮循环」崩塌：19个关键菌种解释顽固性氮负平衡
    After Spinal Cord Injury the Gut's Nitrogen Cycle Collapses: 19 Keystone Species Explain Persistent Negative Nitrogen Balance
    一项小鼠研究借生态学网络思路分析263个高质量细菌基因组，在6个时间点交叉验证后锁定19个关键菌种：11种随损伤加重异常扩增，8种核心共生菌大幅减少。携带完整脲酶基因簇的菌株锐减使尿素氮回收瘫痪、尿素蓄积；苯丙氨酸与酪氨酸合成枯竭，多胺合成异常增强，为脊髓损伤后氮负平衡提供菌群解释。
    Using an ecological network approach on 263 high-quality bacterial genomes and cross-validating at six time points, a mouse study narrowed the field to 19 keystone species: 11 expand abnormally as injury worsens while eight core commensals collapse. Loss of urease-carrying strains cripples urea nitrogen recycling and lets urea accumulate, while phenylalanine and tyrosine synthesis dries up and polyamine production rises, offering a microbial explanation for post-injury negative nitrogen balance.
  • 华中农大团队：两种拟杆菌重塑菌群，吲哚联用酚酸清除耐药菌定植
    Two Bacteroides Species Reshape the Gut, and Indole Plus Phenolic Acids Clears Resistant Pathogens
    华中农大王旭、王俊豪团队发现，嗜酸拟杆菌与鼠盲肠拟杆菌可提升Akkermansia等有益菌比例、压制大肠杆菌过度增殖，重建对空肠弯曲菌的定植抗性。代谢组锁定色氨酸与苯丙素通路：吲哚能破坏细菌细胞膜与生物被膜，与丙酸、丁香酸、阿魏酸联用后协同瓦解膜电位，致胞内核酸、蛋白与ATP大量泄漏。
    Researchers at Huazhong Agricultural University found that Bacteroides acidifaciens and B. caecimuris raise beneficial taxa such as Akkermansia while suppressing overgrowth of E. coli, restoring colonization resistance against Campylobacter jejuni. Metabolomics pointed to tryptophan and phenylpropanoid pathways: indole disrupts bacterial membranes and biofilms, and combined with propionate, syringic acid and ferulic acid it collapses membrane potential, leaking nucleic acids, proteins and ATP.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 莫纳什大学绘出免疫衰老基因蓝图：CD8⁺T细胞有三条老化路径
    Monash Maps the Genetic Blueprint of Immune Aging: CD8+ T Cells Take Three Distinct Routes
    澳大利亚莫纳什大学团队在《Science Immunology》发表临床前研究，以小鼠为模型发现衰老通过三种不同的染色质特征扰乱CD8⁺T细胞的基因指令，影响其应对新威胁、调控免疫反应与维持自身健康的能力；还识别出一群此前未知的衰老CD8调节性T细胞，不仅丧失保护功能，还主动抑制其他免疫细胞，提示免疫衰老并非均一过程。
    A preclinical study from Monash University in Science Immunology used mouse models to show that aging disrupts the genetic instructions of CD8+ T cells through three distinct chromatin signatures, impairing their ability to meet new threats, regulate immune responses and stay healthy. The team also found a previously unrecognized population of aged CD8 regulatory T cells that not only lose protection but actively suppress other immune cells, showing immune aging is not uniform.
  • 专访霍尔斯泰格：认知健康活到百岁，约六成能力归因于遗传
    Interview with Henne Holstege: About 60% of Reaching 100 with Intact Cognition Is Heritable
    红星新闻专访阿姆斯特丹大学医学中心遗传学家亨内·霍尔斯泰格。其团队重建认知健康百岁老人的家族史并与同龄伴侣对照，估算在保持认知健康的前提下活到100岁约六成能力归因于遗传。团队已找到一批与阿尔茨海默病抵抗力相关的罕见变异，以APOE保护性变异最受关注；她强调基因不决定命运，运动、戒烟、控血压血糖与听力干预依然有效。
    In an interview with Red Star News, Henne Holstege of Amsterdam UMC described reconstructing family histories of cognitively healthy centenarians and comparing them with same-age partners' families; roughly 60% of the ability to reach 100 with intact cognition appears heritable. Her team has identified rare variants tied to Alzheimer's resistance, notably protective APOE variants, but she stresses genes are not destiny and that exercise, quitting smoking, blood pressure and glucose control and hearing correction still matter.
  • 《先进科学》鼻喷mRNA让鼻上皮就地造BDNF，改善老年与AD小鼠记忆
    Intranasal mRNA Lets the Nasal Epithelium Make BDNF, Improving Memory in Aged and Alzheimer's Mice
    悉尼大学G. Gregory Neely团队11月18日在《Advanced Science》发表研究，构建仅编码成熟BDNF的mRNA-脂质纳米颗粒鼻腔制剂，借鼻上皮就地合成蛋白以绕开血脑屏障。老年小鼠与5xFAD模型经鼻给药后脑内BDNF升高、海马神经发生增强、多项记忆改善，且未诱发明显炎症；5xFAD的Aβ斑块未见改变，属非侵入式临床前候选策略。
    A Nov 18 study in Advanced Science from G. Gregory Neely's group at the University of Sydney built an intranasal mRNA-lipid nanoparticle formulation encoding only mature BDNF, using the nasal epithelium as an in-body protein factory to bypass the blood-brain barrier. In aged mice and 5xFAD models, nasal dosing raised brain BDNF, boosted hippocampal neurogenesis and improved multiple memory measures without obvious inflammation, though amyloid plaques were unchanged.
  • 《华尔街日报》述评：活得更久不等于活得更好，长寿产业该换考核指标
    WSJ Commentary: A Longer Life Isn't Always a Better Life, and Longevity Needs New Endpoints
    澎湃新闻编译《华尔街日报》述评指出，美国人平均预期寿命约79岁、健康寿命约65岁，相差约14年；70岁及以上人群中超过八成至少患一种慢病。文章强调生物年龄与衰老时钟的改善并不必然带来疾病风险下降或功能改善，健康长寿医学应转向慢病预防、身体功能、认知与独立生活能力等真实结局，并尊重患者对治疗强度的个人选择。
    A Wall Street Journal commentary translated by The Paper notes US life expectancy of about 79 years versus healthspan of about 65, a gap of roughly 14 years, and that more than 80% of people aged 70 and over have at least one chronic disease. It argues that better biological age and clock readings do not necessarily mean lower disease risk or better function, and that longevity medicine should track prevention, physical function, cognition and independence, while respecting patients' choices about treatment intensity.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 第三届精准营养与生命健康创新大会三亚开幕，四百余专家聚焦AI与菌群靶向
    Third Precision Nutrition and Life Health Innovation Conference Opens in Sanya With 400+ Experts
    11月21日，第三届精准营养与生命健康创新大会在三亚开幕，逾400名营养学、食品科学、人工智能与产业界代表参会。议题覆盖食药同源原料挖掘、精准营养调控新机制、功能组分递送控释新工艺、个性化健康食品创制、AI大模型赋能主动健康管理与肠道微生物组靶向干预，并设慢病营养干预与免疫功能强化等分论坛；陈卫、邓子新、朱蓓薇、谢明勇等院士出席。
    The third Precision Nutrition and Life Health Innovation Conference opened in Sanya on Nov 21 with more than 400 specialists in nutrition, food science, AI and industry. Topics spanned medicinal-food raw materials, new mechanisms of nutritional regulation, delivery and controlled-release processes, personalized health foods, large AI models for proactive health management and microbiome-targeted intervention, with sub-forums on chronic disease nutrition and immune function. Academicians Chen Wei, Deng Zixin, Zhu Beiwei and Xie Mingyong attended.
  • 北大团队综述：地中海饮食与胃癌风险降29%、结直肠癌降10%—16%相关
    Peking University Review Links the Mediterranean Diet to 29% Lower Gastric and 10-16% Lower Colorectal Cancer Risk
    北京大学团队在《The Innovation Nutrition》发表综述，综合数十年流行病学证据：覆盖逾130万人的合并分析显示，地中海饮食依从度最高者胃癌风险比最低者低29%，评分每增1分胃癌风险约降5%；该饮食还与结直肠癌风险降10%—16%、结直肠腺瘤风险降21%相关。机制涉及降低炎症标志物、橄榄油与果蔬抗氧化，以及膳食纤维经菌群发酵产丁酸。
    A Peking University review in The Innovation Nutrition pooled decades of epidemiological evidence: in analyses covering more than 1.3 million people, those most adherent to a Mediterranean diet had 29% lower gastric cancer risk than the least adherent, with roughly 5% lower risk per point of adherence. The pattern was also linked to 10-16% lower colorectal cancer risk and 21% lower odds of adenomas, via lower inflammatory markers, antioxidant-rich olive oil and produce, and fiber fermented to butyrate.
  • 893人研究：肠道微生物健康指数可作为整体健康的复合生物标志物
    893-Person Study: A Gut Microbial Health Index Works as a Composite Biomarker of Overall Health
    一项发表于《Gut Microbes》的研究在893名年度体检人群中以16S测序计算微生物健康指数（MHI），即97种健康相关与31种疾病相关细菌变体数量比值的对数。膳食纤维摄入多、坚持地中海饮食、体能（METs）更好者MHI更高、血脂更理想；超加工食品多、亚临床炎症高者MHI更低。研究称该指数对饮食变化反应迅速，可像血压血脂一样反映健康状态。
    Published in Gut Microbes, the study calculated a microbial health index (MHI), the log ratio of 97 health-associated to 31 disease-associated bacterial variants, in 893 adults undergoing annual checkups with 16S sequencing. Higher fiber intake, Mediterranean-style eating and better fitness (METs) tracked with higher MHI and better lipids, while more ultra-processed food and subclinical inflammation tracked with lower scores. The index responded quickly to diet, much like blood pressure or lipids.
  • 美国乳品协会：健康老龄化是乳清蛋白被忽视的市场，老年蛋白需求被低估
    ADPI Says Healthy Aging Is Whey Protein's Missed Market as Older Adults' Protein Needs Are Underserved
    美国乳品协会（ADPI）技术发展副总裁Kimberlee Burrington在芝加哥乳清会议上表示，行业过度聚焦运动营养，忽视了健康老龄化这一「错失的机会」：蛋白质摄入不足会加速肌肉流失，影响平衡并抬高跌倒风险。她指出配方难点在于「在更小体积里装更多蛋白」——部分蛋白shot已做到100毫升含约20克，但口感与稳定性难以兼顾；乳清与GLP-1用药者的保肌研究才刚起步。
    Speaking at a Chicago whey conference, ADPI technical development vice president Kimberlee Burrington said the industry's focus on sports nutrition has left healthy aging a missed opportunity: too little protein accelerates muscle loss, harms balance and raises fall risk. The formulation challenge is fitting more protein into less product, with some shots reaching about 20 g per 100 mL at the cost of taste and stability. Research on whey and muscle retention in GLP-1 users is only beginning.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 2026营养素循证与创新产业大会郑州落幕，首发AI智能体与《营养素生物代谢白皮书》
    Evidence-Based Nutrient Conference in Zhengzhou Debuts an AI Agent and a Nutrient Metabolism White Paper
    11月19日至20日，2026营养素循证与创新产业大会在郑州举行，由郑州瑞普生物与营养素生物代谢评价研究院主办，主题为「循证营养代谢 共创全民健康」。开幕式发布两项行业首发：NutriRipu™ AI智能体启动并现场演示问答；《营养素生物代谢白皮书》发布，试图把营养素研究从分散探索推向系统化标准化，推动行业从「含量营养」转向「代谢营养、精准营养」。
    Held in Zhengzhou on Nov 19-20 and hosted by Ruipu Bio and the Nutrient Biometabolism Evaluation Institute, the 2026 Evidence-Based Nutrient and Innovation Conference opened with two industry firsts: the NutriRipu AI agent, demonstrated live in Q&A, and a white paper on nutrient biometabolism. The document aims to move nutrient research from scattered exploration to systematic standards and shift the sector from nutrient content claims toward metabolism-based, precision nutrition.
  • 山西药店医保个账「白名单」：保健品不能刷，特医食品可用临时码结算
    Shanxi Sets a Whitelist for Pharmacy Medical-Account Spending: No Supplements, but Formula Foods Qualify
    山西印发通知建立定点零售药店职工医保个人账户支付白名单，自印发之日30日后施行，全省统一清单。准予支付四类：医疗属性强的药品、器械与耗材；医用消毒产品；经市场监管总局批准的特医食品（用「特医食品药店临时码Q03000000」结算）；体外诊断试剂。不予支付范围明确包含蓝帽子保健食品、智能手表手环等穿戴设备与米面油。
    Shanxi issued a notice creating a unified whitelist for what employees' medical insurance accounts may buy at designated pharmacies, effective 30 days after publication. Four categories qualify: clearly medical drugs, devices and consumables; medical disinfectants; formula foods for special medical purposes approved by the market regulator, settled with a dedicated temporary code; and in-vitro diagnostics. Excluded are blue-hat health foods, smart watches and bands, and staples such as rice, flour and oil.
  • 衡阳公布养老领域虚假宣传六起典型案例：蜂胶称「有炎必消」被罚
    Hengyang Names Six Senior-Targeted False-Advertising Cases, Including Propolis Claimed to 'Clear Any Inflammation'
    湖南衡阳市场监管部门公布养老领域暨网络食品虚假宣传专项整治六起典型案例。蒸湘区一驼奶店在微信群推送直播链接，宣称蜂胶软胶囊「有炎必消、有包必散、调节血糖血脂、辅助治疗糖尿病」，与获批「有助于增强免疫」功能不符；另有理疗店宣称膏方修复心脑血管、公司小程序宣传矿泉水「防癌抗癌之王」，均依《反不正当竞争法》处罚。
    Market regulators in Hengyang, Hunan published six typical cases from a campaign against senior-targeted and online food false advertising. One camel-milk shop pushed livestream links into WeChat groups claiming its propolis softgels would clear any inflammation or lump, regulate blood sugar and lipids and help treat diabetes, far beyond the approved immune-support claim. Others claimed a paste repaired heart and brain vessels, or that mineral water was a cancer-fighting king; all were fined under the Anti-Unfair Competition Law.
  • 药食同源产业联盟长沙成立，团体标准制订启动并上线「鑫卫云药房」
    Medicinal-Food Industry Alliance Launches in Changsha With Standards Work and a Cloud Pharmacy
    11月20日下午，2026长沙银发产业博览会重点活动——食药同源产业联盟成立大会在红星国际会展中心举行，理事长单位共同签署《食药同源产业联盟公约》并授牌。大会同步启动食药同源标准制订，拟从原料溯源、生产加工、品控检测、标识规范建立统一准则；「鑫卫云药房」上线，打通线上线下本草产品流转、体质服务与溯源查询。
    On the afternoon of Nov 20, a key event of the Changsha silver-economy expo saw the founding of a medicinal-food industry alliance at the Hongxing International Convention Center, with member units signing a covenant and receiving plaques. The meeting also launched standards work covering raw-material traceability, processing, quality testing and labeling, and unveiled the Xinwei cloud pharmacy, which links online and offline herbal product flows, constitution-based services and traceability queries.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 长沙天心区深化矩阵式医联体，同步开办基层老年人健康管理指导中心培训班
    Changsha's Tianxin District Deepens Its Matrix Medical Alliance and Trains Grassroots Geriatric Health Managers
    11月21日报道，长沙天心区深化矩阵式医联体建设，以长沙市第三医院为牵头医院，推动专科联盟协作、资源技术人才下沉。同期举办长沙市基层老年人健康管理指导中心培训班，设置糖尿病性骨质疏松症诊治、高血压患者基层规范化管理、慢阻肺全球指南解读等实操课程；参会人员还实地察看天心紧密型城市医疗集团南托中心运行情况。
    Changsha's Tianxin district is deepening a matrix-style medical alliance led by the Third Hospital of Changsha, pushing specialty collaboration and the downward flow of resources, technology and staff. A parallel training course for the city's grassroots geriatric health management center covered diabetic osteoporosis, standardized primary-care hypertension management and the global COPD guideline. Attendees also visited the Nantuo center of the district's compact urban medical group.
  • 聊城：全民健康信息平台连接2300余套终端，AI辅助诊断覆盖1700余种疾病
    Liaocheng Links 2,300+ Terminals to Its Health Data Platform as AI Diagnosis Covers 1,700+ Diseases
    11月20日聊城市卫健委发布会披露，该市全民健康信息平台按「市级统建、县级共享、基层使用」连接2300余套终端、打通16类信息板块，电子病历、健康档案等四大数据库实时归集；基层引进清华DUCG人工智能辅助诊断，覆盖1700余种疾病。全市93家机构实现省域内检查检验结果互认，影像357项、检验151项；39家二级以上医院推行「一次挂号、多日有效」。
    At a Nov 20 briefing, Liaocheng's health commission said its city-built health information platform links more than 2,300 terminals across 16 data domains, with real-time aggregation of electronic records, health files and other core databases. Primary care has adopted Tsinghua's DUCG AI diagnostic support covering over 1,700 diseases. Ninety-three institutions now recognize each other's results within the province, covering 357 imaging and 151 lab items, and 39 hospitals offer multi-day validity for a single registration.
  • 广州番禺：217个家庭医生团队守社区，钟村街「三师共管」体重门诊成样本
    Guangzhou's Panyu District Fields 217 Family Doctor Teams as a Three-Professional Weight Clinic Sets an Example
    广州番禺以25间健康驿站、23间社区卫生服务机构和217个家庭医生团队织密基层网络，特色科室覆盖中医治未病、康复、体重管理、呼吸慢病、内分泌与老年医学。钟村街社区卫生服务中心打造「三师共管」医防融合体重管理门诊，以个性化营养处方与中医适宜技术为核心。2025年度辖区社区门诊量246.49万人次，较2022年增长54%。
    Panyu district in Guangzhou has built a dense primary-care network of 25 health stations, 23 community health institutions and 217 family doctor teams, with specialty clinics spanning preventive Chinese medicine, rehabilitation, weight management, respiratory chronic disease, endocrinology and geriatrics. Zhongcun Street's center runs a three-professional, prevention-treatment integrated weight clinic built on personalized nutrition prescriptions and appropriate TCM techniques. Community outpatient visits reached 2.46 million in 2025, up 54% from 2022.
  • 湖北老年医学基层适宜人才咸宁培训班开班，八位省市专家授课
    Hubei Trains Grassroots Geriatric Talent in Xianning With Eight Provincial and Municipal Experts
    11月20日至21日，咸宁市卫健委主办、咸宁市中医医院承办的2026年湖北省老年医学基层适宜人才（咸宁）培训班举行，来自乡镇卫生院、社区卫生服务中心及医养结合机构的老年病相关医师参加。课程聚焦高血压、糖尿病等常见慢病规范化管理，以及老年焦虑抑郁的早期识别与干预，并涵盖老年护理需求评估、合理用药、康复护理、居家医疗与中医药适宜技术。
    On Nov 20-21 the Xianning health commission and the city's TCM hospital ran the 2026 Hubei training course for grassroots geriatric talent, drawing physicians from township hospitals, community health centers and integrated elder-care facilities. Sessions focused on standardized management of hypertension and diabetes and early recognition of anxiety and depression in older adults, plus geriatric nursing assessment, rational prescribing, rehabilitation, home care and appropriate TCM techniques.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-11-21
item.description: 2026-11-21 简报，共 20 条：功能医学专委会第四届年会在沪举行，17.8万份体检数据揭示「报告正常、功能异常」；浙大团队：果胶抗炎效果取决于背景膳食纤维，多形拟杆菌是关键搭档；《自然·通讯》1199人研究：肠道菌群比年龄更能预测炎症与未来疾病风险；香港浸大揭示「肠—海马」通路：脆弱拟杆菌脂质C1P损伤髓鞘诱发抑郁；陈香美院士：AI赋能全生命周期延缓衰老，LifeClock整合968万人就诊数据；第三届透明质酸产业大会暨长寿与延衰科学大会在济南举行，发布四项战略行动；协和团队《细胞·代谢》：NAD⁺经脂肪因子Serpina3n远程保护衰老肌肉；老年肌肉恢复慢的元凶：衰老细胞持续分泌前列腺素，低剂量布洛芬可改善；2.1万女性队列：饱和脂肪升高LDL的效应受多基因风险评分调控；超加工食品升高克罗恩病风险的机制：DHA流失叠加FADS1基因差异；达能在上海设研发创新中心，上半年中国鱼油进口额增长60%；42人随机试验：生酮饮食4—5个月肝脂降67%，半数逆转糖尿病前期；JAMA子刊50人试验：尿石素A未改善外周血管，却增强前额叶脑血流反应；直播卖鱼油称「呵护心脑眼」并制造健康焦虑，丹阳一商户被罚3万元；普通食品暗示可治幽门螺杆菌，句容查处益生菌片虚假宣传；国际益生菌协会：中国有望在2030年前成为全球最大益生菌市场；广饶街道社区卫生服务中心：中医外治叠加生活方式干预，千余人受益体重管理门诊；黑龙江举办2026年慢性病防治宣传暨健康体重管理活动；青岛崂山构建「五位一体」中医生活化体系，覆盖社区、家庭、校园、企业；青岛市南区：三甲专家编入家庭医生团队，诊室搬进社区打通最后一公里
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 功能医学专委会第四届年会在沪举行，17.8万份体检数据揭示「报告正常、功能异常」
    Functional Medicine Committee Opens 4th Annual Meeting in Shanghai as 178,946 Checkups Reveal Normal Reports, Abnormal Function
    中国抗衰老促进会功能医学专业委员会第四届年会11月21日在上海开幕，现场发布对重庆、汉中、呼和浩特三地178946份体检数据的分析：体检未见异常者中42.7%至少存在一项功能医学生理异常，约一半集中在慢性炎症、免疫平衡、胰岛素抵抗与红细胞营养失衡；维生素D缺乏检出率32.9%，18—29岁组高达57.9%，超重与肥胖合计占53%。
    The fourth annual meeting of the Functional Medicine Committee of the China Anti-Aging Promotion Association opened in Shanghai on Nov 21, releasing an analysis of 178,946 health-check records from Chongqing, Hanzhong and Hohhot. Among people whose reports looked normal, 42.7% had at least one functional physiological abnormality, about half involving chronic inflammation, immune balance, insulin resistance or red-cell nutrient imbalance. Vitamin D deficiency reached 32.9%, rising to 57.9% at ages 18 to 29, and overweight plus obesity accounted for 53%.
  • 浙大团队：果胶抗炎效果取决于背景膳食纤维，多形拟杆菌是关键搭档
    Zhejiang University: Pectin's Anti-Inflammatory Effect Depends on Background Fiber, With Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron as Key Partner
    浙江大学魏思宇、靳明亮团队在《Carbohydrate Polymers》发表研究：柑橘果胶只有在背景膳食纤维充足时才能缓解小鼠结肠炎，撤去膳食纤维后保护作用几乎消失。纤维充足组果胶显著富集转录活跃的多形拟杆菌，上调GH2、GH28等降解酶基因，提升乙酸与丙酸产量；其发酵上清可部分恢复紧密连接蛋白表达并抑制IL-6。
    A Zhejiang University team led by Wei Siyu and Jin Mingliang reported in Carbohydrate Polymers that citrus pectin relieved colitis in mice only when background dietary fiber was adequate; without it the protection largely vanished. In the fiber-sufficient group, pectin enriched transcriptionally active Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron, upregulated GH2 and GH28 degrading enzymes and raised acetate and propionate output, while its fermentation supernatant partly restored tight-junction gene expression and suppressed IL-6.
  • 《自然·通讯》1199人研究：肠道菌群比年龄更能预测炎症与未来疾病风险
    Nature Communications Study of 1,199 Adults: Gut Microbiome Predicts Inflammation and Future Disease Better Than Age
    研究分析1199名20—72岁成年人的粪便菌群、30种血浆细胞因子与19项生理生化指标，发现菌群组成对97%的炎症因子和84%的生理指标的解釋力超过年龄。B2肠型人群8种促炎因子显著升高，20多岁者的炎症水平已相当于其他肠型57岁；9年随访住院风险比为1.21，涉及13类疾病中的7类，R肠型则为0.79。
    Analyzing stool microbiome, 30 plasma cytokines and 19 physiological measures in 1,199 adults aged 20 to 72, researchers found microbiome composition explained more variance than age for 97% of inflammatory markers and 84% of physiological measures. People with the B2 enterotype had eight elevated pro-inflammatory cytokines, with twenty-somethings matching the inflammation of 57-year-olds in other enterotypes; over nine years their hospitalization risk ratio was 1.21 across seven of 13 disease categories, versus 0.79 for the R enterotype.
  • 香港浸大揭示「肠—海马」通路：脆弱拟杆菌脂质C1P损伤髓鞘诱发抑郁
    Hong Kong Baptist University Maps a Gut–Hippocampus Pathway: Bacteroides fragilis Lipid C1P Damages Myelin and Triggers Depression
    香港浸会大学刘琴团队在《Advanced Science》发表研究，分析147名腹泻型肠易激综合征患者与84名健康对照：共病抑郁者粪便中脆弱拟杆菌丰度更高，且与汉密尔顿抑郁评分正相关。该菌分泌的神经酰胺-1-磷酸可结合并降低海马SMPD4蛋白、损伤髓鞘；把膳食支链氨基酸削减至常规20%可部分恢复髓鞘标志物与行为。
    A Hong Kong Baptist University team led by Liu Qin reported in Advanced Science on 147 diarrhea-predominant IBS patients and 84 controls: those with comorbid depression carried more Bacteroides fragilis, and abundance correlated with Hamilton depression scores. The bacterium's ceramide-1-phosphate bound and lowered hippocampal SMPD4, damaging myelin. Cutting dietary branched-chain amino acids to 20% of normal partly restored myelin markers and behavior in mice.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 陈香美院士：AI赋能全生命周期延缓衰老，LifeClock整合968万人就诊数据
    Academician Chen Xiangmei: AI for Lifespan-Wide Anti-Aging, With LifeClock Drawing on 9.68 Million Patient Records
    11月17—21日，中华医学会肾脏病学分会第29届学术年会在上海召开，解放军总医院陈香美院士作《人工智能赋能全生命周期延缓衰老进展》报告。其团队构建全生命周期生物学年龄模型LifeClock，整合968万余人、2463万余次纵向就诊记录，基于常规临床数据分别建立儿童发育时钟与成人衰老时钟；并揭示百岁老人自然杀伤细胞与免疫通讯特征、肾脏衰老的器官特异性。
    At the 29th Congress of the Chinese Society of Nephrology in Shanghai, held Nov 17 to 21, Academician Chen Xiangmei of PLA General Hospital presented on AI-enabled lifespan-wide anti-aging. Her team built LifeClock, a biological age model integrating 9.68 million people and more than 24.63 million longitudinal visit records, deriving separate childhood development and adult aging clocks from routine clinical data. The work also characterized natural killer cell and immune communication features in centenarians and organ-specific patterns of kidney aging.
  • 第三届透明质酸产业大会暨长寿与延衰科学大会在济南举行，发布四项战略行动
    Third Hyaluronic Acid Industry Conference and Longevity Science Summit Opens in Jinan With Four Strategic Actions
    11月19—21日，以「生命向新 长寿未来」为主题的大会在济南举行，设十大论坛，覆盖长寿前沿科技、合成生物与糖类药物、智能生物制造与健康衰老、社会心理与健康长寿、衰老干预前沿科技等。会上发布四项战略行动：产业蓝皮书、长寿与延衰科学共同体、生命科学实验室体系，以及以郭学平名义发起的全球糖科学与肿瘤前沿交叉研究公益计划。
    Held in Jinan from Nov 19 to 21 under the theme Life Renewing, Longevity Future, the conference ran ten forums spanning frontier longevity technology, synthetic biology and glyco-drugs, intelligent biomanufacturing and healthy aging, social psychology and longevity, and frontier anti-aging interventions. Four strategic actions were launched: an industry blue book, a longevity science community, a life-science laboratory system, and a global glyco-science and oncology research fund initiated under Guo Xueping's name.
  • 协和团队《细胞·代谢》：NAD⁺经脂肪因子Serpina3n远程保护衰老肌肉
    Cell Metabolism Study: NAD+ Protects Aging Muscle Remotely via the Adipokine Serpina3n
    北京协和医学院团队在《细胞·代谢》发表研究：给22月龄老年小鼠注射NMN后肌肉量与抓力改善，但直接把NMN加到萎缩的肌管细胞上无效，说明需要脂肪组织参与。NAD⁺升高促使脂肪分泌Serpina3n，经血液到达肌肉、减缓丙酮酸羧化酶降解，维持三羧酸循环与蛋白合成；在脂肪中敲除Serpina3n后NMN的保护作用明显减弱。
    A Peking Union Medical College team reported in Cell Metabolism that NMN injections improved muscle mass and grip strength in 22-month-old mice, yet adding NMN directly to atrophied myotubes did nothing, showing adipose tissue is required. Rising NAD+ prompts fat cells to secrete Serpina3n, which travels to muscle, slows pyruvate carboxylase degradation and sustains the TCA cycle and protein synthesis; deleting Serpina3n in fat blunted NMN's protection.
  • 老年肌肉恢复慢的元凶：衰老细胞持续分泌前列腺素，低剂量布洛芬可改善
    Why Older Muscle Recovers Slowly: Senescent Cells Keep Producing Prostaglandins, and Low-Dose Ibuprofen Helps
    犹他大学团队在《Aging Cell》发表研究：小鼠肌肉废用后，年轻个体前列腺素短暂升高即启动修复，老年个体则长期维持高水平，使肌肉处于慢性炎症状态、难以完全恢复。过量前列腺素来自衰老免疫细胞，还会诱导健康细胞衰老形成恶性循环。低剂量布洛芬降低前列腺素与衰老细胞数量，帮助老年小鼠更快恢复力量，高剂量反而无效。
    A University of Utah team reported in Aging Cell that after muscle disuse, young mice show a brief prostaglandin spike that triggers repair, while old mice keep levels high, leaving muscle chronically inflamed and incompletely recovered. Excess prostaglandins come from senescent immune cells and push healthy cells into senescence, creating a feedback loop. Low-dose ibuprofen cut prostaglandins and senescent cells and sped strength recovery in aged mice, whereas a high dose did not help.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 2.1万女性队列：饱和脂肪升高LDL的效应受多基因风险评分调控
