    Researchers identified DHRS7 as the gene encoding the 5-oxoETE synthase and OXER1 as its receptor, showing that this classic immune-cell recruiting alarm also shields neighbouring healthy cells from the chemical stress of the immune response, via NUDIX hydrolases. Blocking the pathway worsens inflammation, and low intestinal 5-oxoETE in IBD tracks with poorer outcomes.
  • 每日两个绿心猕猴桃：功能性便秘与便秘型肠易激的「低负担」膳食选项
    Two green kiwifruit a day: a low-burden dietary option for functional constipation and IBS-C
    综述梳理猕猴桃干预功能性便秘与便秘型肠易激综合征的机制与临床证据：最一致的方案是每日两个新鲜绿心猕猴桃、持续约 4 周，对排便次数与粪便性状的改善与车前子、西梅大致相当，且耐受性良好。作者强调证据以绿心鲜果最强，粉剂与提取物不可假定临床等效。
    A review of mechanisms and clinical evidence for kiwifruit in functional constipation and IBS-C finds the most consistent regimen is two fresh green kiwifruit daily for about four weeks, improving bowel frequency and stool form comparably to psyllium or prunes with good tolerability. Evidence is strongest for fresh green fruit; powders and extracts should not be assumed equivalent.
  • 第四届功能医学行业论坛 11 月 21–22 日落地上海，九大专题聚焦临床与长寿
    Fourth Functional Medicine Industry Forum lands in Shanghai on Nov 21-22 with nine themed tracks
    FMC 2026 第四届功能医学行业论坛定于 11 月 21–22 日在上海富悦大酒店举办，由 FMC 功能医学教育平台组织，会期两天、九大专题论坛并行，覆盖功能医学与慢性疾病、个性化营养、抗衰老与长寿医学、长寿诊所运营等方向，并设临床案例大赛与专题工作坊。
    FMC 2026, the fourth Functional Medicine Industry Forum, runs Nov 21-22 at Shanghai Fuyue Hotel, organised by the FMC functional medicine education platform, with nine parallel tracks spanning functional medicine and chronic disease, personalised nutrition, anti-ageing and longevity medicine, and longevity clinic operations, plus a clinical case competition and workshops.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 《自然-代谢》：全血 NAD 不随年龄下降，为抗衰而补 NMN 缺乏依据
    Nature Metabolism: whole-blood NAD does not fall with age, leaving little basis for NMN for longevity
    立陶宛团队对 1068 人完成 1340 次全血 NAD 检测，发现健康人 NAD 不随年龄下降，但心血管疾病与高血压患者显著下降。每日口服 1000 mg NMN 可把 NAD 从约 19–20 μM 推高到 51–56 μM，半衰期 3.2–4.3 天，远超生理范围，长期安全性未知。
    A Lithuanian team ran 1,340 whole-blood NAD measurements in 1,068 adults and found NAD does not fall with age in healthy people (flat in men, rising slightly in women), yet declines markedly in cardiovascular disease and hypertension. Daily 1,000 mg NMN raised NAD from about 19-20 microM to 51-56 microM with a 3.2-4.3 day half-life, far above physiological range, with unknown long-term safety.
  • 长寿（抗衰老）生物医学张江论坛：抗衰目标是延长健康寿命，不是拉长生存年限
    Zhangjiang longevity biomedicine forum: the goal is healthspan, not merely longer survival
    论坛 10 月 31 日在上海科技大学举办，为该主题首次落地张江。清华大学王钊从进化生物学角度指出，遗传只是衰老影响因素之一，生活方式与环境可有效调控进程；与会专家围绕本土人群甲基化衰老时钟、基因重编程、中医体质分型与「未病先防」展开讨论，倡导个体化全周期健康管理。
    Held Oct 31 at ShanghaiTech University and the first of its kind in Zhangjiang, the forum heard Tsinghua's Wang Zhao argue from evolutionary biology that genes are only one ageing factor while lifestyle and environment can modulate the process. Experts discussed methylation clocks for Chinese populations, gene reprogramming, TCM constitution typing and individualised whole-lifecycle health management.
  • 中国营养学会联合中国疾控中心研讨健康长寿：膳食营养在高龄阶段更关键
    Chinese Nutrition Society and China CDC forum finds diet matters most at advanced ages
    中国营养学会与中国疾控中心在京召开健康长寿研究专题研讨会，施小明团队报告高龄老年人健康评价与促进研究：血压、血脂、体质指数与死亡风险和认知功能的关联需结合年龄与功能状态解读；休闲活动在较年轻老年人中作用突出，膳食营养在高龄阶段更为关键，并已开发认知障碍风险评估工具。
    At a Beijing symposium co-hosted by the Chinese Nutrition Society and China CDC, Shi Xiaoming's team reported that links between blood pressure, lipids, BMI and mortality or cognition must be read alongside age and functional status; leisure activity matters most in the younger-old and diet in the oldest-old. A cognitive impairment risk tool was also released.
  • Elysium 借 HHS 新政策扩供六种肽类，并启动肽类表观遗传研究
    Elysium expands access to six peptides under a new HHS policy and launches peptide epigenetics research
    美国 HHS 发布临时执法裁量政策，允许在厂家资质、产品检测、患者个体处方与不良事件报告条件下有限配制 BPC-157、Epitalon、KPV、MOTS-c、Semax 与 TB-500。Elysium 宣布经处方渠道提供这六种肽，并推出 PEER 科研供应计划与 TIME-PEP 表观遗传研究。
    A new HHS interim enforcement-discretion policy permits limited compounding of BPC-157, Epitalon, KPV, MOTS-c, Semax and TB-500 subject to manufacturer qualification, product testing, patient-specific prescriptions and adverse-event reporting. Elysium will offer the six peptides through its prescription channel and launched the PEER research-supply programme and the TIME-PEP epigenetic study.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 《自然-医学》：两条方向相反的菌群通路，把生活方式与慢病风险连了起来
    Nature Medicine: two opposing microbiome axes link lifestyle to health and chronic disease
    研究整合日本人群多组学与中介分析，刻画饮食、饮酒等可改变生活方式如何经肠道菌群影响健康与疾病风险：膳食纤维、豆类、发酵食品与咖啡指向产丁酸菌，精制糖则富集口腔来源菌与乳酸产生菌并伴随促炎特征。据此构建的 MADE 评分可区分健康与多种疾病，并在外部人群获得验证。
    Integrating multi-omics and mediation analysis in a Japanese cohort, the study maps how modifiable behaviours such as diet and alcohol act through the gut microbiome: fibre, legumes, fermented foods and coffee track with butyrate producers, while refined sugar enriches oral-derived and lactic-acid bacteria alongside pro-inflammatory signatures. The derived MADE scores separated health from multiple diseases and validated externally.
  • 进博会：华大把测序底座、智能健康终端与「益人益方」个性化营养一起摆上展台
    At CIIE, BGI pairs sequencing infrastructure with a smart health terminal and personalised nutrition
    第九届进博会上，华大集团展出覆盖测序装备、智能健康体系与精准健康消费品的完整矩阵，智能健康终端「i³智舱」入选中国馆；华大智造呈现全读长测序、智能自动化与多组学「底层基座」，华大营养则推出「益人益方」个性化肠道健康方案与个性化营养素，把多组学落到日常健康消费。
    At the ninth CIIE, BGI Group showed a full matrix from sequencing hardware to smart health systems and precision consumer products, with its i-cubed smart health cabin selected for the China Pavilion. MGI presented all-read-length sequencing, lab automation and multi-omics infrastructure, while BGI Nutrition launched the Yirenyifang personalised gut-health and nutrient programmes.
  • 青岛大学李铎团队：低嘌呤限能量平衡膳食 42 天，痛风患者尿酸达标率升至 71%
    Qingdao University trial: 42 days of a low-purine, energy-restricted diet lifts urate target attainment to 71%
    90 名男性痛风患者随机对照试验显示，在常规健康教育之上叠加 42 天低嘌呤限能量平衡膳食，血尿酸较基线下降 112.4 μmol/L（对照组 47.0），尿酸排泄分数提高 0.87%，达标率由 11.1% 升至 71.1%（对照组 40%），红肉、甜点与烹调油摄入减少，蔬菜、鸡蛋与乳制品增加。
    In a 90-patient randomised trial, 42 days of a structured low-purine, energy-restricted balanced diet on top of standard education lowered serum urate by 112.4 micromol/L versus 47.0 in controls, raised fractional urate excretion by 0.87 percentage points and lifted target attainment from 11.1% to 71.1% (controls 40%), with less red meat, dessert and cooking oil and more vegetables, eggs and dairy.
  • 抗性淀粉益生元复现试验：双歧杆菌方向对上了，Akkermansia 主要终点没达标
    Resistant starch prebiotic replication: Bifidobacterium direction holds, Akkermansia endpoint missed
    Solnul 抗性马铃薯淀粉开展 4 周随机双盲安慰剂对照复现试验，74 名健康成人每日 3.5 g：符合方案集分析中双歧杆菌增幅优于安慰剂，但扩大分析人群后差异不显著；Akkermansia 较基线升高却未显著优于安慰剂，主要终点未达。胃肠道耐受性良好，无严重不良事件。
    A four-week randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled replication of Solnul resistant potato starch gave 74 healthy adults 3.5 g daily: Bifidobacterium rose more than placebo in the per-protocol set but not in the broader population, and Akkermansia increased from baseline without beating placebo, missing the primary endpoint. Gastrointestinal tolerability was good, with no serious adverse events.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 复合抗衰补剂随机对照：六个月收缩压低 6.1 mmHg、脉搏波速度降 1.18 m/s
    Multi-target longevity supplement RCT: systolic pressure 6.1 mmHg lower, pulse wave velocity down 1.18 m/s
    萨里大学主导的 STAMINA 试验纳入 61 名健康成人，33 人每日服用含维生素、矿物质、氨基酸与植物活性物的复合配方，28 人服安慰剂六个月。结果显示血流介导舒张改善（首剂一小时内即出现）、收缩压较对照低 6.1 mmHg、脉搏波速度低 1.18 m/s，血脂无变化；样本量小，属概念验证。
    The Surrey-led STAMINA trial gave 33 of 61 healthy adults a multivitamin, mineral, amino acid and plant-bioactive blend and 28 a placebo for six months. Flow-mediated dilation improved, detectable within an hour of the first dose, systolic pressure was 6.1 mmHg lower and pulse wave velocity 1.18 m/s lower than control, with no lipid change. Small and proof-of-concept only.
  • 肌酸正在离开健身房：新品增速 62%，剂型溢价把每公斤价格推到四倍
    Creatine leaves the gym: launches up 62% as premium formats quadruple the price per kilo
    Innova 数据显示 2022–2025 年肌酸增速为整体补剂市场三倍，2026 年 1–8 月含肌酸新品同比增 62%，健身房之外场景的新品增幅达 194.7%。价格分层：原味粉每公斤 73 欧元，调味粉 83 欧元，加生物活性物的「肌酸+」222 欧元，软糖、咀嚼片等剂型 275 欧元。
    Innova data show creatine grew at three times the wider supplement market in 2022-2025, with launches containing it up 62% year on year in January-August 2026 and non-gym launches up 194.7%. Pricing is highly tiered: a median 73 euros per kilo for plain powder, 83 flavoured, 222 for creatine-plus with bioactives and 275 for gummies, chews and bars.
  • 辣椒素补剂首个注册人体试验：超重中老年人脑血流反应性与认知改善
    First registered human trial of a capsaicin supplement: better cerebrovascular responsiveness and cognition in overweight older adults
    南昆士兰大学团队评估印度 Akay Bioactives 的辣椒素原料 Capsifen 对超重或肥胖中老年人脑血管功能与认知的影响，发现补充组总脑血管反应性升高，反映神经元代谢需求增加时脑血流调配能力增强。作者称这是初步证据，机制涉及一氧化氮可用性、氧化应激与炎症。
    University of Southern Queensland researchers tested Akay Bioactives' Capsifen in overweight or obese middle-aged and older adults, finding total cerebrovascular responsiveness rose in the supplement group, reflecting better blood-flow matching to neuronal metabolic demand. The authors call it preliminary evidence, with nitric oxide availability, oxidative stress and inflammation as mechanisms.
  • 国产 AKK 菌原料摘得北美 NIE 原料大奖，90 天试验甘油三酯降 21%
    Chinese Akkermansia ingredient wins a North American NIE award, with triglycerides down 21% at 90 days
    据 NIE 公布资料，AKK001 相关研究为 90 天、60 名超重或肥胖受试者的随机安慰剂对照试验，采用 AKK001 与三丁酸甘油酯复配的落地方案，体重、体脂率、腰围及多项代谢指标向好，甘油三酯 12 周下降 21%。报道同时提示，联合干预结果不能简单归因于单一菌株，仍需更多验证。
    According to NIE materials, the AKK001 study was a 90-day randomised placebo-controlled trial in 60 overweight or obese participants using a combination of AKK001 and tributyrin; weight, body-fat percentage, waist circumference and several metabolic markers improved, with triglycerides down 21% at 12 weeks. The report cautions that combination results cannot be credited to a single strain.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 山西「十五五」卫生健康划出五个推动：县级慢病管理中心实体化、财政投 6 亿
    Shanxi's 15th Five-Year health plan: county chronic-disease centres and RMB 600 million for county medical communities
    山西省卫健委发布会提出「五个推动」：依托县级医疗集团实体化建设慢病管理中心，实行「专科医师+全科医师+公卫医师」三师共管与「医师+药师+护士」三岗联动；省财政投入 6 亿元分两批支持 30 个县实施紧密型县域医共体升级版，首批 15 个县已由副县长兼任中心主任。
    Shanxi's health commission outlined five pushes: building chronic-disease centres inside county medical groups with a three-physician, three-role care model; and 600 million yuan in provincial funding for 30 counties to upgrade tight county medical communities, with the first 15 counties already chaired by vice-county heads.
  • 浙江 361 家机构开设体重管理门诊，11 市 38 县成立健康体重指导中心
    Zhejiang: 361 hospitals run weight-management clinics, with guidance centres in 11 cities and 38 counties
    浙江将体重管理纳入健康浙江行动，十五部门联合出台「体重管理年」实施方案，已推动 11 个设区市和 38 个县（市、区）成立健康体重指导中心，全省 361 家医疗机构提供体重管理门诊，普遍采用内分泌、营养、运动、心理多学科模式，构建「筛查—干预—随访」链条；中医治未病科设置率达 100%。
    Zhejiang has folded weight management into Healthy Zhejiang, with 15 departments issuing a weight-management year plan. Guidance centres now exist in 11 cities and 38 counties, and 361 hospitals offer weight clinics using multidisciplinary endocrine, nutrition, exercise and psychology teams along a screen-intervene-follow-up chain; TCM preventive-care units reach 100% of public TCM hospitals.
  • 辉瑞计划两年内助建 500 家医院体重管理门诊，重点下沉县域
    Pfizer to help build weight-management clinics in 500 hospitals over two years, focused on county-level care
    辉瑞中国计划 2026 年下半年至 2027 年在全国协助落实 500 家医院体重健康管理门诊，并重点打造 100 家标杆。其广阔市场事业部观察到，一线城市减重多指向外形与幸福感，县域人群则多在出现功能性障碍后才就诊，存在明显时间差；企业将配合主管部门为县域医护提供系统培训。
    Pfizer China plans to help set up weight-management clinics in 500 hospitals between late 2026 and 2027, with 100 developed as benchmarks. Its broader-market unit notes that in tier-1 cities weight loss is driven by appearance and wellbeing, while county patients usually present only after functional problems appear, a dangerous time lag. Training for county clinicians is part of the plan.
  • 国家医保局：支持基层为慢病患者开长期处方，推进处方流转与用药衔接
    National Healthcare Security Administration backs long prescriptions for chronic disease at primary care
    国家医保局明确支持基层为符合条件的慢性病患者开具长期处方，健全医共体内药品采购、配送、使用一体化管理，推进处方规范流转和用药衔接。地方层面，苏州允许符合条件的社区卫生服务中心与养老机构内设医疗机构不受规划数量限制纳入医保定点，杭州要求每个街道或乡镇至少有一家一级及以下定点机构。
    The NHSA explicitly backs long prescriptions for eligible chronic-disease patients in primary care, integrated drug procurement, delivery and use within medical communities, and orderly prescription circulation. Locally, Suzhou exempts qualifying community health centres and elderly-care facilities from planning quotas for insurance designation, while Hangzhou requires at least one tier-1-or-lower designated provider per subdistrict or township.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-11-05
item.description: 2026-11-05 简报，共 20 条：《自然》：1280 万个肠菌单碱基变异绘出健康关联图景；肠道菌产的甘氨酸脂质经门静脉与淋巴入体，改善肝与肌肉线粒体；口服纳米疫苗入肠，精准狙击结肠炎致病菌；仿生凝聚体递送线粒体，恢复结肠炎肠上皮能量稳态；九州大学把肌肉修复因子改造成「超级 HGF」，抵抗衰老性硝化损伤；视网膜 AI 指标 RetiME 把死亡风险变成可追踪的个体轨迹；长寿补剂卖不动机制：消费者不关心 NAD+、去乙酰化酶与端粒长度；辽宁老年健康管理年会：从点状突破到韧性驱动的长寿医学；《自然综述·微生物学》：同样的益生元，为何有人肠道不买单；牛津跨国队列：纯素食者大肠癌风险不降反升，鱼素者表现最好；基层营养门诊 N-RCSP 共识发表：五师共管打通筛查到随访闭环；北部湾临床营养培训班：把营养筛查与干预做进全流程；日本 42 天试验：NMN 及复方对心肺与认知无统计学获益；每周 100 微克 calcifediol：四周内近七成维生素 D 缺乏女性达标；《中国营养品行业创新发展研究报告（2026）》发布：电商占近半，循证与标准仍是短板；21 金维他被指制造儿童成长焦虑：普通食品越界宣称保健功效；山东发布卫生健康十五五规划：人均预期寿命 81.7 岁，2030 年过早死亡率降至 10% 以下；宁波社区减重门诊一年减掉 513.9 公斤，以小投入撬动慢病关口前移；深圳罗湖把精准运动与功能康复嵌进家庭医生签约包；南京秦虹社区医院体重管理门诊：680 人签约，慢病患者占九成
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 《自然》：1280 万个肠菌单碱基变异绘出健康关联图景
    Nature: 12.8 Million Gut Microbial SNVs Mapped to Health and Exposures
    荷兰格罗宁根大学傅静远团队 11 月 4 日在《自然》发表微生物组范围 PheWAS，整合荷兰与坦桑尼亚六队列、10781 人的粪便宏基因组，检测约 1280 万个常见肠菌单核苷酸变异，锁定 940 个独立信号，覆盖 101 种细菌与 69 项健康表型及环境暴露，并借蛋白结构把关联推进到氨基酸位点。
    Fu Jingyuan's team at UMC Groningen published a microbiome-wide PheWAS in Nature on Nov 4, pooling six Dutch and Tanzanian cohorts (10,781 people, 11,831 metagenomes) to test roughly 12.8 million common gut microbial SNVs against 244 phenotypes and exposures. They identified 940 independent signals across 101 species and 69 traits, then used protein structures to push associations down to specific amino acid sites.
  • 肠道菌产的甘氨酸脂质经门静脉与淋巴入体，改善肝与肌肉线粒体
    Microbial Glycine Lipids Reach the Body via Portal Vein and Lymph, Improving Liver and Muscle Mitochondria
    康涅狄格大学团队追踪肠道菌产生的甘氨酸脂质 L1256 与 L654，用质谱在门静脉血与肠淋巴中同时检出，证实其经两条途径吸收并见于人肝组织。8 周西方饮食雄鼠中，L1256 富集于骨骼肌，改善脂肪酸支持的线粒体呼吸，上调能量代谢与抗氧化蛋白并保住肌纤维横径；L654 仅影响炎症信号。
    A UConn team tracked two microbial glycine lipids, L1256 and L654, detecting both in portal blood and intestinal lymph by mass spectrometry, confirming two absorption routes and presence in human liver tissue. In male mice fed a Western diet for eight weeks, L1256 accumulated in skeletal muscle, improved fatty-acid-supported mitochondrial respiration, raised energy-production and antioxidant proteins and preserved fibre size, while L654 only shifted inflammatory signalling.
  • 口服纳米疫苗入肠，精准狙击结肠炎致病菌
    An Oral Nanovaccine That Targets the Colitis-Driving Pathobiont
    山东第一医科大学附属一院李鑫团队发现 Ruminococcus gnavus 在溃疡性结肠炎患者肠道显著富集，且与病情严重度正相关，菌群移植与单菌定植均加重肠损伤。团队以该菌外囊泡为抗原，包覆聚多巴胺、二氧化铈纳米酶与碳酸钙壳，制成口服微粒 CP-EV@Ca，经分泌型 IgA 把致病菌挤出生态位。
    Li Xin's team at the First Affiliated Hospital of Shandong First Medical University found Ruminococcus gnavus enriched in ulcerative colitis patients and correlated with severity and oxidative stress, with faecal transplant and mono-colonisation both worsening injury. They built an oral microparticle, CP-EV@Ca, using the bacterium's outer vesicles as antigen plus polydopamine, a cerium oxide nanozyme and a calcium carbonate shell, driving secretory IgA to push the pathobiont out of its niche.
  • 仿生凝聚体递送线粒体，恢复结肠炎肠上皮能量稳态
    Biomimetic Condensates Deliver Mitochondria to Restore Epithelial Energy Balance
    温州医科大学徐荷林团队构建仿生凝聚体 HTP@Mito，将外源线粒体递送至结肠炎肠上皮。治疗后结肠 ATP 接近健康水平，膜电位与 COX IV 回升，MDA 下降而 SOD、GSH 增强；Claudin-5、Occludin 与黏液层同步修复，自噬通量重启，毛螺菌科增加、埃希氏-志贺氏菌受抑。
    Xu Helin's team at Wenzhou Medical University built a biomimetic condensate, HTP@Mito, to deliver exogenous mitochondria into inflamed colonic epithelium. Treated mice recovered colonic ATP to near-healthy levels, with restored membrane potential and COX IV, lower MDA and higher SOD and GSH. Claudin-5, occludin and the mucus layer were repaired, mitophagy flux restarted, Lachnospiraceae rose and Escherichia-Shigella was suppressed.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 九州大学把肌肉修复因子改造成「超级 HGF」，抵抗衰老性硝化损伤
    Kyushu University Turns Muscle Repair Factor Into Super HGF That Resists Age-Related Nitration
    九州大学辰巳隆一团队在《科学报告》报道，三硫化合物 LASSS 与肝细胞生长因子 HGF 按 1:8000 摩尔比混合，可使其与 c-met 受体结合力提升一倍以上并抵抗硝化失活，形成超级 HGF。尾悬吊小鼠预先给予 LASSS 显著减少 HGF 硝化，但未证明能恢复肌力或肌肉量，仍需老年动物实验。
    Ryuichi Tatsumi's group at Kyushu University reported in Scientific Reports that mixing the trisulfide LASSS with hepatocyte growth factor at a 1:8000 molar ratio more than doubled binding to the c-met receptor and protected the protein from nitration-driven inactivation, yielding a so-called Super HGF. In tail-suspended mice, pre-treatment with LASSS cut HGF nitration, though restoration of muscle mass or strength remains unproven and aged-animal studies are still needed.
  • 视网膜 AI 指标 RetiME 把死亡风险变成可追踪的个体轨迹
    Retinal AI Metric RetiME Turns Mortality Risk Into a Trackable Individual Trajectory
    《自然·生物医学工程》新论文提出个体化寿命轨迹建模，不再只估算某一时点的死亡概率，而是刻画风险随年龄变化的轨迹及相对一般人群的时间偏移。配套的 RetiME 用眼底照片做深度学习，与全因死亡、特定原因死亡及未来疾病风险相关，并能区分癌症、心血管代谢与神经退行性疾病的不同风险轨迹。
    A new Nature Biomedical Engineering paper models individual lifespan trajectories rather than a single-point mortality probability, describing how risk shifts with age and how far it deviates from the population. The companion RetiME metric applies deep learning to fundus photographs and is associated with all-cause and cause-specific mortality plus future disease risk, distinguishing trajectories for cancer, cardiometabolic and neurodegenerative disease.
  • 长寿补剂卖不动机制：消费者不关心 NAD+、去乙酰化酶与端粒长度
    Longevity Supplements Miss the Mark: Consumers Do Not Care About NAD+, Sirtuins or Telomere Length
    在波兰一场营养食品会议上，Holland & Barrett 全球配方负责人 Alex Glover 表示，50 岁以上消费者并不关心 NAD+ 水平、去乙酰化酶或端粒长度，只关心能否无痛起身、陪孙辈玩耍；1000 名消费者被问何谓细胞健康，答案离散。该零售商因此按可感知功效而非成分机制立项。
    At the Remedy Nutrafood CDMO conference in Gdansk, Holland & Barrett global formulation lead Alex Glover said consumers over 50 do not care about NAD+ levels, whether their sirtuins are scavenging or how long their telomeres are, only about rising from a chair without pain or playing with grandchildren. Asked to define cellular health, 1,000 shoppers gave wildly divergent answers, so new products are now built around felt benefits rather than mechanisms.
  • 辽宁老年健康管理年会：从点状突破到韧性驱动的长寿医学
    Liaoning Geriatric Health Meeting: From Isolated Pilots to Resilience-Driven Longevity Care
    辽宁省老年医学学会健康管理专委会第三次学术年会在沈阳召开，主题为韧性驱动的健康长寿。主委张海燕提出把各机构零散实践连成一张可复制、可核验的区域性公共产品网络，并给出红黄绿灯分层干预框架：运动、营养、睡眠是所有人都要守好的第一层，干细胞、NAD+ 等前沿手段须严守证据与监管边界。
    The third annual meeting of the Liaoning Geriatric Society's health management committee in Shenyang took resilience-driven healthy longevity as its theme. Chair Zhang Haiyan argued for linking scattered institutional pilots into a replicable, verifiable regional public product and presented a traffic-light tiered framework: exercise, nutrition and sleep form the first layer everyone must secure, while stem cells and NAD+ must stay within evidence and regulatory limits.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 《自然综述·微生物学》：同样的益生元，为何有人肠道不买单
    Nature Reviews Microbiology: Why the Same Prebiotic Fibre Works for Some and Not Others
    内布拉斯加大学林肯分校与普渡大学团队系统拆解益生元纤维的应答者与非应答者之谜：基线降解菌丰度、碳水化合物活性酶与多糖利用位点决定纤维能否被拆解，交叉喂养网络、肠腔 pH 与宿主 FUT2 基因共同塑造代谢表型；文章提出用机器学习与群落代谢模型预测个体产短链脂肪酸倾向。
    A review from Nebraska-Lincoln and Purdue dissects why prebiotic fibres work for some people and not others: baseline degrader abundance, carbohydrate-active enzymes and polysaccharide utilisation loci determine whether a fibre can be broken down, while cross-feeding networks, luminal pH and host FUT2 shape the metabolic phenotype. The authors propose machine learning and community-scale metabolic models to predict short-chain fatty acid output, plus highly specific fibres and targeted synbiotics to improve response consistency.
  • 牛津跨国队列：纯素食者大肠癌风险不降反升，鱼素者表现最好
    Oxford Cohort: Vegans Show Higher Colorectal Cancer Risk, Pescatarians Fare Best
    星岛环球网引述牛津大学 2026 年一项跨国世代研究，完全不吃动物性食物的纯素者大肠癌风险反而高于一般肉食者与蛋奶素者，推测与缺少乳制品来源的钙和维生素 D、B12 不足有关；只吃鱼的鱼素者风险最低。专家建议纯素者强化钙、维生素 D 与 B12，并少吃高油高盐的超加工素肉。
    Citing a 2026 Oxford multinational cohort study, Sing Tao Global Net reports that vegans who avoid all animal foods have higher colorectal cancer risk than regular meat eaters or lacto-ovo vegetarians, likely linked to missing dairy-derived calcium and vitamin D plus insufficient B12 and trace minerals. Pescatarians who eat fish but no red or processed meat had the lowest risk; vegans are advised to secure calcium, vitamin D and B12 and limit high-fat, high-salt processed meat analogues.
  • 基层营养门诊 N-RCSP 共识发表：五师共管打通筛查到随访闭环
    N-RCSP Consensus Published for Community Nutrition Clinics With a Five-Professional Closed Loop
    广东省基层卫生协会精准营养应用分会牵头、陈骁熠团队执笔的《基层营养门诊建设与 N-RCSP 精准营养健康管理专家共识》在《中国全科医学》发表。N-RCSP 以营养为核心，融合功能康复、中医食疗与经络、运动、心理五维，构建筛查、评估、干预、监测、随访的数字化闭环，已在广州番禺洛浦街社区落地。
    A consensus led by Chen Xiaoyi for the Guangdong Primary Care Association's precision nutrition branch has been published in the Chinese Journal of General Practice. The N-RCSP model centres on nutrition and integrates functional rehabilitation, TCM diet therapy and meridians, exercise and psychology into a digital closed loop of screening, assessment, intervention, monitoring and follow-up, already piloted at a community health centre in Guangzhou's Panyu district.
  • 北部湾临床营养培训班：把营养筛查与干预做进全流程
    Beibu Gulf Clinical Nutrition Training Embeds Screening and Intervention Across the Care Pathway
    钦州市第二人民医院承办的 2026 年北部湾临床营养诊疗技术及体重管理规范化培训班完成，课程覆盖营养预康复的代谢基础与争议、胃肠肿瘤围手术期营养管理、肥胖合并代谢紊乱的医学营养干预难点、老年肌少症从循证到临床、以及体重管理门诊的现实困境与规范建设路径，指向入院、干预、出院随访的闭环管理。
    Qinzhou Second People's Hospital hosted the 2026 Beibu Gulf training on clinical nutrition and standardised weight management. Sessions covered the metabolic basis and controversies of nutritional prehabilitation, perioperative nutrition in gastrointestinal cancer, medical nutrition therapy for obesity with metabolic disorders, evidence-to-practice nutrition in sarcopenia, and the operational realities of weight management clinics, all pointing to a closed loop from admission through discharge follow-up.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 日本 42 天试验：NMN 及复方对心肺与认知无统计学获益
    Japan Trial: NMN and Multi-Ingredient Formulas Show No Significant Cardiopulmonary or Cognitive Benefit
    日本安部养生研究所与日本医科大学医院在《营养素》发表 42 天四臂开放标签试验，42 名 45 至 65 岁受试者每日饮用含 NMN，或 NMN 复配人参皂苷、D-BHB、小檗碱、PQQ、辅酶 Q10、亚精胺的饮料。心肺与认知主要终点均无统计学差异，八成分组记忆改善不显著，表观遗传时钟亦未逆转。
    Abe Yoan Aging Research Institute and Nippon Medical School Hospital published a 42-day open-label four-arm trial in Nutrients: 42 healthy adults aged 45 to 65 drank a daily beverage containing NMN, or NMN plus ginsenosides, D-BHB, berberine, PQQ, CoQ10, resveratrol and spermidine. Neither cardiopulmonary nor cognitive primary endpoints differed significantly; memory trended better on the eight-ingredient arm but not significantly, and DNAm PhenoAge changes fell short of biological age reversal.
  • 每周 100 微克 calcifediol：四周内近七成维生素 D 缺乏女性达标
    Weekly 100 mcg Calcifediol Brings Nearly 70 Percent of Vitamin D-Deficient Women to Target in Four Weeks
    《营养素》52 周双盲试验（Faes Farma 资助）纳入 261 名维生素 D 缺乏女性，每周口服 100 微克 calcifediol 或安慰剂：第 4 周 68.2% 升至 20 ng/mL 以上，安慰剂组仅 5.8%；第 16 周逾 93% 达标，且不受 BMI 与绝经状态影响。
    A 52-week randomised double-blind trial funded by Spain's Faes Farma and published in Nutrients enrolled 261 vitamin D-deficient women given 100 mcg calcifediol weekly or placebo. By week 4, 68.2 percent of treated women reached at least 20 ng/mL versus 5.8 percent on placebo; beyond week 16 more than 93 percent stayed at target, mean levels rose from 12.21 to 39.47 ng/mL, and responses were consistent across BMI and menopausal status.
  • 《中国营养品行业创新发展研究报告（2026）》发布：电商占近半，循证与标准仍是短板
    China Nutrition Industry Innovation Report 2026: E-commerce Nears Half of Sales, Evidence and Standards Lag
    市场监管总局发展研究中心发布《中国营养品行业创新发展研究报告（2026）》，指渠道已由药店商超转向电商，2025 年上半年膳食营养补充剂电商销售额达 622 亿元，占整体近半。并点出标准滞后、循证薄弱、线上擦边营销与贴牌同质化等痛点，提出以合成生物学、智能递送与多组学 AI 驱动个性化精准营养。
    The State Administration for Market Regulation's development research centre released its 2026 China nutrition industry innovation report in Beijing, noting a shift from pharmacies and supermarkets to e-commerce, where dietary supplement sales reached 62.2 billion yuan in the first half of 2025, nearly half the market. It flags lagging classification standards, thin human evidence, borderline online marketing and copycat contract manufacturing, and points to synthetic biology, smart delivery and multi-omics AI as drivers of personalised nutrition.
  • 21 金维他被指制造儿童成长焦虑：普通食品越界宣称保健功效
    21 JINWEITA Accused of Marketing Growth Anxiety as Ordinary Food Claims Health Benefits
    速豹新闻网调查显示，21 金维他把法定适宜人群为运动人群的运动营养食品面向普通儿童推广，并搭配文献罗列营养缺口；含 γ-氨基丁酸的产品被暗示可增高，而证据仅支持镇静、抗焦虑与助眠。专家指出场景化软暗示足以构成违法，角落免责声明无法抵消整体图文效果，蓝帽子产品超范围宣称同样涉夸大宣传。
    An investigation by Subao News finds that 21 JINWEITA markets sports nutrition food, legally intended for athletes, to ordinary children while citing literature on nutrient gaps; its gamma-aminobutyric acid product implies height gain, though evidence only supports sedation, anxiolysis and sleep improvement. Experts say contextual soft hints alone can constitute illegal advertising and that a corner disclaimer cannot offset the overall message, while approved products claiming beyond their scope also risk exaggeration.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 山东发布卫生健康十五五规划：人均预期寿命 81.7 岁，2030 年过早死亡率降至 10% 以下
    Shandong 15th Five-Year Health Plan Targets 81.7-Year Life Expectancy and Premature Mortality Below 10 Percent by 2030
    山东省 11 月 5 日发布卫生健康十五五规划，提出人均预期寿命达 81.7 岁，2030 年重大慢性病过早死亡率降至 10% 以下。规划要求开展医院—社区—家庭连续营养服务与健康体重管理行动，鼓励医院设运动健康指导门诊、基层设生活方式干预门诊，建设一站式慢性病健康管理中心。
    Shandong released its 15th Five-Year health plan on Nov 5, targeting life expectancy of 81.7 years and premature mortality from major chronic diseases below 10 percent by 2030. It calls for hospital-community-home continuous nutrition services and a healthy weight programme, encourages exercise-health clinics in hospitals and lifestyle-intervention clinics in primary care, and pushes one-stop chronic disease centres covering prevention, screening, treatment, rehabilitation and management.
  • 宁波社区减重门诊一年减掉 513.9 公斤，以小投入撬动慢病关口前移
    Ningbo Community Weight Clinics Shed 513.9 kg in a Year, Shifting Chronic Disease Prevention Upstream
    宁波日报评论披露，鄞州区钱湖医院减重门诊今年 1 至 10 月接诊超 1100 人次，全年预计破 1600 人次，较去年增长约 5 倍，开设一年多累计减重 513.9 公斤；北仑戚家山街道社区卫生服务中心同类门诊自 2023 年 10 月起管理 1287 人，人均减重 7%。
    A Ningbo Daily commentary reports that Qianhu Hospital's weight clinic in Yinzhou saw over 1,100 visits from January to October, heading for 1,600 this year, roughly five times last year, with 513.9 kg lost since it opened; the Qijiashan community health centre has managed 1,287 people since October 2023 with an average 7 percent weight loss. The paper argues such clinics shift chronic disease prevention upstream at low cost.
  • 深圳罗湖把精准运动与功能康复嵌进家庭医生签约包
    Shenzhen Luohu Embeds Precision Exercise and Functional Rehabilitation Into Family Doctor Packages
    钮曼医疗与深圳罗湖医院集团签署协议，共建家庭医生精准运动与功能康复技术支撑平台，把功能健康评估、运动风险分层、个体化运动处方、心肺与神经肌骨康复、数字化随访嵌入家庭医生签约服务包，覆盖控糖、体重管理、银发健康与儿童生长发育，试图破解运动处方开得出、社区接不住、居民难执行的难题。
    Niuman Medical and the Shenzhen Luohu Hospital Group signed an agreement to build a technical platform embedding functional health assessment, exercise risk stratification, individualised prescriptions, cardiopulmonary and neuromuscular rehabilitation and digital follow-up into family doctor service packages. Covering glucose control, weight management, senior health and child growth, it targets the gap where hospitals can prescribe exercise but communities cannot deliver and residents do not adhere.
  • 南京秦虹社区医院体重管理门诊：680 人签约，慢病患者占九成
    Nanjing Qinhong Community Weight Clinic Enrols 680 Residents, 91 Percent With Chronic Disease
    南京晨报报道，秦淮区秦虹社区卫生服务中心打造健康体重管理门诊，已有 680 名居民签约，其中慢病患者占 91%，居民体重、内脏脂肪与糖脂指标稳步改善，辖区慢病新发增长放缓。中心以筛查同步宣教、流程简化、上门随访、多网点就近服务提升可及性，下一步推进全域筛查与老年肥胖合并肌少症管理。
    Nanjing Morning Post reports the Qinhong community health centre in Qinhuai district has enrolled 680 residents in its weight management package, 91 percent with chronic disease, with steady gains in weight, visceral fat and glycaemic and lipid markers and slower growth in new chronic cases locally. Screening paired with education, simplified processes, home visits and satellite sites drive uptake; next come district-wide screening and dedicated care for obesity with sarcopenia.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-11-04
item.description: 2026-11-04 简报，共 20 条：《细胞》：5981 株菌基因组揭示，工业化正驱动肠道菌趋同进化；协和朱兰团队《自然·医学》：绝经激素治疗应答由肠道与阴道菌群分型决定；700 例粪便宏基因组：肠道四界微生物可无创筛查胆管癌，平均 AUC 达 91%；20 项 RCT 荟萃：益生菌改善健康成人抑郁与睡眠，对焦虑无显著作用；《细胞》：补充 DGLA 把衰老细胞推向铁死亡，开辟高选择性 senolytic 新路径；成年期去势使雄鼠寿命延长约 33%，推翻越早手术越好的旧观点；华西 NKG2D-CAR-T 抗衰技术作价入股，衰老疫苗进入产业化通道；雄性小鼠中年更早丧失抗癌免疫：胸腺萎缩让 naive T 细胞储备先耗尽；每天一个牛油果加一杯芒果，8 周改善糖尿病前期者血管功能；老来瘦未必好：专家给出肌少症蛋白质处方，1.2–1.5 g/kg 并三餐均分；拉萨市人民医院营养门诊开诊：按高原特点做个体化营养治疗；株洲三三一医院把营养处方开进食堂与家庭：300 余人人均减重 21 斤；白藜芦醇＋槲皮素＋姜黄素复方 2a 期：黄斑区玻璃膜疣体积降 13.4%；Holland & Barrett 发布 2027 六大趋势：从量化自我转向神经系统调节；市场监管总局发展研究中心发布《中国营养品行业创新发展研究报告（2026）》；雀巢、正大、卡乐比如何把健康长寿做进日常食品；湖南 15 条医保举措下沉基层：门诊报销 70%，慢病可开 12 周处方；常州全域推进医防融合：体重管理门诊一号通办，专科资源下沉基层；全国 80 名医院管理者在渝参访：体重管理中心如何做成体系；西藏比如县启动慢病双管行动：管体重、管意识，建筛查到保障全链条
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 《细胞》：5981 株菌基因组揭示，工业化正驱动肠道菌趋同进化
    Cell: 5,981 gut bacterial genomes reveal convergent evolution driven by industrialization
    德国基尔大学 Eric Alm 团队联合全球微生物组保护计划，从9国24地区434个物种水平基因组簇中培养测序5981株肠道细菌，发现工业化人群菌株蛋白组更大、泛基因组流动性更高，80%至90%的基因获得由水平基因转移驱动，维生素B12合成的cob与肽聚糖合成的mur操纵子出现跨物种趋同突变。
    A team led by Eric Alm at Kiel University, working with the Global Microbiome Conservancy, cultured and sequenced 5,981 gut bacterial strains spanning 434 species-level clusters from 24 regions in nine countries. Strains from industrialized hosts carried larger proteomes and higher pangenome fluidity, with 80 to 90 percent of gene gains driven by horizontal gene transfer; the cob operon for vitamin B12 synthesis and the mur operon for peptidoglycan synthesis showed convergent non-synonymous mutations across species.
  • 协和朱兰团队《自然·医学》：绝经激素治疗应答由肠道与阴道菌群分型决定
    Peking Union Medical College Hospital team maps how microbiome subtypes predict hormone therapy response
    北京协和医院朱兰、陈蓉团队11月3日在 Nature Medicine 发表前瞻队列，覆盖14家中心356名围绝经期女性，治疗前及第4、12、24周采集四部位菌群宏基因组。口服雌二醇/地屈孕酮主要改变泌尿生殖道与舌苔菌群；治疗前卷曲乳杆菌丰度与性功能评分正相关，菌群失调者改善微弱。
    Zhu Lan and Chen Rong of Peking Union Medical College Hospital, with BGI Life Science Research, published a multicentre prospective cohort in Nature Medicine on Nov 3 covering 356 perimenopausal women at 14 centres, with metagenomic sampling of four body sites before treatment and at weeks 4, 12 and 24. Oral estradiol plus dydrogesterone mainly shifted urogenital and tongue-coating microbiota while gut communities stayed stable; pre-treatment Lactobacillus crispatus abundance correlated with sexual function scores, women with disordered microbiota improved little, and the team built a machine-learning model to predict response.
  • 700 例粪便宏基因组：肠道四界微生物可无创筛查胆管癌，平均 AUC 达 91%
    Faecal metagenomics across four microbial kingdoms enables non-invasive cholangiocarcinoma screening
    郑大一附院任志刚团队与浙大一院郑树森团队对700例多中心粪便样本做宏基因组测序，同时解析古菌、细菌、真菌、病毒四界及功能特征，用梯度提升机整合21个标志物建模。模型在三个独立队列平均AUC达91%，鉴别胆管癌与肝细胞癌AUC为99.74%，成果发表于 Genome Medicine。
    Ren Zhigang of the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University and Zheng Shusen of the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University sequenced faecal metagenomes from 700 multicentre samples, profiling archaea, bacteria, fungi and viruses plus functional features, then built a gradient-boosting model on 21 markers. The model reached a mean AUC of 91 percent across three independent cohorts, 99.74 percent for separating cholangiocarcinoma from hepatocellular carcinoma, and detected 97.6 percent of CA19-9-negative cases; the work appeared in Genome Medicine.
  • 20 项 RCT 荟萃：益生菌改善健康成人抑郁与睡眠，对焦虑无显著作用
    Meta-analysis of 20 RCTs: probiotics ease depression and sleep in healthy adults, not anxiety
    西南医科大学附属医院李亚玲、李俊团队在 Pharmacological Research 发表荟萃分析，汇总20项随机对照试验、1508名健康成人：益生菌显著降低抑郁评分并改善睡眠质量指数，焦虑未达显著且异质性极高；短于8周的干预对焦虑改善更好，多菌株组合效应更一致。
    Li Yaling and Li Jun of the Affiliated Hospital of Southwest Medical University published a systematic review and meta-analysis in Pharmacological Research pooling 20 randomised trials and 1,508 healthy adults with subclinical mood and sleep complaints. Probiotics significantly lowered depression scores (SMD -0.23) and improved Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index scores (SMD -0.37), while anxiety did not reach significance amid high heterogeneity; interventions shorter than eight weeks outperformed longer ones for anxiety, and multi-strain formulas were more consistent.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 《细胞》：补充 DGLA 把衰老细胞推向铁死亡，开辟高选择性 senolytic 新路径
    Cell: supplementing DGLA pushes senescent cells into ferroptosis, a selective senolytic route
    塔夫茨大学团队在 Cell 发文，发现多不饱和脂肪酸去饱和代谢是细胞在衰老与铁死亡间的分子开关：衰老细胞上调 FADS1/FADS2 比例、加速消耗 DGLA 以逃避铁死亡；外源 DGLA 经 CD36 摄入并引发膜脂过氧化，选择性杀伤衰老细胞，老龄小鼠口服后 p16 与 SASP 下降。
    A Tufts University team reported in Cell that polyunsaturated fatty acid desaturation acts as the molecular switch deciding whether damaged cells senesce or undergo ferroptosis. Senescent cells raise the FADS1 to FADS2 ratio and shunt DGLA toward arachidonic acid, escaping ferroptosis; exogenous DGLA at 200 micromolar enters via CD36 and, with ALOX15-catalysed lipid peroxidation, selectively kills several senescent cell types. Five days of oral DGLA ethyl ester in old mice lowered p16 signalling, SASP expression and liver and kidney fibrosis after two weeks.
  • 成年期去势使雄鼠寿命延长约 33%，推翻越早手术越好的旧观点
    Castration in adulthood extends male mouse lifespan by about 33 percent
    得州大学圣安东尼奥健康科学中心 Nelson 团队在 bioRxiv 预印本报告：同品系雄鼠在青春期前、后与240日龄（约人类30岁）去势，寿命分别延长19%、26%与33%，成年期获益最大；但各组握力下降速度与对照组相同，提示去势延寿并非简单减缓衰老。研究者强调仅为小鼠结果且未经同行评审。
    Nelson and colleagues at UT Health San Antonio reported in a bioRxiv preprint that male mice of the same strain castrated before puberty, just after puberty, or at 240 days of age (roughly 30 human years) lived 19, 26 and 33 percent longer respectively, with the adult group gaining most. Grip strength and other functional decline progressed at the same rate as controls, suggesting the benefit is not simple slowing of ageing; the authors stress this is mouse data, not peer reviewed, and not transferable to humans.
  • 华西 NKG2D-CAR-T 抗衰技术作价入股，衰老疫苗进入产业化通道
    West China NKG2D CAR-T senescence technology licensed into a spin-off for industrialization
    华西医院赵旭东团队靶向 NKG2D 配体的 CAR-T 技术，已由循源科技以专利作价入股承接，并启动衰老疫苗产业化项目。论文2023年登上 Science Translational Medicine 封面，证实可清除小鼠与恒河猴衰老细胞，是全球首个在灵长类验证的抗衰 CAR-T，仍处临床前。
    A CAR-T platform targeting NKG2D ligands developed by Zhao Xudong at West China Hospital of Sichuan University has been transferred by patent-for-equity deal to Xunyuan Technology, which launched an industrialization project branded as a senescence vaccine. The underlying paper appeared as a 2023 cover article in Science Translational Medicine, showing clearance of senescent cells and improved ageing metrics in mice and rhesus macaques, the first anti-ageing CAR-T validated in non-human primates; it remains preclinical.
  • 雄性小鼠中年更早丧失抗癌免疫：胸腺萎缩让 naive T 细胞储备先耗尽
    Male mice lose anti-cancer immunity earlier as thymic involution depletes naive T cells
    Lifespan.io 11月3日报道，新研究发现雄性小鼠到中年时 naive T 细胞储备下降幅度明显大于雌性，识别肿瘤的能力随之减弱；恢复胸腺活性可改善保护作用。研究者认为这提示两性免疫衰老节奏不同，也为男性癌症发生率与免疫治疗应答差异提供了一条免疫学解释线索。
    Lifespan.io reported on Nov 3 that a new study found shrinking naive T cell reserves weaken tumour recognition in male mice by middle age more than in females, and that restoring thymic activity improved protection. The authors suggest the sexes age immunologically at different tempos, offering an immunological clue to sex differences in cancer incidence and immunotherapy response.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 每天一个牛油果加一杯芒果，8 周改善糖尿病前期者血管功能
    Daily avocado plus mango improves vascular function in prediabetes within eight weeks
    伊利诺伊理工学院将82名糖尿病前期成人随机分组，干预组每日一个中等哈斯牛油果加一杯鲜芒果，对照组以等热量碳水替代，共8周。结果血流介导舒张升至6.7%，对照组降至4.6%；男性中心血压降约1.9 mmHg，对照组升5 mmHg；体重与总热量无变化。研究发表于 JAHA，由行业机构资助。
    Illinois Institute of Technology randomised 82 adults with prediabetes to a daily medium Hass avocado plus a cup of fresh mango or to calorie-matched carbohydrate alternatives for eight weeks, with 75 percent of meals provided. Flow-mediated dilation rose to 6.7 percent versus a fall to 4.6 percent in controls; central blood pressure fell about 1.9 mmHg in men on the fruit diet while rising 5 mmHg in controls, with no weight or calorie change. The study appeared in JAHA, funded by mango and avocado trade boards.
  • 老来瘦未必好：专家给出肌少症蛋白质处方，1.2–1.5 g/kg 并三餐均分
    Experts detail a sarcopenia protein prescription of 1.2 to 1.5 g per kg split across meals
    人民日报健康客户端11月3日求证稿援引专家：我国60岁以上人群肌少症患病率约9.8%，早期可部分逆转。建议每日蛋白质1.2至1.5克/公斤（60公斤老人约72至90克），按每餐20至30克分配；优选鱼虾、瘦肉、蛋奶与大豆，并关注维生素D与亮氨酸，配合每周2至3次抗阻训练。
    A People's Daily Health Client fact-check published on Nov 3 cited clinicians noting that about 9.8 percent of Chinese adults over 60 have sarcopenia and that early cases can partly reverse. Recommended intake is 1.2 to 1.5 grams of protein per kilogram daily, roughly 72 to 90 grams for a 60 kg older adult, split into 20 to 30 grams per meal to maximise muscle synthesis; fish, lean meat, eggs, dairy and soy are preferred, alongside vitamin D, leucine and resistance training two to three times weekly.
  • 拉萨市人民医院营养门诊开诊：按高原特点做个体化营养治疗
    Lhasa People's Hospital opens nutrition clinic tailored to high-altitude needs
    拉萨市人民医院宣布自11月3日起开设营养门诊，每周二、周四全天由营养医师坐诊。服务覆盖普通人群膳食搭配与体重管理、孕产妇及婴幼儿青少年生长发育、老年人营养不良与消化薄弱，并针对糖尿病、高血压、痛风、肾病、肝病等提供专属营养治疗方案，以及术后与放化疗后的营养支持，强调结合高原饮食特点制定个体化方案。
    Lhasa People's Hospital said its new nutrition clinic opens on Nov 3, staffed by nutrition physicians all day every Tuesday and Thursday. Services cover everyday meal planning and weight management, pregnancy and child growth, malnutrition in older adults, disease-specific nutrition therapy for diabetes, hypertension, gout, kidney and liver disease, plus post-surgical and post-chemotherapy nutrition support, with individualised plans adapted to high-altitude dietary patterns.
  • 株洲三三一医院把营养处方开进食堂与家庭：300 余人人均减重 21 斤
    Zhuzhou hospital extends nutrition prescriptions from clinic to canteen and kitchen
    红网11月3日报道，株洲市三三一医院依托体重管理门诊整合治未病、临床营养与内分泌科，建立评估到随访闭环。开诊至今服务300余人，人均减重21斤，干预3个月减重5%以上者占98.2%，合并三高与脂肪肝者代谢指标恢复正常率83.0%；并把减脂餐与烹饪教学延伸到食堂、家庭和企业。
    Rednet reported on Nov 3 that Zhuzhou 331 Hospital built a closed loop of assessment, planning, execution and follow-up at its weight management clinic, combining preventive medicine, clinical nutrition and endocrinology and profiling patients by BMI, body composition and TCM constitution. It has served over 300 people with an average loss of 21 jin, 98.2 percent losing more than 5 percent at three months and 83.0 percent of those with metabolic syndrome normalising markers; low-fat canteen meals and cooking classes extend the prescription to homes and workplaces.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 白藜芦醇＋槲皮素＋姜黄素复方 2a 期：黄斑区玻璃膜疣体积降 13.4%
    Resveratrol, quercetin and curcumin combo cuts drusen volume 13.4 percent in phase 2a trial
    伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校开放标签随机2a期试验纳入38例早中期年龄相关性黄斑变性患者，分入复方组（姜黄素类800毫克、反式白藜芦醇200毫克、槲皮素200毫克每日）或单用姜黄素组，疗程两年。复方组中心玻璃膜疣体积下降13.4%，单药组上升6.9%；视力复方组改善、单药组下降，但组间未达显著。
    An open-label randomised phase 2a trial at the University of Illinois Chicago assigned 38 people with early to intermediate age-related macular degeneration to a combination of 800 mg curcuminoids, 200 mg trans-resveratrol and 200 mg quercetin daily, or curcumin alone, for two years. Central drusen volume fell 13.4 percent with the combination but rose 6.9 percent with curcumin alone; visual acuity improved in the combination arm and declined in the monotherapy arm, though between-group differences were not statistically significant. The results appeared in Translational Vision Science and Technology.
  • Holland & Barrett 发布 2027 六大趋势：从量化自我转向神经系统调节
    Holland and Barrett forecasts six wellness trends for 2027, from tracking to nervous-system care
    英国连锁 Holland & Barrett 报告预测2027年六大健康趋势：神经系统调节、降温补水、女性全周期健康、肌肉经济、主动心血管健康与拒绝过度量化的简约主义。2026年站内搜索镁3280万次居首，胶原2940万、维生素D 2700万次；企业预计精准发酵蛋白与功能性纤维将成创新重点。
    UK retailer Holland and Barrett forecast six wellness trends for 2027: nervous-system regulation, cooling and hydration, women's health across life stages, the muscle economy, proactive cardiovascular health, and a simplicity trend that rejects over-tracking. On its site in 2026 magnesium drew 32.8 million searches, ahead of collagen at 29.4 million and vitamin D at 27 million, while a single magnesium bisglycinate line sold nearly 45 million capsules. The company expects precision-fermented proteins, functional fibres and polyphenols to drive innovation.
  • 市场监管总局发展研究中心发布《中国营养品行业创新发展研究报告（2026）》
    China nutrition industry innovation report 2026 flags evidence gap and personalisation shift
    报告指出渠道已由药店商超转向电商主导，2025年上半年膳食营养补充剂电商销售额622亿元、占近半市场；合成生物学、智能递送、多组学与AI推动产品从千人一面走向个性化精准营养。报告同时列出五类痛点：分类管理与标准待完善、新成分检测滞后、人体循证不足、擦边营销与贴牌同质化。
    The report says channels have shifted from pharmacies and supermarkets to e-commerce, with dietary supplement online sales reaching 62.2 billion yuan in the first half of 2025, close to half the market, as Gen Z and millennials became core buyers and demand spread across all age groups. Synthetic biology, smart delivery, multi-omics and AI are moving products from one-size-fits-all toward personalised precision nutrition. It also lists five pain points: incomplete category standards, lagging testing for novel ingredients, thin human evidence, borderline marketing claims and copycat contract manufacturing.
  • 雀巢、正大、卡乐比如何把健康长寿做进日常食品
    How Nestle, CPF and Calbee are building healthy longevity into everyday food
    在新加坡亚太农业食品创新峰会上，雀巢表示把健康长寿视为营养与补充剂协同的机会，强调让产品可日常食用；泰国正大采取日常营养、医学营养与个性化营养三线并进，与医院合作设计糖尿病及康复人群食品，并建设菌群数据库指导配餐；日本卡乐比与新加坡 AMILI 合作，以菌群检测加麦片订阅提供个性化营养服务。
    At the Asia-Pacific Agri-Food Innovation Summit in Singapore, Nestle described healthy longevity as an interconnected opportunity across food and supplements and stressed everyday accessibility. Thailand's CPF runs three tracks of daily, medical and personalised nutrition, codesigning foods with a hospital for diabetes and recovery diets and building a microbiome database to guide meal plans. Japan's Calbee works with Singapore's AMILI on a personalised nutrition service pairing a gut microbiome test with a granola subscription.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 湖南 15 条医保举措下沉基层：门诊报销 70%，慢病可开 12 周处方
    Hunan pushes 15 insurance measures to primary care with 70 percent outpatient reimbursement
    湖南省医保局等三部门印发通知，15项量化举措自公布起施行：基层普通门诊政策范围内报销70%且不设起付线，住院起付线统一200元、居民报85%、职工报93%；慢病最长12周长处方且不纳入次均费用考核；医共体健康管理结余不调减次年预算，结余留用向基层倾斜不低于40%。
    Three Hunan departments issued a notice with 15 quantified measures effective immediately for five years: primary care outpatient reimbursement within policy scope rises to 70 percent with no deductible, inpatient deductibles unify at 200 yuan with 85 percent reimbursement for residents and 93 percent for employees, chronic disease prescriptions can run 12 weeks without counting toward average-cost assessments, and savings from good health management in county medical communities are not clawed back, with at least 40 percent retained at the primary level and 70 percent of contracted service fees going to family doctors.
  • 常州全域推进医防融合：体重管理门诊一号通办，专科资源下沉基层
    Changzhou builds citywide preventive-care integration with one-stop weight management
    央广网11月3日报道，常州以市域统筹三医联动，构建防、筛、管、治、康全链条闭环。市第二人民医院体重管理中心整合内分泌、胃肠外科、注册营养师与运动康复等18个学科，患者挂一个号即可完成初筛、方案与长期随访；该院牵头组建江苏省首个体重管理联盟，吸纳51家机构，并向基层输出诊疗规范与数字化平台。
    CNR reported on Nov 3 that Changzhou coordinates health, insurance and medical reform citywide to build a closed chain spanning prevention, screening, management, treatment and rehabilitation. The weight management centre at Changzhou No. 2 People's Hospital brings together 18 disciplines including endocrinology, bariatric surgery, dietitians and exercise rehabilitation, so one registration covers screening, planning and long-term follow-up; the hospital leads Jiangsu's first weight management alliance of 51 institutions and exports protocols and a digital platform to primary care.
  • 全国 80 名医院管理者在渝参访：体重管理中心如何做成体系
    80 hospital leaders visit Chongqing to study how to build a weight management centre
    10月30日至31日，2026体重管理中心建设与能力提升项目重庆专场在两江新区人民医院举行，全国80名管理者参加。8个专题涵盖青少年肥胖诊疗、内镜减重、穴位埋线安全管控、医学营养减重路径与《肌少型肥胖临床诊治专家共识（2026版）》解读，并分组观摩三个科室门诊与MDT演示。
    On Oct 30 and 31 the Chongqing leg of a 2026 weight management centre development programme drew 80 hospital leaders and clinicians to Liangjiang New Area People's Hospital. Eight sessions covered adolescent obesity care, endoscopic bariatric procedures, safety of acupoint catgut embedding, medical nutrition weight loss pathways, case manager roles and the 2026 expert consensus on sarcopenic obesity, with group visits to endocrinology, gastroenterology and nutrition clinics plus a multidisciplinary team demonstration.
  • 西藏比如县启动慢病双管行动：管体重、管意识，建筛查到保障全链条
    Tibet's Biru county launches chronic disease drive targeting weight and health literacy
    科学网11月3日报道，西藏那曲市比如县启动健康比如·健康共富双管行动暨十五五慢性病综合防控治行动，以管慢病体重、管健康意识为切口，依托县医疗集团构建筛查、干预、管理、保障全链条，衔接县乡村三级随访与转诊，并组织为期两天半的慢病防治能力培训，推动高原慢病防控由阶段性活动转向常态化。
    ScienceNet reported on Nov 3 that Biru county in Nagqu, Tibet, launched a dual-track chronic disease campaign for the 15th five-year plan period, targeting chronic disease weight control and health literacy. Relying on the county medical group, it builds a chain from screening and intervention to management and financing, links county, township and village follow-up and referral, and ran a two-and-a-half-day training course so high-altitude chronic disease control becomes routine rather than episodic.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-11-03
item.description: 2026-11-03 简报，共 20 条：陕西省首家肠道微生态诊疗中心升级开诊，粪菌移植建成全流程闭环；GPCR-seq 绘出肠菌—宿主“化学对话”图谱，锁定炎症性肠病相关受体通路；《自然》：约翰霍普金斯找到肠菌毒素入侵结肠的“门锁”claudin-4；《自然》：高胆固醇饮食经 Ral–CTSA 通路“拆掉”肝脏 LDL 受体；中科院团队筛出千金藤素：选择性清除衰老细胞，小鼠中位寿命延长约 18%；上海仁济 1.8 万人队列：血浆代谢组“衰老时钟”可预测慢病与死亡；24 年追踪 8200 人：BMI 越高，记忆与执行功能衰退越快；巴克研究所联手 Oracle：用 1.22 亿条真实世界数据打造“内在能力评分”；朱蓓薇院士提出“AI 驱动精准体重管理”：先做肥胖分型，再定一日三餐；康宝莱进博会首秀 Bioniq GO，健康管理数字化平台中国版全球首发；《自然》：决定免疫治疗疗效的不只是肠菌，还有“喂给肠菌的食物”；新报告呼吁改写血压指南：补钾与减钠应当并重；第五届中国营养师发展大会提出“慧选慧烹慧吃慧补慧动”五步食养体系；低剂量小檗碱提取物 Metaberine：14 天交叉试验空腹 GLP-1 升高 29%；Cochrane 综述：医用大麻改善失眠的证据“薄弱且不确定”；223 对母婴队列：孕早期 omega-6/omega-3 比值偏高与 4 岁执行功能较弱相关；健康 AI“蚂蚁阿福”获世界互联网大会领先科技奖，已服务 1.5 亿用户；全国重大慢性病过早死亡率十年由 18.5% 降至 13.8%；云南发布《中西医结合体重管理中心建设专家共识》；《科学》：电化学植入物把多余血糖转成葡萄糖酸盐，小鼠降糖同时减重
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 陕西省首家肠道微生态诊疗中心升级开诊，粪菌移植建成全流程闭环
    Shaanxi's first gut microbiome clinic reopens with a full-chain FMT workflow
    10月30日，西安市中心医院肠道微生态诊疗中心在经开院区开诊。该中心2022年建成陕西省首家菌群库，已打通供体筛选、菌群分离制备、低温储存到临床治疗的闭环，围绕艰难梭菌感染、溃疡性结肠炎、慢性便秘、肠易激综合征开展粪菌移植，并称该技术已纳入国家医疗服务技术规范与医保立项指南。
    On Oct 30, Xi'an Central Hospital opened its gut microbiome diagnosis and treatment centre at the Jingkai campus. First established in Shaanxi in July 2022, the centre now runs a closed loop from donor screening and microbiome isolation to cryostorage and clinical delivery, performing faecal microbiota transplantation for C. difficile infection, ulcerative colitis, chronic constipation and IBS; hospital officials noted FMT is now covered by national technical standards and insurance pricing guidelines.
  • GPCR-seq 绘出肠菌—宿主“化学对话”图谱，锁定炎症性肠病相关受体通路
    GPCR-seq maps the gut microbe–host chemical dialogue and flags an IBD-linked receptor
    麻省总医院团队在 Cell Host & Microbe 发表 GPCR-seq 平台，用测序多重报告系统一次筛查数百种肠道代谢物对受体的激活效应。研究显示环己乙酸等菌源脂肪酸经嗅觉受体 OR51E1 驱动肠嗜铬细胞分泌血清素；6-羟基烟酸激活 GPR35，且在炎症性肠病患者粪便中富集。
    Writing in Cell Host & Microbe, the Xavier and Graham teams at Massachusetts General Hospital described GPCR-seq, a next-generation-sequencing-based multiplex reporter platform that screens hundreds of gut metabolites against host receptors at once. Microbial fatty acids such as cyclohexaneacetic acid drove serotonin release from enterochromaffin cells via the olfactory receptor OR51E1, while 6-hydroxy-nicotinic acid activated GPR35 and was markedly enriched in stools from patients with inflammatory bowel disease.
  • 《自然》：约翰霍普金斯找到肠菌毒素入侵结肠的“门锁”claudin-4
    Nature: Johns Hopkins identifies claudin-4 as the docking receptor for a gut bacterial toxin
    约翰霍普金斯在《自然》报告，产毒型脆弱拟杆菌的 BFT 毒素须先结合结肠上皮紧密连接蛋白 claudin-4，才能降解 E-cadherin、破坏屏障并促发慢性炎症与肿瘤。团队设计可溶性 claudin-4 诱饵，在小鼠体内拦截毒素、避免组织损伤，为结直肠癌预防提供新靶点。
    In Nature, Johns Hopkins Kimmel Cancer Center researchers showed that the BFT toxin of toxigenic Bacteroides fragilis must first bind claudin-4, a tight-junction protein on colon epithelial cells, before it can degrade E-cadherin, breach the barrier and drive chronic inflammation and tumours. Using a genome-wide CRISPR screen, the team then built a soluble claudin-4 decoy that intercepted the toxin and protected mice from tissue damage, offering a new target for colorectal cancer prevention.
  • 《自然》：高胆固醇饮食经 Ral–CTSA 通路“拆掉”肝脏 LDL 受体
    Nature: high-cholesterol diets dismantle liver LDL receptors via a Ral–CTSA pathway
    加州大学圣迭戈分校在《自然》揭示，高胆固醇饮食激活蛋白 Ral，经组织蛋白酶 A（CTSA）加速肝细胞 LDL 受体降解。抑制 CTSA 后小鼠 LDL 受体更稳定、循环 LDL 显著下降。该通路不同于他汀与 PCSK9 抑制剂，已有通过 I 期安全性试验的抑制剂可候选进入 II 期。
    UC San Diego scientists reported in Nature that dietary cholesterol activates the protein Ral, which in turn drives cathepsin A (CTSA) to accelerate degradation of LDL receptors on liver cells, eroding the body's ability to clear LDL from the blood. Blocking CTSA with a small molecule stabilised the receptors and sharply lowered circulating LDL in mice. The pathway is distinct from those targeted by statins and PCSK9 inhibitors, and a CTSA inhibitor that already passed a Phase 1 safety trial could move to Phase 2.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 中科院团队筛出千金藤素：选择性清除衰老细胞，小鼠中位寿命延长约 18%
    Cepharanthine emerges as a selective senolytic, extending mouse median lifespan
    中科院香港创新研究院等团队在 Phytomedicine 报告，千金藤素对衰老细胞 IC50 为 3.1 μM、对正常细胞 10.96 μM，选择性约 3.5 倍。自然衰老小鼠中位寿命由 660 天延至 780 天，早衰症小鼠由 110 天延至 130 天。
    Researchers from the Chinese Academy of Sciences Hong Kong Institute of Innovation and collaborators reported in Phytomedicine that the natural compound cepharanthine kills senescent cells with an IC50 of 3.1 μM versus 10.96 μM for proliferating cells, roughly 3.5-fold selectivity. It suppresses PI3K/AKT survival signalling, activates PERK-ATF4-CHOP and upregulates PUMA/NOXA to trigger mitochondrial apoptosis. Median lifespan rose from 660 to 780 days in naturally aged mice and from 110 to 130 days in a progeria model.
  • 上海仁济 1.8 万人队列：血浆代谢组“衰老时钟”可预测慢病与死亡
    Shanghai cohort of 18,476 builds a plasma metabolomic clock for ageing and disease risk
    仁济医院卜军团队与上海交大钱昆团队在《科学·转化医学》发表封面研究，覆盖六中心 18476 名 1—96 岁人群、随访 6 年，绘出血浆代谢图谱，筛出 56 个年龄相关特征并构建“代谢组年龄加速”（mAA）。mAA 每升高 1 个标准差，全因死亡风险约增 50%，并与高血压、脂肪肝、糖尿病相关。
    A cover paper in Science Translational Medicine from Renji Hospital's Bu Jun team and Shanghai Jiao Tong University's Qian Kun team profiled plasma metabolites in 18,476 people aged 1 to 96 across six Chinese centres with about six years of follow-up. They mapped lifespan-wide metabolic trajectories, identified 56 age-related features and built a metabolomic age acceleration (mAA) index; each standard-deviation rise in mAA corresponded to roughly 50% higher all-cause mortality and tracked hypertension, fatty liver and diabetes.
  • 24 年追踪 8200 人：BMI 越高，记忆与执行功能衰退越快
    24-year study of 8,200 adults links higher BMI to faster cognitive decline
    佐治亚大学团队分析全国代表性队列 8200 余名 50 岁以上成人、历时 24 年的数据，发现 BMI 每升高 1 点，记忆、整体认知与执行功能衰退更快，关联在第 8 年最强、65 岁以上最明显。研究同时给出积极信号：管理体重后认知衰退速度可在两年内显著放缓。论文发表于《神经病学杂志》。
    Using 24 years of data from a nationally representative cohort of more than 8,200 US adults over 50, University of Georgia researchers found that each one-point increase in BMI was associated with faster decline in memory, global cognition and executive function, strongest at year eight and most pronounced above age 65. Encouragingly, managing weight was linked to a significantly slower rate of cognitive decline within just two years. The study appeared in the Journal of Neurology.
  • 巴克研究所联手 Oracle：用 1.22 亿条真实世界数据打造“内在能力评分”
    Buck Institute taps Oracle's 122 million records to build an Intrinsic Capacity Score
    巴克衰老研究所将接入 Oracle 逾 1.22 亿条去标识化纵向真实世界记录，寻找可在症状出现前数年预警衰弱与慢病的标志物，并构建“内在能力评分”。该工作隶属斯坦福牵头的 THRIVE 联盟（ARPA-H PROSPR 计划，资助上限 3450 万美元），并争取 FDA 资格认定。
    The Buck Institute for Research on Aging will use Oracle Health's Life Sciences Data Intelligence platform, holding more than 122 million de-identified longitudinal real-world records, to hunt for biomarkers that flag frailty or chronic disease years before symptoms appear and to build a statistically validated Intrinsic Capacity Score. The work sits inside THRIVE, a Stanford-led consortium under ARPA-H's PROSPR programme with up to $34.5 million in funding, covering five intrinsic-capacity domains, with FDA qualification as a goal.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 朱蓓薇院士提出“AI 驱动精准体重管理”：先做肥胖分型，再定一日三餐
    Academician Zhu Beiwei proposes AI-driven precision weight management
    在 2026 大湾区科学论坛“数智赋能健康湾区”分论坛上，中国工程院院士朱蓓薇提出 AI 驱动的精准体重管理新范式：先把食材、烹饪与摄入量数据化，整合健康与膳食执行数据，按代谢异常型、内脏脂肪型、高脂低肌型三类肥胖给出三餐方案，由智能烹饪设备落地。该模式已进入全国 400 多家社区爱心厨房。
    Speaking at the 2026 Greater Bay Area Science Forum's digital-health session in Nansha, Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Zhu Beiwei outlined an AI-driven precision weight-management model: digitise ingredients, cooking methods and actual intake, fuse those with health data, then assign one of three obesity subtypes — metabolic, visceral-fat or low-muscle-high-fat — a tailored three-meal plan delivered by smart cooking devices. The approach is already running in more than 400 community kitchens nationwide.
  • 康宝莱进博会首秀 Bioniq GO，健康管理数字化平台中国版全球首发
    Herbalife brings Bioniq GO to Asia and debuts a China edition of its digital health platform
    康宝莱宣布第九次参展进博会，将带来个性化营养配方产品 Bioniq GO 的亚洲首秀——通过数字化健康评估，从 40 种营养配方中匹配个体方案，采用瑞士颗粒技术简化日常补充；同时全球首展专为中国市场打造的健康管理数字化平台，以人工智能覆盖“评估—建议—规划—陪伴”全链路，并与营养顾问服务结合。
    Herbalife said it will exhibit at the China International Import Expo for a ninth time, giving its personalised nutrition product Bioniq GO its Asia debut: a digital health assessment matches users to one of 40 nutrient formulas, delivered as easy-to-take granules using Swiss granulation technology. The company will also globally premiere a China edition of its digital health-management platform, which uses AI across an assess-advise-plan-accompany chain combined with human nutrition advisers.
  • 《自然》：决定免疫治疗疗效的不只是肠菌，还有“喂给肠菌的食物”
    Nature: diet–microbiome synergy, not body weight, may explain the obesity paradox
    麦吉尔大学团队在《自然》测试 12 种饮食后发现，部分通常被视为“致肥”的饮食反而增强了小鼠对免疫检查点抑制剂的应答，即使干预时间很短。研究者认为“肥胖悖论”的关键可能不在体重本身，而在饮食与肠道菌群的协同——即便菌群构成合适，喂养它们的食物也决定治疗是否有效。团队强调不应据此鼓励患者采用致肥饮食。
    Testing 12 different diets in mice, McGill University researchers reported in Nature that some diets normally considered obesogenic actually improved responses to immune checkpoint inhibitors, even over short periods. The team argues the obesity paradox may hinge less on excess weight than on diet-microbiome synergy: even with the right bacterial composition, the food nourishing those populations can determine whether treatment works. They stressed the findings must not encourage patients to eat obesity-promoting diets.
  • 新报告呼吁改写血压指南：补钾与减钠应当并重
    New report urges blood pressure guidelines to treat potassium as equal to sodium
    佛蒙特大学学者在《美国临床营养学杂志》发表报告指出，全球逾 12.8 亿高血压成人长期被建议“少吃盐”，但钾摄入普遍远低于理想水平。报告认为增加膳食钾可帮助肾脏排钠、改善血管功能，与减钠联合的降压效果优于单纯限盐，并建议推广低钠高钾盐替代品；但肾病或服用特定药物者需在医嘱下补钾。
    A report in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition from University of Vermont researchers argues that advice for the more than 1.28 billion adults with hypertension has long emphasised cutting sodium while ignoring potassium, which remains far below optimal intakes worldwide. Higher dietary potassium helps the kidneys excrete sodium and supports blood vessel function, and combining it with sodium reduction outperforms salt restriction alone; the authors back low-sodium, high-potassium salt substitutes, with medical guidance for people with kidney disease.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 第五届中国营养师发展大会提出“慧选慧烹慧吃慧补慧动”五步食养体系
    China Dietitian Development Conference proposes a five-step science-based eating framework
    10月30日至11月1日，第五届中国营养师发展大会在北京举行，首次面向公众开放，提出“慧选、慧烹、慧吃、慧补、慧动”科学食养五步实操体系，并发布《新时代轻食发展态势与国民健康价值研究白皮书》。中国营养学会理事长杨月欣、北京协和医院临床营养科主任于康等参会，Swisse 斯维诗获“科学食养促进奖”。
    The fifth China Dietitian Development Conference ran in Beijing from Oct 30 to Nov 1, opening to the public for the first time and proposing a five-step practical framework — choose wisely, cook wisely, eat wisely, supplement wisely, move wisely. It also released a white paper on the light-meal sector and public health value. Yang Yuexin, president of the Chinese Nutrition Society, and Yu Kang of Peking Union Medical College Hospital spoke; Swisse took a science-based eating award.
  • 低剂量小檗碱提取物 Metaberine：14 天交叉试验空腹 GLP-1 升高 29%
    Low-dose berberine extract lifts fasting GLP-1 by 29% in a 14-day crossover trial
    印度 Zeus Hygia 的专利小檗碱 Metaberine 发表双盲安慰剂对照交叉试验：36 名超重受试者服用 14 天后空腹 GLP-1 升高 29%，血糖峰值与 LDL 下降、HDL 升高，体重与安慰剂组相差约 0.35 公斤。供应商强调这并非减重效力试验，不宜与处方 GLP-1 类比。
    A randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial tested Metaberine, a patented Berberis aristata extract from India's Zeus Hygia, in 36 participants with a mean BMI of 25.8. After 14 days fasting GLP-1 rose 29% and postprandial GLP-1 22%, glucose exposure and peaks fell, LDL dropped and HDL rose, with about a 0.35 kg weight gap versus placebo. The supplier stressed the study was not designed to show weight loss and should not be likened to prescription GLP-1 drugs.
  • Cochrane 综述：医用大麻改善失眠的证据“薄弱且不确定”
    Cochrane review finds little reliable evidence that medical cannabis helps insomnia
    Cochrane 系统综述纳入 9 项试验、537 名 18—76 岁失眠成人，其中 8 项对照安慰剂。结果显示医用大麻在睡眠质量、满意度、总睡眠时长与日间功能上几乎没有临床意义的改善，头晕、口干等轻度不良反应更常见，证据确定性为低或极低。作者强调这不等于无效，而是现有研究不足以判断。
    A Cochrane systematic review from the Universidad Hospital Italiano de Buenos Aires and the University of Manitoba pooled nine trials in 537 adults aged 18 to 76 being treated for insomnia, eight of them placebo-controlled. Medical cannabis produced little or no clinically meaningful improvement in sleep quality, sleep satisfaction, total sleep time or daytime functioning, while dizziness and dry mouth were more common; certainty of evidence was rated low or very low. The authors stressed this does not mean cannabis is ineffective, only that current research cannot answer the question.
  • 223 对母婴队列：孕早期 omega-6/omega-3 比值偏高与 4 岁执行功能较弱相关
    Higher omega-6 to omega-3 ratio in early pregnancy tied to weaker executive function at age 4
    西班牙 ECLIPSES 队列 223 名孕妇在孕 12、24、36 周测血清脂肪酸，孩子 4 岁时用 WPPSI 与 BRIEF-P 评估。仅孕早期 n-6/n-3 比值偏高与执行功能较弱相关，尤其影响工作记忆、抑制控制与计划组织。两类脂肪酸竞争同一去饱和酶，比值比绝对水平更有意义。
    In Spain's ECLIPSES cohort, 223 pregnant women had serum fatty acids measured at 12, 24 and 36 weeks, and their children were assessed at age four with the WPPSI and BRIEF-P. Only a higher first-trimester n-6/n-3 ratio was associated with poorer executive function — notably working memory, inhibition and planning — with no significant link in the third trimester and general cognition largely unaffected. Because the two fatty acid families compete for the same desaturases, the ratio may be more biologically meaningful than absolute levels, the authors wrote in Nutrients.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 健康 AI“蚂蚁阿福”获世界互联网大会领先科技奖，已服务 1.5 亿用户
    Ant Group's health AI A'Fu wins the WIC Leading Science and Technology Award
    11月2日，2026 年世界互联网大会揭晓领先科技奖，蚂蚁集团健康 AI“蚂蚁阿福”成为首个获该奖的健康垂类应用。官方称其已服务 1.5 亿用户、单日解答近 2000 万人次咨询，55% 用户来自三线及以下城市、四分之一为老年人。“科学减重 1 亿斤”行动已累计减重超 700 万斤。
    At the 2026 World Internet Conference on Nov 2, Ant Group's health AI assistant A'Fu became the first health-focused app to win the event's Leading Science and Technology Award. Ant says it serves 150 million users and answers nearly 20 million health queries a day, with 55% of users from tier-three cities or below and a quarter aged over 60. Its weight-loss campaign has enrolled 3.7 million users who shed more than 3.5 million kilograms in total.
  • 全国重大慢性病过早死亡率十年由 18.5% 降至 13.8%
    China's premature mortality from major chronic diseases falls from 18.5% to 13.8%
    《人民日报海外版》梳理慢病防线：四川泸县 20 多万慢病患者获分类分级服务，县域四类重大慢病过早死亡率较 2020 年降 3.25 个百分点；安徽濉溪医保基金按人头包干给医共体，基金连续 9 年结余。全国重大慢性病过早死亡率由 2015 年 18.5% 降至 2025 年 13.8%。
    A People's Daily Overseas Edition data column traced China's chronic-disease defences: Luxian county in Sichuan gives more than 200,000 patients tiered services and cut premature mortality from four major chronic diseases by 3.25 percentage points versus 2020; Suixi in Anhui hands its insurance fund to the county medical community as a per-capita lump sum, putting 131,000 patients under online tiered management with nine consecutive years of surplus. Nationally, premature mortality from major chronic diseases fell from 18.5% in 2015 to 13.8% in 2025.
  • 云南发布《中西医结合体重管理中心建设专家共识》
    Yunnan releases an expert consensus on integrated Chinese-Western weight management centres
    10月31日，云南省中医医院在昆明发布《云南省中西医结合体重管理中心建设专家共识》。该院体重管理中心 2025 年 8 月挂牌，统筹治未病、内分泌、针灸推拿等资源，形成“三维评估—五联干预—全链条服务”模式，截至 9 月底接诊 1.6 万余人次。云南将推动分级联动，打造适配高原代谢的方案。
    Yunnan Provincial Hospital of Traditional Chinese Medicine released an expert consensus on building integrated Chinese-Western weight management centres in Kunming on Oct 31. The hospital's own centre, opened in August 2025, pools preventive medicine, endocrinology and acupuncture resources into a three-dimensional assessment, five-pronged intervention and full-chain service model, logging more than 16,000 visits by end-September 2026. Yunnan plans province-city-county-primary tiered rollout of protocols tuned to highland metabolic traits.
  • 《科学》：电化学植入物把多余血糖转成葡萄糖酸盐，小鼠降糖同时减重
    Science: an electrochemical implant converts excess glucose into gluconate, cutting sugar and weight
    苏黎世联邦理工 Fussenegger 团队在《科学》报告一款无线供电植入物：石墨毡上的金簇与铂微粒作为无机催化剂，把过量葡萄糖转化为可经尿排出的葡萄糖酸盐，避免多余能量转为脂肪。系统由连续血糖传感器经蓝牙触发，形成闭环。糖尿病小鼠血糖被精准调控并减重，6 周测试稳定、无电热损伤，尚未开展人体试验。
    ETH Zurich's Fussenegger lab reported in Science a wirelessly powered implant whose inorganic catalyst — gold clusters and platinum particles on graphite felt — converts excess glucose into gluconate that the body excretes in urine, keeping surplus energy from being stored as fat. A continuous glucose sensor triggers the device over Bluetooth in a closed loop. In diabetic mice it precisely controlled blood sugar and produced weight loss, ran reliably for six weeks without electrical or thermal tissue damage, and has not yet been tested in humans.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-11-02
item.description: 2026-11-02 简报，共 20 条：全食物饮食让克罗恩病高危人群肠道炎症降六成，一级预防首获随机证据；电针缓解疼痛与抑郁共病：肠—代谢物—脑轴重塑前额叶 Glu/GABA 平衡；《Nature Medicine》提出微生物组与慢病转化的十大战略优先事项；绝经后肠道菌群同步「变老」：短链脂肪酸减少、TMAO 风险放大；承重骨骼会「分泌青春」：力学刺激让老年小鼠延寿近 3 个月；三组分「抗衰老疫苗」使雌性小鼠中位寿命延长 12%；核内 NAD⁺ 维持先天免疫记忆，补充 NMN 可找回老龄小鼠的抗肿瘤免疫；长寿时代应把脑卒中视为「生物衰老加速」的预警信号；每天两份带皮烤花生 16 周：老年人胰岛素敏感性与记忆同步改善；48 万国人 9 年随访：习惯性喝茶与血管病风险下降 11% 相关；中国食品科技年会昆明开幕：「AI＋精准营养＋智能制造」成新落点；减肥不必戒碳水：高质量碳水才是体重管理与血糖的关键；维生素 A 的新发现改写视觉发育认知，但离「补维 A」建议还很远；百元「维生素文身贴」走红：无透皮数据，也走不了保健食品备案；69% 爆品红不过一个月：保健品竞争从流量转向成分与复购；2026 共识解读：维生素 D 不用于糖尿病血糖管理，窗口在糖尿病前期；长寿医学与生活方式医学北大国际论坛 11 月 13 日开幕，设功能医学实操培训；第九届中华健康节启幕：食药同源从传统滋补走向日常快消；南京赛虹桥启用运动促进健康中心：运动处方接进家庭医生随访；AI 精准长寿管理落地广东 16 个专病方向，专家点出五个「断点」
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 全食物饮食让克罗恩病高危人群肠道炎症降六成，一级预防首获随机证据
    Whole-food diet cuts gut inflammation by 60% in high-risk Crohn's relatives
    沙阿雷泽德克医疗中心的 Dan Turner 团队在《Gastroenterology》发表 PIONIR 随机交叉试验：331 名克罗恩病患者无症状一级亲属中，钙卫蛋白持续升高者接受 8 周 Tasty&Healthy 全食物饮食，钙卫蛋白降 61%，应答率 71%（对照 27%）。
    In the PIONIR randomised crossover trial published in Gastroenterology, Dan Turner's team screened 331 asymptomatic first-degree relatives of Crohn's patients and gave an 8-week Tasty&Healthy whole-food diet to those with persistently elevated faecal calprotectin. Calprotectin fell 61% from baseline and 71% responded versus 27% on habitual diet; Coprococcus eutactus enrichment tracked the decline and ultra-processed food intake dropped to zero.
  • 电针缓解疼痛与抑郁共病：肠—代谢物—脑轴重塑前额叶 Glu/GABA 平衡
    Electroacupuncture relieves pain-depression comorbidity via gut-metabolite-brain axis
    广东省中医院符文彬、刘健华团队在《Translational Psychiatry》发表：坐骨神经损伤大鼠中，电针缓解痛敏与抑郁样行为，恢复前额叶 Glu/GABA 平衡，并富集丁酸相关菌属；多组学锁定哌可酸为枢纽代谢物，中介分析证实「哌可酸—GABA」轴介导行为恢复。
    Writing in Translational Psychiatry on 30 October, Ruwenbin and Liu Jianhua's team at Guangdong Provincial Hospital of Chinese Medicine showed that electroacupuncture in nerve-injured rats eased mechanical hypersensitivity and depressive behaviour, restored prefrontal Glu/GABA balance with normalised EAAT2 and GAD67, and reshaped the microbiome toward butyrate producers. Multi-omics pinpointed pipecolic acid as the hub metabolite mediating recovery via a pipecolic acid-GABA axis.
  • 《Nature Medicine》提出微生物组与慢病转化的十大战略优先事项
    Nature Medicine sets ten strategic priorities for microbiome translation
    美国 HHS 召集的国际专家共识在《Nature Medicine》提出微生物组与慢病研究十大优先事项：从关联描述转向因果验证，整合多组学，建全球计算平台与 AI 模型，加速活体生物药与精准营养审批，聚焦生命最初 1000 天与肠—脑轴，并警示缺循证的商业检测与补剂。
    An international expert consensus convened by the US HHS, published in Nature Medicine on 23 October, lists ten strategic priorities for microbiome research: moving from association to causal validation, integrating metatranscriptomics, metaproteomics and metabolomics, building global computational and AI platforms, speeding approval of live biotherapeutics and precision-nutrition products, focusing on the first 1,000 days and the gut-brain axis, and warning against unproven commercial tests and supplements.
  • 绝经后肠道菌群同步「变老」：短链脂肪酸减少、TMAO 风险放大
    Gut microbiome ages with menopause as short-chain fatty acids decline
    科普梳理绝经后菌群与代谢的联动：雌激素下降伴随菌群构成改变，产短链脂肪酸能力（尤其丁酸）减弱、TMAO 通路风险放大、次级胆汁酸代谢改变，进而联动血管僵硬、肝脏脂肪堆积与骨骼肌流失。动物实验显示，补充丁酸或移植正常菌群可减轻卵巢切除小鼠的肝脂变性。
    A science explainer traces how menopause reshapes the microbiome: falling oestrogen accompanies compositional change, weaker short-chain fatty acid production (especially butyrate), amplified TMAO pathways and altered secondary bile acid metabolism, feeding into arterial stiffness, liver fat accumulation and muscle loss. In ovariectomised mice, butyrate supplementation or healthy microbiota transfer reduced hepatic steatosis.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 承重骨骼会「分泌青春」：力学刺激让老年小鼠延寿近 3 个月
    Loaded bone secretes rejuvenating factors, extending old mice lifespan
    南方医科大学白晓春团队在《Cell Metabolism》发表：骨细胞 PIEZO1 感知力学负荷，每周两次胫骨动态轴向负荷使老年小鼠寿命延长近 3 个月（约合人类 9 年），多器官状态同步年轻化；骨细胞分泌的 PEDF 单独注射即可复刻效果。尚属小鼠概念验证。
    In Cell Metabolism, Bai Xiaochun's team at Southern Medical University reports that osteocyte PIEZO1 senses mechanical load: twice-weekly tibial dynamic axial loading extended old mice lifespan by nearly three months (roughly nine human years) with younger bone, cognition and organ states. PEDF, secreted by osteocytes, reproduced the effect when injected alone and is lower in older adults and osteoporosis patients. Mouse proof-of-concept only.
  • 三组分「抗衰老疫苗」使雌性小鼠中位寿命延长 12%
    Three-element senolytic vaccine extends median lifespan 12% in female mice
    Lifespan Research Institute 报告：晚年给予三组分「抗衰老疫苗」可降低衰老标志物，使雌性 B6 小鼠中位寿命延长 12%。研究提示帮助免疫系统清除「僵尸细胞」可影响衰老结局，但对照组本身寿命偏短，结论仍需更严格设计验证，目前尚无人体数据。
    Lifespan Research Institute reports that late-life treatment with a three-element senolytic vaccine lowered senescence markers and increased median lifespan by 12% in female B6 mice. The work suggests helping the immune system clear zombie cells can shift ageing outcomes, but the short-lived controls complicate interpretation and no human data exist yet.
  • 核内 NAD⁺ 维持先天免疫记忆，补充 NMN 可找回老龄小鼠的抗肿瘤免疫
    Nuclear NAD+ sustains innate immune memory; NMN restores it in aged mice
    中国团队在《Science Immunology》发表：核内 NAD⁺ 通过抑制 KDM5A 依赖的组蛋白去甲基化维持先天免疫记忆，补充 NMN 可恢复老龄小鼠受损的 β-葡聚糖训练性抗肿瘤效应。作者强调训练在肿瘤接种前完成，不能据此认为 NMN 可治疗已形成的肿瘤。
    A Chinese team in Science Immunology shows nuclear NAD+ sustains innate immune memory by inhibiting KDM5A-dependent histone demethylation, and NMN supplementation restored impaired β-glucan-trained anti-tumour responses in aged and Nampt-deficient mice. The authors stress the training was given before tumour inoculation, so NMN cannot be assumed to treat established tumours; human evidence remains correlative.
  • 长寿时代应把脑卒中视为「生物衰老加速」的预警信号
    In the longevity era, stroke should be read as accelerated biological ageing
    神经科专家提出，卒中预防应跳出分项管控危险因素的模式，把生物学年龄纳入风险评估，将卒中视作衰老进程失衡的外在表现。核心干预仍是控压、地中海饮食、每周 150 分钟有氧、每天 6 小时以上睡眠与他汀、房颤规范治疗；文章提醒生物年龄检测与全身 MRI 证据不足，颈动脉斑块负荷更可靠。
    Neurologists argue that stroke prevention should move beyond managing individual risk factors, incorporating biological age and treating stroke as an external sign of dysregulated ageing. Core interventions remain blood pressure control, a Mediterranean diet, 150 minutes of weekly aerobic exercise, six-plus hours of sleep, statins and proper atrial fibrillation treatment. The authors caution that biological age tests and whole-body MRI lack evidence, whereas carotid plaque burden is more reliable.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 每天两份带皮烤花生 16 周：老年人胰岛素敏感性与记忆同步改善
    Two daily servings of roasted peanuts for 16 weeks improve insulin and memory
    ScienceDaily 报道一项干预研究：老年人连续 16 周每天摄入约两份无盐带皮烘烤花生，胰岛素敏感性改善，记忆与认知测试表现优于对照。研究者强调这是特定食物、特定剂量下的短期结果，不能替代整体膳食模式，也不意味着花生可普遍用于预防认知衰退。
    ScienceDaily reports an intervention study in which older adults ate about two servings of unsalted, skin-roasted peanuts daily for 16 weeks, improving insulin sensitivity and scoring better on memory and cognitive tests than controls. The researchers stress these are short-term results for one food at one dose and no substitute for an overall dietary pattern.
  • 48 万国人 9 年随访：习惯性喝茶与血管病风险下降 11% 相关
    Tea habit linked to 11% lower vascular risk in 486,000 Chinese adults
    《Journal of Internal Medicine》研究随访 48 万余国人中位 9 年：每周饮茶≥3 天者血管病风险低 11%；红茶优于绿茶，烫茶风险升高约 16%，中等浓度、每天 6~8 杯最低；「喝茶＋不吸烟＋高运动量」组合降 45.2%。属观察性研究，不宜直接推论因果。
    A Journal of Internal Medicine study following more than 486,000 Chinese adults for a median nine years found that drinking tea at least three days a week was associated with 11% lower vascular disease risk. Black tea outperformed green, warm tea beat scalding tea (which raised risk about 16%), and six to eight cups of moderate strength showed the lowest risk; tea plus non-smoking and high activity cut risk 45.2%. Observational only.
  • 中国食品科技年会昆明开幕：「AI＋精准营养＋智能制造」成新落点
    CIFST annual meeting in Kunming puts AI-driven precision nutrition centre stage
    中国食品科学技术学会第二十三届年会 10 月 31 日在昆明开幕。谢明勇院士提出「AI＋精准营养＋智能制造」是新质生产力在食品业的落脚点，涵盖功能因子发现、生物合成与个体化营养；胡小松介绍海淀数智食堂每天 600 余人就餐的「精准营养＋AI 大模型」实践，显示精准营养正从概念走向餐饮与产品场景。
    The 23rd annual meeting of the Chinese Institute of Food Science and Technology opened in Kunming on 31 October. Academician Xie Mingyong called AI plus precision nutrition plus smart manufacturing the industry's new productivity frontier, spanning functional factor discovery, biosynthesis and personalised nutrition, while Hu Xiaosong presented a Haidian digital canteen serving 600-plus people daily as a precision-nutrition plus large-model testbed.
  • 减肥不必戒碳水：高质量碳水才是体重管理与血糖的关键
    Don't cut carbs, upgrade them: quality carbohydrates for weight and glucose
    光明网科普指出，《中国居民膳食指南（2022）》建议碳水供能占 50%~65%，盲目戒碳水会带来营养不良、肌肉流失、记忆力下降与情绪低落。体重管理的关键在「选对碳水」：全谷物、薯类、杂豆与低 GI 水果具备高纤维、高营养密度、低升糖特点，并建议多种全谷物轮换、杂豆配谷物、薯类替代部分米面。
    Guangming Online notes that China's 2022 dietary guidelines advise carbohydrates to supply 50-65% of energy, and that cutting them outright risks malnutrition, muscle loss, poorer memory and low mood. Weight management hinges on choosing better carbs: whole grains, tubers, pulses and low-GI fruit, which are fibre-rich, nutrient-dense and slow to raise glucose, with variety and partial replacement of refined staples recommended.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 维生素 A 的新发现改写视觉发育认知，但离「补维 A」建议还很远
    New vitamin A finding rewrites vision development, but not supplement advice
    约翰斯·霍普金斯大学团队发现一种帮助人类在出生前形成敏锐视力的新过程，挑战了数十年来关于眼睛如何形成的假设。该成果属发育生物学基础研究，提示视觉精细环路的建立涉及此前未被认识的通路；研究者未据此提出任何维生素 A 补充建议，过量补充仍有安全边界。
    Johns Hopkins scientists uncovered a process that helps humans develop sharp vision before birth, challenging decades of assumptions about how the eye forms. The work is basic developmental biology, suggesting previously unrecognised pathways in building fine visual circuits; the team draws no supplementation advice from it, and vitamin A excess still carries safety limits.
  • 百元「维生素文身贴」走红：无透皮数据，也走不了保健食品备案
    Viral vitamin tattoo patches lack skin-absorption data and legal pathway
    中国宁波网调查售价百元的「维生素文身贴」：宣称贴手臂即可补充维生素、提升免疫，但公开渠道找不到人体透皮实验数据。浙江大学沈立荣指出，标注 1mg 锌、5mg 接骨木果提取物不等于能透皮入血达到有效剂量；此类外用贴剂无法申报保健食品，宣称「补充维生素」涉嫌违规，建议优先选择蓝帽子口服产品。
    China Ningbo Net investigated 100-yuan vitamin tattoo patches claiming that sticking one on the arm supplies vitamins and boosts immunity, yet no human skin-absorption data are publicly available. Zhejiang University's Shen Lirong notes that listing 1 mg zinc and 5 mg elderberry extract does not mean they cross the skin at effective doses; such topical patches cannot be registered as health foods, and the vitamin claims carry compliance risk.
  • 69% 爆品红不过一个月：保健品竞争从流量转向成分与复购
    69% of hit supplements fade within a month as competition shifts to retention
    果壳梳理抖音滋补保健榜单 21 个月数据：943 个曾进月榜 Top100 的商品中 651 个「红不过第二个月」，仅 8 个长期在榜；占 69% 的「一月游」爆品累计销售额与常青款相差 10 倍。文章以定制营养小程序复购率 30% 为例，认为竞争正从投流转为成分透明与长期跟踪。
    Guokr analysed 21 months of Douyin supplement rankings: of 943 products that entered the monthly top 100, 651 faded before a second month and only eight stayed throughout, with one-month wonders making up 69% of entries yet trailing evergreen products tenfold in cumulative sales. A customised-nutrition mini-program with 30% repurchase rates, four times the category norm, is cited as evidence that competition is shifting from ad spend to ingredient transparency and follow-up.
  • 2026 共识解读：维生素 D 不用于糖尿病血糖管理，窗口在糖尿病前期
    2026 consensus: vitamin D is not for glycaemic control, the window is prediabetes
    科学网梳理 2026 年维生素 D 与血糖证据：ADA/EASD 10 月共识明确「当前证据不支持维生素 D 用于 2 型糖尿病患者血糖管理」，也不推荐特定补充剂降糖；但糖尿病前期人群的荟萃分析显示 HbA1c 可降约 0.48 个百分点。作者提示补充窗口可能在确诊之前。
    ScienceNet reviews the 2026 evidence on vitamin D and glucose: an October ADA/EASD consensus states current evidence does not support vitamin D for glycaemic management in type 2 diabetes, nor specific supplements for lowering glucose, while meta-analyses in prediabetes show HbA1c down about 0.48 points and fasting glucose down about 0.46 mmol/L. The window for benefit may therefore precede diagnosis.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 长寿医学与生活方式医学北大国际论坛 11 月 13 日开幕，设功能医学实操培训
    Peking University forum pairs longevity and lifestyle medicine in November
    北大医疗集团与北京大学国际医院将于 11 月 13—20 日举办「长寿医学与生活方式医学北大国际论坛」，设主旨演讲、闭门研讨与《功能医学在临床中的应用》手把手培训班，议题覆盖长寿蓝区与地中海饮食、体重管理、脑健康、围绝经期、免疫健康与个性化营养，并成立「健康中国生活方式医学 30 人论坛」智库。
    PKU Healthcare Group and Peking University International Hospital will host a longevity and lifestyle medicine forum from 13 to 20 November, combining keynote sessions, closed-door workshops and a hands-on course on functional medicine in clinical practice. Topics span blue zones and the Mediterranean diet, weight management, brain health, perimenopause, immune health and personalised nutrition, alongside a new 30-expert lifestyle medicine think tank.
  • 第九届中华健康节启幕：食药同源从传统滋补走向日常快消
    Ninth Chinese Health Festival opens as medicinal foods go mainstream
    第九届中华健康节 10 月 31 日在石家庄以岭健康城启幕，主题「身体需要经营，健康需要管理」。会议围绕通络养生八字经、营养保健食品循证化、食药同源从传统滋补走向日常快消、AI 与大数据赋能大健康展开；以岭健康科技与腾讯、中国老龄产业协会等签约，布局银发经济与线下药店「健康＋」场景。
    The ninth Chinese Health Festival opened on 31 October at Yiling Health City in Shijiazhuang under the theme that the body needs managing and health needs stewardship. Sessions covered the collateral-unblocking wellness framework, evidence-based claims for supplements, medicinal foods moving from tonic traditions to everyday fast-moving goods, and AI in healthcare; Yiling signed partnerships with Tencent and the China Ageing Industry Association to build out the silver economy and pharmacy health-plus services.
  • 南京赛虹桥启用运动促进健康中心：运动处方接进家庭医生随访
    Nanjing community opens exercise-for-health centre tied to family doctors
    南京雨花台区赛虹桥街道启用运动促进健康中心并发布「行动力」体卫融合品牌：社区点负责初筛与日常锻炼指导，中心承担深度评估与复杂病例运动干预，形成「社区发现—医院解决—回社区管理」闭环；运动处方接入家庭医生随访，健康管理能力被纳入基层治理考核，一年后出具居民运动干预真实效果报告。
    Saihongqiao subdistrict in Nanjing's Yuhuatai district opened an exercise-for-health centre and launched its health-fitness integration brand: community sites screen and coach daily activity while the centre handles deep assessment and complex cases, closing a loop from community detection to hospital solutions to community management. Exercise prescriptions now feed family-doctor follow-up, health management counts in grassroots governance metrics, and a real-world outcome report is due in a year.
  • AI 精准长寿管理落地广东 16 个专病方向，专家点出五个「断点」
    AI longevity management lands in 16 specialties, but five gaps remain
    在广东省医学会健康管理与互联网医疗联合大会上，OMYQS 发布精准长寿健康管理生态，已在广东省第二人民医院 16 个主动健康专病方向落地。首席 AI 科学家王皓指出 AI 进入持续管理的五个断点：信息接不上、记录连不清、结果接不进流程、过程查不全、经验协同难。
    At the Guangdong Medical Association's health management and internet medicine congress, OMYQS launched a precision longevity management ecosystem now deployed across 16 proactive-health specialties at Guangdong Second Provincial General Hospital. Chief AI scientist Wang Hao named five gaps blocking continuous AI-driven care: fragmented history, disconnected records, outputs that never reach workflows, untraceable reasoning and hard-to-share expertise, urging that disability prevention start in the functionally robust and mildly impaired.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-31
item.description: 2026-10-31 简报，共 20 条：《Immunity》：肠道 Tfh 细胞衰老让「吃牛磺酸的菌」失控，是肥胖的新上游；《Immunity》空间转录组：IBD 肠壁里贴着一群 TMIGD2hi 致病性 Th17；巴戟天寡糖改善卒中后抑郁：肠菌多样性、丁酸与海马 Pla2g4a 三点连成线；心梗之前肠道或已报警：促炎链球菌升高、产丁酸菌减少；Eos 线粒体靶向 geropeptide PTC-2105：老年大鼠 16 周保住运动能力，脂肪减少；抑制一个「越老越忙」的酶：小鼠平均寿命延长 17%，衰弱与记忆同步改善；百岁老人的心血管「韧性」：炎症能收能放，肠道菌群反而更年轻；《Cell》：首个衰老生物学 AI 基准 LongevityBench 发布，小模型胜过拼规模；每天 200 克番茄加 50 克番茄酱，6 周后脂肪肝指标降得更多；儿童营养从「吃饱」「吃好」到「吃对」：隐性饥饿与营养素协同；膳食多样性指标怎么用才不算误读：从食物计数到个体化评估；乳企转向精准营养：功能保健食品前三季度翻倍，益生菌与蛋白补充剂成五年战略；ESMO：处方级 EPA 让肠癌肝转移术后五年生存升至 62%，但未延缓复发；国内首款苯丙酮尿症氨基酸组件特医食品发布：蛋白等同物 95 克/百克；汤臣倍健三季报：维生素 D 保留率 +25.6%，辅酶 Q10 生物利用度 151%；日本把男性更年期列为社会议题，补剂厂商盯上「职场男性」新赛道；贵州部署 2026 年基本公卫：慢病红黄绿分级、一站式中心、健康积分；毕节构建「1+9+N」慢病防治体系：2030 年过早死亡率降到 13% 以下；湘潭岳塘「减盐减油」：三师共管、定制服务包，把体重管理写进家医签约；第十一届柳叶刀—中国医学科学院大会：AI 临床创新与健康老龄化同台
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 《Immunity》：肠道 Tfh 细胞衰老让「吃牛磺酸的菌」失控，是肥胖的新上游
    Immunity: Aged gut Tfh cells let taurine-consuming bacteria drive obesity
    上海交大医学院团队在《Immunity》揭示，VEGF-B/VEGFR-1 轴经 AKT-MDM2-p53 维持肠道滤泡辅助性 T 细胞干性，保障分泌型 IgA；该轴失灵后 Taurinivorans 菌过度增殖、耗竭肠道牛磺酸，抑制脂肪 AMPK 产热而致肥胖，补充 IgA 或牛磺酸可逆转。
