    A Shanghai Jiao Tong University team reported in Immunity that the VEGF-B/VEGFR-1 axis sustains gut follicular helper T cell stemness through AKT-MDM2-p53, safeguarding secretory IgA. When the axis fails, Taurinivorans overgrows, depletes gut taurine and suppresses adipose AMPK-driven thermogenesis, driving obesity; IgA or taurine supplementation reversed it in mice.
  • 《Immunity》空间转录组：IBD 肠壁里贴着一群 TMIGD2hi 致病性 Th17
    Immunity spatial transcriptomics maps a TMIGD2hi pathogenic Th17 subset in IBD
    博德研究所团队用单细胞转录组、TCR 测序与 Xenium 空间转录组，在 IBD 患者肠组织鉴定出 TMIGD2hi Th17 亚群：其克隆扩增、高表达 GZMA、低表达干性基因 BACH2，并紧贴 HHLA2 阳性的肠上皮细胞，提示 TMIGD2-HHLA2 共刺激是潜在干预靶点。
    Using single-cell RNA sequencing, TCR sequencing and Xenium spatial transcriptomics, Broad Institute researchers identified a TMIGD2hi Th17 subset in IBD gut tissue: clonally expanded, high in GZMA, low in the stemness gene BACH2, and spatially adjacent to HHLA2-positive epithelium, pointing to the TMIGD2-HHLA2 costimulatory axis as a target.
  • 巴戟天寡糖改善卒中后抑郁：肠菌多样性、丁酸与海马 Pla2g4a 三点连成线
    Morinda oligosaccharides ease post-stroke depression via butyrate and hippocampal Pla2g4a
    《CNS Neuroscience & Therapeutics》刊发小鼠研究：巴戟天寡糖可改善卒中后抑郁样行为，同时恢复肠道菌群多样性与丁酸水平、修复肠道与海马屏障、降低海马 Pla2g4a 表达；丁酸钠单独给药亦有抗抑郁效应，粪菌移植提供了初步因果证据。
    A mouse study in CNS Neuroscience & Therapeutics found Morinda officinalis oligosaccharides eased post-stroke depression-like behaviour while restoring gut microbial diversity and butyrate, repairing gut and hippocampal barriers and lowering hippocampal Pla2g4a. Sodium butyrate alone helped, and faecal transplant offered preliminary causal evidence.
  • 心梗之前肠道或已报警：促炎链球菌升高、产丁酸菌减少
    The gut may signal a heart attack before it happens
    光明网援引研究称，急性心梗发作期患者肠道菌群明显失衡——促炎链球菌大幅升高、产丁酸保护菌下降，心梗后半年多可恢复；长期菌群紊乱通过炎症代谢物损伤血管内皮、加速动脉粥样硬化，因此被视作值得关注的预警信号，而非心梗的直接后果。
    Citing research, Guangming Online reported that gut microbiota shifts markedly during acute myocardial infarction — pro-inflammatory streptococci rise while butyrate-producing protective bacteria fall — and largely normalises within six months. Chronic dysbiosis is seen as an early warning signal that damages endothelium and accelerates atherosclerosis, not a consequence of the event.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • Eos 线粒体靶向 geropeptide PTC-2105：老年大鼠 16 周保住运动能力，脂肪减少
    Eos MitoXcel geropeptide PTC-2105 preserves motor function in aged rats at 16 weeks
    Eos SENOLYTIX 公布 PTC-2105 在 24—26 月龄老年大鼠的 16 周中期数据：每周一次皮下给药组转棒耐力维持在基线附近，对照组下降约 76%，握力增加 30.7%（对照 7.3%），第 8 周脂肪减少更多，为 2027 年首次人体试验提供第二物种证据。
    Eos SENOLYTIX reported 16-week interim data for PTC-2105 in 24–26-month-old rats: weekly subcutaneous dosing kept rotarod endurance near baseline versus a roughly 76% decline in controls, raised grip strength by 30.7% (controls 7.3%) and produced greater fat loss at week 8, adding second-species support for first-in-human trials targeted at 2027.
  • 抑制一个「越老越忙」的酶：小鼠平均寿命延长 17%，衰弱与记忆同步改善
    Blocking an age-overactive enzyme extended mouse lifespan by 17%
    中国团队在《iScience》报告，天冬酰胺内肽酶（AEP/legumain）抑制剂 #11a 从 18 月龄起喂养老鼠，平均寿命由 24 个月延至 28 个月（+17%），衰弱指标、运动与记忆表现及胰岛素敏感性均改善，炎症与细胞衰老信号减少；机制与长期安全性仍待验证。
    A Chinese team reported in iScience that the asparagine endopeptidase (AEP/legumain) inhibitor #11a, given from 18 months of age, extended mean mouse lifespan from 24 to 28 months (+17%), with fewer frailty signs, better exercise, strength and memory performance, improved insulin sensitivity and less inflammation and cellular senescence; mechanisms and long-term safety remain unproven.
  • 百岁老人的心血管「韧性」：炎症能收能放，肠道菌群反而更年轻
    Cardiovascular resilience in centenarians: balanced inflammation and a youthful gut
    《Nature Reviews Cardiology》综述：百岁老人促炎与抗炎因子（IL-10、TGF-β）高水平平衡，肠道菌群年轻化且 zonulin、LPS 更低，富集保护性变异并抵抗克隆性造血，表观年龄比实际年轻 15—29 岁；提示收缩压目标 130—150 mmHg 更稳妥。
    A Nature Reviews Cardiology review describes centenarian cardiovascular resilience: pro- and anti-inflammatory mediators (IL-10, TGF-β) stay balanced at high levels, the gut microbiome retains youthful features with lower zonulin and LPS, protective variants are enriched and clonal haematopoiesis resisted, and epigenetic age runs 15–29 years younger; systolic targets of 130–150 mmHg are advised.
  • 《Cell》：首个衰老生物学 AI 基准 LongevityBench 发布，小模型胜过拼规模
    Cell: LongevityBench sets a first open benchmark for AI in aging biology
    英矽智能在《Cell》发布首个衰老生物学开放基准 LongevityBench：17 项任务覆盖临床记录、DNA 甲基化、转录组、蛋白组与遗传学五大域、25457 条提示，评测 18 个前沿大模型；结果显示在衰老数据上微调的小模型优于单纯扩大规模，并开放智能体接口 Longevity Claw。
    Insilico Medicine published LongevityBench in Cell, the first open benchmark for AI in aging biology: 17 tasks spanning clinical records, DNA methylation, transcriptomics, proteomics and genetics, with 25,457 prompts evaluating 18 frontier models. Small models fine-tuned on aging data outperformed scale alone, and an agent interface, Longevity Claw, was released alongside.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 每天 200 克番茄加 50 克番茄酱，6 周后脂肪肝指标降得更多
    200 g of tomatoes plus 50 g of paste daily lowered liver fat over six weeks
    意大利 IRCCS 团队 POMOSANO 随机对照试验纳入 79 名 MASLD 患者，干预组每日食用 200 g 生番茄加 50 g 番茄酱、持续 6 周，肝脂肪变性指标 CAP 降幅显著大于严格无番茄对照组，体成分由双能 X 线评估，为番茄作为膳食干预手段添了 RCT 证据。
    The Italian IRCCS POMOSANO randomised trial enrolled 79 MASLD patients; six weeks of 200 g raw tomatoes plus 50 g tomato paste daily produced a significantly greater drop in CAP-measured liver steatosis than a strict tomato-free control diet, with body composition assessed by DXA, adding RCT evidence for tomato-based dietary intervention.
  • 儿童营养从「吃饱」「吃好」到「吃对」：隐性饥饿与营养素协同
    From enough food to the right food: hidden hunger and nutrient synergy in children
    美赞臣中国研发负责人熊辉指出，中国儿童营养已从单一营养素缺乏转为缺乏与过剩并存，热量足而维生素矿物质不足形成「隐性饥饿」；精准营养需依膳食参考摄入量设计、讲究营养素协同与吸收利用，其科学成长营养系统围绕骨骼、脑眼、肠道、自护四维复配。
    Mead Johnson China R&D head Xiong Hui said child nutrition in China has shifted from single-deficiency to coexisting deficiency and excess, with adequate calories but insufficient vitamins and minerals — so-called hidden hunger. Precision nutrition should follow dietary reference intakes and nutrient synergy and absorption; its growth nutrition system combines prebiotics and bioactive peptides across bone, brain-eye, gut and immunity.
  • 膳食多样性指标怎么用才不算误读：从食物计数到个体化评估
    How to read dietary diversity indicators without misinterpreting them
    一篇综述梳理膳食多样性指标从食物计数、食物组多样性到复合指数、可持续性与个体化评估的演化，指出指标效度更取决于所测构念、分析单位与应用场景是否一致，而非方法复杂程度；多样性高并不等于更健康，呼吁统一食物分类、参考期与评分报告标准。
    A review traced dietary diversity indicators from food counts and food-group diversity to composite indices, sustainability and individualised assessment, arguing that validity depends less on methodological complexity than on alignment between the construct measured, the unit of analysis and the intended use. Higher diversity does not equal healthier diets, and harmonised food classification, reference periods and scoring are needed.
  • 乳企转向精准营养：功能保健食品前三季度翻倍，益生菌与蛋白补充剂成五年战略
    Dairy giant pivots to precision nutrition as functional health food sales double
    伊利三季报显示，功能保健食品前三季度实现翻倍增长，益生菌与蛋白质补充剂被列为未来五年重点发力的战略新兴品类；成人营养以「欣活」骨能提出骨、关、肌三位一体方案，并计划由成人奶粉向特医食品、功能保健延伸，折射乳企向精准营养要增量。
    Yili's third-quarter report shows functional health foods doubled year on year in the first nine months, with probiotics and protein supplements named strategic emerging categories for the next five years. Its adult nutrition brand Xinhui proposes an integrated bone-joint-muscle formula and plans to expand from adult milk powder into foods for special medical purposes, reflecting dairy's push into precision nutrition.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • ESMO：处方级 EPA 让肠癌肝转移术后五年生存升至 62%，但未延缓复发
    ESMO: prescription-grade EPA lifted five-year survival to 62% after colorectal liver surgery, without delaying relapse
    ESMO 2026 公布 EMT2 三期试验：418 例可切除肠癌肝转移患者每日 4 g 高纯度 EPA，五年总生存 62.0% 对安慰剂 45.1%，死亡风险比 0.68；但主要终点无进展生存未过关（13.5 对 12.9 个月），出血与房颤未增加，申办方暂不申请该适应症。
    The phase 3 EMT2 trial presented at ESMO 2026 gave 418 patients with resectable colorectal cancer liver metastases 4 g daily of high-purity EPA (icosapent ethyl): five-year overall survival was 62.0% versus 45.1% with placebo (hazard ratio 0.68), yet the primary progression-free survival endpoint failed (13.5 vs 12.9 months). Bleeding and atrial fibrillation did not increase, and no label filing is planned for now.
  • 国内首款苯丙酮尿症氨基酸组件特医食品发布：蛋白等同物 95 克/百克
    China's first PKU amino acid formula for special medical purposes launched
    国内首款苯丙酮尿症氨基酸组件特医食品「光明爱普昔」在上海发布，由上海交大医学院附属新华医院蔡威团队研发、光明乳业产业化，今年 8 月获市场监管总局注册；产品不含苯丙氨酸，蛋白质等同物达 95 g/100 g，面向大龄儿童、青少年与成人患者，打破进口依赖。
    Guangming Aipuxi, China's first amino acid formula for special medical purposes for phenylketonuria, launched in Shanghai. Developed by Cai Wei's team at Xinhua Hospital affiliated to Shanghai Jiao Tong University School of Medicine and industrialised by Bright Dairy, it was registered in August. Phenylalanine-free with 95 g protein equivalent per 100 g, it targets older children, adolescents and adults, ending import reliance.
  • 汤臣倍健三季报：维生素 D 保留率 +25.6%，辅酶 Q10 生物利用度 151%
    By-health Q3: vitamin D retention up 25.6%, CoQ10 bioavailability 151%
    汤臣倍健三季报显示连续五个季度营收增长：自研乳化技术使维生素 D 保留率提升 25.6%，红芯辅酶 Q10 生物利用度达 151%，三合一鱼油上市 9 天销售额破百万；公司累计专利 439 项、保健食品注册证 141 个、备案凭证 227 个、SCI 论文 170 篇。
    By-health reported a fifth consecutive quarter of revenue growth: an in-house emulsification technology raised vitamin D retention by 25.6%, its red-core coenzyme Q10 reached 151% bioavailability, and a three-in-one fish oil passed one million yuan in sales nine days after launch. The company holds 439 patents, 141 health-food registrations, 227 filings and 170 SCI papers.
  • 日本把男性更年期列为社会议题，补剂厂商盯上「职场男性」新赛道
    Japan flags andropause as a social issue, opening supplement opportunities
    日本原料商 Octroll 在 Hi Japan 2026 表示，随着政府把男性更年期列为社会议题（相关年经济损失约 2 万亿日元，约 127 亿美元），消费者认知提升正为补剂打开新空间；其思路是用传统上用于提升睾酮与运动表现的原料缓解症状，职场健康管理被视为重要切入口。
    Japanese ingredient supplier Octroll told NutraIngredients at Hi Japan 2026 that government recognition of andropause as a social issue — with related annual economic losses estimated at about ¥2 trillion (US$12.7 billion) — is raising consumer awareness and opening supplement opportunities. Its approach repurposes ingredients traditionally used for testosterone and sports performance, with workplace health programmes seen as a key entry point.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 贵州部署 2026 年基本公卫：慢病红黄绿分级、一站式中心、健康积分
    Guizhou sets 2026 public health services: traffic-light chronic disease tiers and health points
    贵州省卫健委等四部门部署 2026 年基本公共卫生服务：探索健康积分兑换，推动乡镇与社区提供周末接种；基层设一站式慢病健康管理中心，按红黄绿三类分级管理，并将高血压、2 型糖尿病、高脂血症、肥胖症的膳食运动指导要点嵌入医生工作站，年内覆盖三分之二以上基层机构。
    Guizhou's health commission and three other departments set 2026 basic public health tasks: piloting redeemable health points, offering weekend vaccination at township and community facilities, building one-stop chronic disease centres with red-yellow-green risk tiers, and embedding dietary and exercise guidance for hypertension, type 2 diabetes, hyperlipidaemia and obesity into clinician workstations in over two-thirds of primary facilities within the year.
  • 毕节构建「1+9+N」慢病防治体系：2030 年过早死亡率降到 13% 以下
    Bijie builds a 1+9+N chronic disease system, targeting premature mortality below 13% by 2030
    毕节市印发慢性病防治体系建设实施方案（2026—2030 年），构建「1+9+N」体系与市、县、乡、村四级网络，2026 年建成心脑血管、肿瘤、呼吸三大市级诊疗中心，2030 年重大慢性病过早死亡率降至 13% 以下、癌症五年生存率 46.6%、人均预期寿命约 78 岁。
    Bijie issued a 2026–2030 chronic disease prevention and control plan built on a 1+9+N structure and a four-tier city-county-township-village network. By 2026 three municipal centres for cardiovascular, cancer and respiratory disease should operate; by 2030 premature mortality from major chronic diseases should fall below 13%, cancer five-year survival reach 46.6% and life expectancy about 78 years.
  • 湘潭岳塘「减盐减油」：三师共管、定制服务包，把体重管理写进家医签约
    Xiangtan Yuelang cuts salt and oil with three-professional teams and tailored service packages
    湘潭市岳塘区以机关先行、企业联动推进减盐减油精准干预：把减盐减油与体重管理纳入家庭医生签约，组建「三师共管」团队，为 25—60 岁超重肥胖及高血压、糖尿病高危人群提供免费筛查、体质评估、膳食运动处方与随访，并发放限盐勺、控油壶、智能体脂秤，配套线上打卡复盘。
    Yuelang district in Xiangtan is rolling out targeted salt and oil reduction, starting with government offices and linking enterprises: the programme is folded into family doctor contracts with three-professional teams serving overweight and high-risk adults aged 25–60 through free screening, constitution assessment, diet and exercise prescriptions and follow-up, plus portion spoons, oil pots and smart scales with online check-ins.
  • 第十一届柳叶刀—中国医学科学院大会：AI 临床创新与健康老龄化同台
    11th Lancet–CAMS conference pairs AI in clinical innovation with healthy ageing
    第十一届柳叶刀—中国医学科学院医学与健康大会 10 月 30—31 日在北京举行，由中国医学科学院北京协和医学院与《柳叶刀》共同举办，聚焦人工智能与临床创新、健康老龄化及重大公共卫生问题，集中分享多项针对中国健康挑战的《柳叶刀》委员会报告，并设呼吸病学、公共卫生等中国专刊专场。
    The 11th Lancet–Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences Conference runs in Beijing on 30–31 October, co-hosted by CAMS/Peking Union Medical College and The Lancet. It focuses on AI and clinical innovation, healthy ageing and major public health challenges, presenting several Lancet Commission reports on China's health issues alongside special issues in respiratory medicine, public health and Western Pacific regional health.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-30
item.description: 2026-10-30 简报，共 20 条：《Microbiome》：压力先引爆肠道活性氧，短链脂肪酸先崩、菌群结构后变；《Nature Communications》：肠道 AhR 失活，让真菌失调演变为重症哮喘；第七届「钱潮论健」杭州闭幕：功能医学从被动治疗转向主动健康；《Nature》：发病前后 4 天吃错，炎症记忆能留半年；中国抗衰老促进会长寿医学专业委员会成立，发布《中国长寿医学发展倡议》；《Aging Cell》：星形胶质细胞 FGF13 上调，让小鼠全身衰老减速；Life Biosciences 公布 ER-100 首个 I 期人体数据：3 例青光眼患者耐受良好；中年早期用二甲双胍：小鼠衰弱减轻，肌力与骨微结构保住；《PNAS》双篇：同样吃高脂，为何有人更容易胖——17 个 SNP 解释约 87% 增重差异；韩国 CJ Bioscience 发布本土肠道菌群靶向饮食指数，万人外部验证优于现有指数；中国农科院食物营养健康青年科学家座谈会在深圳召开，聚焦精准营养与主动健康；康宝莱进博会亚洲首秀 Bioniq GO：40 种配方按数字化评估匹配；SupplySide Global 2026 原料之星揭晓：长寿、生物制剂、适应原与 GLP-1 成主角；三菱商事生命科学：NMN 拓展至护发场景，半胱氨酸主打皮肤提亮；英国 FSE 发布网红营销新指南，剑指补剂误导性宣称；dsm-firmenich 在 SupplySide 推出「长寿转变 2.0：肠道效应」；RESET for Remission：低热量饮食加运动，54% 年轻 2 型糖尿病 6 个月缓解；《国家残疾预防行动计划（2026—2030 年）》发布：18 项指标、居民健康素养达 40%；世界卒中日：《成人脑卒中食养指南（2026 年版）》给出全国七大地区四季食谱；广东启动企联医疗健康服务平台，「粤小医」接管体检之后的长期管护
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 《Microbiome》：压力先引爆肠道活性氧，短链脂肪酸先崩、菌群结构后变
    Microbiome: Stress first triggers an intestinal ROS burst, collapsing short-chain fatty acids before the microbiome shifts
    斑马鱼实验中，应激数小时内肠道远端活性氧骤升，此时菌群结构未变，但厌氧发酵被抑制、短链脂肪酸急降；上皮产能受损后肠腔低氧屏障失守，兼性致病菌得以扩张。拘束应激小鼠重现同一顺序，清除 ROS 或恢复上皮产能即可阻断失调。
    In zebrafish, intestinal reactive oxygen species surged in the distal gut within hours of stress, before any change in microbial composition. Anaerobic fermentation was selectively suppressed and short-chain fatty acid output fell sharply; epithelial PPARγ-dependent metabolism then weakened, the hypoxic barrier eroded and facultative pathobionts expanded. Restraint-stressed mice showed the same sequence. Neutralizing intestinal ROS or restoring epithelial bioenergetics prevented dysbiosis despite ongoing stress, pointing to the hypoxic barrier as a target.
  • 《Nature Communications》：肠道 AhR 失活，让真菌失调演变为重症哮喘
    Nature Communications: Loss of gut AhR turns fungal dysbiosis into severe asthma
    肠道上皮特异性敲除 AhR 的小鼠，在白色念珠菌与尘螨作用下暴发中性粒细胞性哮喘，气道以 Th17 为主。AhR 缺失使阿克曼氏菌锐减，肺部岩藻糖基化形成 sLeX「糖基化伪装」诱捕中性粒细胞，其胞外诱捕网再损伤上皮线粒体；补充菌源囊泡可逆转。
    Mice with intestinal epithelial AhR deletion developed neutrophilic asthma when exposed to Candida albicans plus house dust mite, with IL-17-producing Th17 cells rather than Th2 dominating the airway. AhR loss sharply reduced Akkermansia, raising pulmonary α1,2-fucosylation that produced an sLeX glycan disguise, trapping L-selectin-positive neutrophils on endothelium; their extracellular traps then impaired epithelial mitochondrial function. Neutrophil depletion or Akkermansia outer-membrane vesicles reversed the disease.
  • 第七届「钱潮论健」杭州闭幕：功能医学从被动治疗转向主动健康
    Seventh Qiantang Health Forum closes in Hangzhou as functional medicine pivots from treatment to proactive health
    10 月 23—25 日，浙江省健康服务业促进会功能医学分会学术年会暨第七届钱潮论健在杭州举行，设 1 个主会场与 5 个分会场，覆盖抗衰老、肠道健康管理、临床转化与运营模式；开幕式发布《甲状腺功能 28 天复原方案》，并研讨线粒体代谢、生物年龄评估、NAD+ 应用与 AI 健康管理闭环。
    Held in Hangzhou on October 23–25 and hosted by Sir Run Run Shaw Hospital, the annual meeting of the Zhejiang Functional Medicine Branch and the seventh Qiantang Health Forum drew over a hundred specialists with one plenary and five breakout tracks covering anti-aging, gut health management, clinical translation and clinic operations. The opening released a 28-day thyroid restoration protocol, with sessions on mitochondrial energetics, biological age assessment, clinical NAD+ use and AI-driven closed-loop health management.
  • 《Nature》：发病前后 4 天吃错，炎症记忆能留半年
    Nature: Four days of the wrong diet at disease onset leaves inflammatory memory for months
    银屑病样皮肤炎症模型显示，高脂饮食只需在发病前 3 天至发病后 1 天这 4 天窗口给予，即可放大炎症，与是否肥胖无关；已肥胖小鼠在该窗口换低脂饮食同样能抵消。该窗口塑造组织驻留记忆 CD4 T 细胞，使 25 天后再次激发复发更重，效应持续至少 6.5 个月。
    Using a psoriasis-like skin inflammation model, researchers found that a high-fat diet given only during a four-day window — three days before to one day after onset — amplified inflammation, independent of obesity. Switching already-obese mice to low-fat food within that window abolished the effect, showing diet state rather than body weight sets inflammatory amplitude. The window imprinted tissue-resident memory CD4 T cells, making rechallenge 25 days later faster and more severe, persisting at least 6.5 months and only at the original site.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 中国抗衰老促进会长寿医学专业委员会成立，发布《中国长寿医学发展倡议》
    China Anti-Aging Promotion Association launches Longevity Medicine Committee and development initiative
    10 月 27 日，2026 长寿医学大会暨中国抗衰老促进会长寿医学专业委员会成立大会在北京举行，屈伟当选首任主委。大会发布《中国长寿医学发展倡议》十二项内容与五条底线，严禁夸大宣传、越界行医、滥用健康数据、制造衰老焦虑，不承诺「逆龄」「治愈衰老」，并启动六项工作计划。
    The 2026 Longevity Medicine Conference in Beijing on October 27 saw the founding of the Longevity Medicine Committee under the China Anti-Aging Promotion Association, with Qu Wei as inaugural chair. The conference issued a 12-point China Longevity Medicine Development Initiative organised around three main lines and five red lines, explicitly banning exaggerated claims, practice beyond scope, misuse of health data and fear-based marketing, and refusing to promise rejuvenation or a cure for aging. Six work programmes were launched.
  • 《Aging Cell》：星形胶质细胞 FGF13 上调，让小鼠全身衰老减速
    Aging Cell: Boosting astrocytic FGF13 slows whole-body aging in mice
    FGF13 随年龄在星形胶质细胞中下降，与自噬蛋白 Phafin2 结合促进自噬。敲除老年小鼠星形胶质细胞 FGF13 会加重衰老、提高循环炎症因子；反向过表达后，水迷宫表现接近年轻鼠，血中 IFN-γ、IL-6 明显下降，皮肤、肝、脾、肾衰老标志减少，年龄相关增重减轻。
    FGF13 declines with age in astrocytes and binds Phafin2 to promote autophagy. Knocking it out in aged mouse astrocytes worsened aging: poorer Morris water maze performance, more senescent cells in heart, skin, liver, spleen and kidney, and higher circulating inflammatory cytokines, suggesting the brain amplifies aging signals to peripheral tissues. Overexpression restored spatial learning close to young levels, lowered IFN-γ and IL-6, reduced organ senescence markers and blunted age-related weight gain.
  • Life Biosciences 公布 ER-100 首个 I 期人体数据：3 例青光眼患者耐受良好
    Life Biosciences reports first-in-human Phase 1 data for ER-100: well tolerated in three glaucoma patients
    ER-100 用单次玻璃体内 AAV 递送 OSK 三因子，配合口服多西环素 8 周诱导表达，实现部分表观遗传重编程。3 例开角型青光眼患者至第 56 天耐受良好，无剂量限制毒性或严重不良事件；2 例视野改善，≥28% 检测点提升超 4 dB，安全监测委员会建议升至第二剂量组。
    ER-100 delivers OSK (OCT4, SOX2, KLF4) via a single intravitreal AAV injection with eight weeks of oral doxycycline to induce expression, achieving partial epigenetic reprogramming. In three open-angle glaucoma patients it was well tolerated through day 56, with no dose-limiting toxicity, adverse events of special interest or serious adverse events; all events related to the procedure, steroids or pre-existing conditions. Two of three showed visual field improvement, with at least 28% of test points gaining more than 4 dB, and the safety board endorsed dose escalation.
  • 中年早期用二甲双胍：小鼠衰弱减轻，肌力与骨微结构保住
    Metformin started in early midlife reduces frailty and preserves muscle and bone in mice
    《Biogerontology》研究让雄性小鼠从 30 周龄（约合人类 32—42 岁）起经饮水摄入 500 mg/kg/d 二甲双胍共 23 周。干预组体重趋近年轻组，临床与表现型衰弱指数显著下降，活动量、举重能力、倒屏跌落潜伏期改善，骨微结构维持，提示中年早期是延缓衰弱的窗口。
    In a Biogerontology study, male mice received metformin in drinking water at 500 mg/kg/day from 30 weeks of age — roughly 32–42 human years — for 23 weeks until 53 weeks. Treated animals stayed lighter than age-matched controls and approached young reference weights, scored markedly lower on both clinical and performance-based frailty indices, were more active in the open field, lifted more weight, held longer on the inverted screen and maintained bone microarchitecture, suggesting early midlife is a window for frailty prevention.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 《PNAS》双篇：同样吃高脂，为何有人更容易胖——17 个 SNP 解释约 87% 增重差异
    Two PNAS papers: Why some gain more on a high-fat diet — 17 SNPs explain about 87% of weight-gain variance
    以易胖 C57BL/6N 与抗胖 BALB/c 双向杂交建立 F2 群体，207 只雄性小鼠经 8 周高脂干预并结合遗传分型，研究者定位到涉及 Abcc3、Ahr、Nr1i3 等 11 个基因的 17 个 SNP，可解释约 87% 的增重差异；这些基因大多不在脑内表达，提示易感性主要由外周组织决定。
    Teams led by John R. Speakman (Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology) and Wuyingga (Inner Mongolia University) crossed obesity-prone C57BL/6N with resistant BALB/c mice to build an F2 population, then put 207 males on an eight-week high-fat diet with genotyping. They identified 17 SNPs across 11 genes including Abcc3, Ahr and Nr1i3 that explain roughly 87% of weight-gain variance; most are not expressed in the brain, suggesting peripheral tissues drive susceptibility.
  • 韩国 CJ Bioscience 发布本土肠道菌群靶向饮食指数，万人外部验证优于现有指数
    CJ Bioscience unveils Korean gut-microbiota-targeted diet index, outperforming existing indices in 10,000-person validation
    在韩国食品科学与营养学会国际会议上，CJ Bioscience 发布基于健康成人队列的「肠道菌群靶向饮食指数」，以约 1 万人公开数据外部验证，与临床指标相关性强于现有膳食指数，且仅需简化问卷即可评估；公司同时展示以微生物可利用碳水为基础的 MACPLAN 个性化方案与 DIGEST 肠模拟技术。
    At the Korean Society of Food Science and Nutrition conference in Jeju, CJ Bioscience presented a gut-microbiota-targeted diet index built from a cohort of healthy Korean adults. External validation in about 10,000 people from public data showed stronger associations with clinical indicators than existing dietary indices, and the tool needs only a simplified questionnaire, suiting diet-management apps. The company also showed MACPLAN, a personalised programme based on microbiota-accessible carbohydrates, plus probiotic-MAC combinations and gut-simulating DIGEST platforms.
  • 中国农科院食物营养健康青年科学家座谈会在深圳召开，聚焦精准营养与主动健康
    CAAS young scientist forum on food, nutrition and health opens in Shenzhen, spotlighting precision nutrition
    10 月 29 日，中国农科院食品营养学部主办的 2026 年食物营养健康青年科学家座谈会在深圳召开，提出按《中国食物与营养发展纲要（2025—2030 年）》统筹育种、加工、品质调控与标准体系。四个分论坛聚焦精准营养与主动健康、基因组学赋能个性化食品、智能加工、智链品质与安全。
    Hosted by the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences' food and nutrition division in Shenzhen on October 29, the forum urged aligning breeding, processing, quality control and standards with the 2025–2030 national food and nutrition outline, starting from human nutritional needs. Four sub-forums covered precision nutrition and proactive health, genomics-enabled personalised foods, intelligent processing, and supply-chain quality and safety; a joint laboratory on weight-management foods with Duoyanshou was also unveiled.
  • 康宝莱进博会亚洲首秀 Bioniq GO：40 种配方按数字化评估匹配
    Herbalife to debut Bioniq GO in Asia at CIIE, matching 40 formulas via digital assessment
    第九届进博会前，康宝莱宣布个性化营养产品 Bioniq GO 亚洲首秀、健康管理数字化平台中国版全球首展。Bioniq GO 通过数字化健康评估，从 40 种配方中匹配个人方案，采用瑞士颗粒技术；平台覆盖「评估—建议—规划—陪伴」全链路，把 AI 工具与营养顾问服务结合。
    Ahead of the ninth China International Import Expo, Herbalife said it will give Bioniq GO its Asian debut alongside the global première of a China-edition digital health management platform. Bioniq GO uses a digital health assessment to match individuals to one of 40 nutrition formulas, built on science-backed ingredients and Swiss granule technology for easier daily intake. The platform spans assessment, recommendation, planning and ongoing coaching, pairing AI tools with human nutrition advisers.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • SupplySide Global 2026 原料之星揭晓：长寿、生物制剂、适应原与 GLP-1 成主角
    SupplySide Global 2026 Ingredient Idol winners: longevity, biotics, adaptogens and GLP-1 lead
    第六届 Ingredient Idol 结果公布：补充剂长寿奖为 PLT Health 的 Kinexa 关节复方，生物制剂奖为 Helaina 发酵法人体乳铁蛋白，适应原奖为含 15% 沙塔瓦林的山羊豆根提取物；食品类 GLP-1 创新奖为 Formo 精密发酵酪蛋白，脑健康奖为 SunWay 的 ExoBDNF 益生菌。
    At the Las Vegas show, the sixth Ingredient Idol awards went to PLT Health's Kinexa joint longevity complex of standardised turmeric, Indian frankincense and haritaki in the supplements-longevity category; Helaina's fermentation-derived human lactoferrin effera in biotics; and Xeya, a shatavari root extract standardised to 15% shatavarins, in adaptogens. In food and beverage, Formo's precision-fermented casein won GLP-1 innovation and SunWay's ExoBDNF probiotic took brain health. Entries had to launch after January 2025.
  • 三菱商事生命科学：NMN 拓展至护发场景，半胱氨酸主打皮肤提亮
    Mitsubishi Corporation Life Science takes NMN into hair care, positions cysteine for skin brightening
    三菱商事生命科学为 NMN 寻找新定位，从口服抗衰延伸至头皮与毛囊护理，同时推进半胱氨酸在皮肤提亮方面的应用。公司称将围绕机制与人体数据补强证据，避免仅靠成分概念营销，反映日本原料商在 NAD+ 前体同质化竞争中转向细分场景与配方差异化。
    Mitsubishi Corporation Life Science is repositioning NMN beyond oral anti-aging into scalp and hair-follicle care, while advancing cysteine for skin brightening. The company said it will strengthen the evidence base around mechanisms and human data rather than relying on ingredient-story marketing. The move reflects how Japanese suppliers are seeking growth in a crowded NAD+ precursor category through niche use cases, delivery formats and formulation differentiation, shifting from broad anti-aging claims to specific perceivable benefits.
  • 英国 FSE 发布网红营销新指南，剑指补剂误导性宣称
    UK's FSE issues new influencer marketing guidance targeting misleading supplement claims
    英国食品补充剂行业机构 FSE 针对达人带货发布新指南，要求明确广告标识、不得暗示治疗或治愈疾病、不得使用未经批准的健康声称，并对「前后对比」「夸大减重」设限。此举回应监管与消费者对线上宣传合规性的关注，也为品牌与达人、MCN 合作划定边界。
    The UK Food Supplement industry body FSE published new guidance for social media influencer marketing, requiring clear ad labelling, banning any implication of treating or curing disease, prohibiting unapproved health claims and setting limits on before-and-after imagery and exaggerated weight-loss messaging. The move responds to sustained regulatory and consumer scrutiny of online supplement promotion and draws operational boundaries for brand, creator and agency partnerships, likely affecting how cross-border brands advertise in the UK.
  • dsm-firmenich 在 SupplySide 推出「长寿转变 2.0：肠道效应」
    dsm-firmenich brings 'The Longevity Shift 2.0: The Gut Effect' to SupplySide Global
    帝斯曼-芬美意在 10 月 28—30 日拉斯维加斯展会上把沉浸式长寿体验升级为「肠道效应」，聚焦菌群失调这一衰老标志，援引调查称七成消费者认同肠道与其他健康强关联。同期主推 Age Slower 方案，以微藻 Omega-3 与维生素 D 复配，对应 DO-HEALTH 三年生物学衰老最多减缓 10%。
    At the Las Vegas show running October 28–30, dsm-firmenich upgraded its immersive longevity installation to 'The Gut Effect', centring on gut dysbiosis as a hallmark of aging and citing survey data that seven in ten consumers see a strong link between gut health and other health areas. It also promoted the ready-to-market Age Slower concept combining life'sOMEGA 60 microalgae omega-3 with Quali-D vitamin D, the pairing studied in Europe's largest healthy aging trial DO-HEALTH, which found up to a 10% reduction in biological aging over three years.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • RESET for Remission：低热量饮食加运动，54% 年轻 2 型糖尿病 6 个月缓解
    RESET for Remission: Low-calorie diet plus exercise brings 54% of early-onset type 2 diabetes into remission in six months
    96 名 18—45 岁早发 2 型糖尿病合并肥胖患者中，干预组每日 800—900 千卡配合每周两次监督下有氧加抗阻训练，24 周后 54% 达到缓解（HbA1c<6.5% 且停药 12 周以上），常规照护组仅 4%；干预组多减 7.5 kg，其中脂肪 6.6 kg，肌肉得以保留。
    Ninety-six adults aged 18–45 with early-onset type 2 diabetes, obesity and no insulin use were randomised. The intervention group took 800–900 kcal daily (30% protein, 50% carbohydrate, 20% fat) with supervised aerobic plus resistance training twice weekly and one self-directed session, then shifted to weight maintenance at week 12. At 24 weeks, 54% (27 of 50) achieved remission — HbA1c below 6.5% with no glucose-lowering drugs for 12 weeks — versus 4% on usual care, with 7.5 kg greater weight loss including 6.6 kg of fat and preserved lean mass.
  • 《国家残疾预防行动计划（2026—2030 年）》发布：18 项指标、居民健康素养达 40%
    China releases National Disability Prevention Action Plan 2026–2030 with 18 targets
    10 月 30 日，国务院残工委办公室在京解读《国家残疾预防行动计划（2026—2030 年）》。文件设 18 项主要指标，明确到 2030 年居民健康素养达 40%、产前筛查率不低于 90%、残疾人基本康复服务覆盖率超 90%，并新增专业人员科普能力、职业健康服务网络、交通事故救治效率等指标。
    At a Beijing briefing on October 30, the State Council working committee office detailed the plan, which sets 18 headline targets for 2030 including a 40% health literacy rate, antenatal screening of at least 90% and basic rehabilitation service coverage above 90% for people with disabilities. New indicators cover professional science-communication capacity, occupational health service networks and traffic-injury rescue efficiency, with focus on birth defects, chronic disease prevention, injury control and rehabilitation, backed by closed-loop services and data infrastructure.
  • 世界卒中日：《成人脑卒中食养指南（2026 年版）》给出全国七大地区四季食谱
    World Stroke Day: China's 2026 dietary guideline for stroke survivors adds four-season menus for seven regions
    世界卒中日（10 月 29 日），国家卫健委办公厅《成人脑卒中食养指南（2026 年版）》提出 8 条原则：能量适宜、优质蛋白优先（鱼虾每周 300—500 g、每日 1 个鸡蛋、奶类 300—500 mL）、烹调油不超 25 g、限饱和与反式脂肪、增钾补钙、低 GI 主食，并按七大地区设计四季食谱。
    Released by the National Health Commission for World Stroke Day on October 29, the 2026 dietary guideline for adults with stroke stresses that diet and lifestyle are closely tied to onset and progression. For the recovery and sequelae phases it sets eight principles: appropriate energy intake, prioritised quality protein (300–500 g fish and shellfish weekly, about 50 g meat daily, one egg a day, 300–500 mL dairy), cooking oil under 25 g, limits on saturated and trans fat, more potassium and calcium, and low-glycaemic staples, with four-season full-day menus for seven regions.
  • 广东启动企联医疗健康服务平台，「粤小医」接管体检之后的长期管护
    Guangdong launches enterprise health service platform as 'Yue Xiaoyi' takes over post-checkup care
    10 月 29 日，2026 健康产业创新发展大会在广州举行，广东省企联医疗健康服务平台启动，首期项目「粤小医」由微医数智医院运营，构建「个性化体检—风险评估—干预方案—跟踪随访」闭环；以医疗大模型与健康智能体联动智能指环、动态血糖监测，生成数字孪生健康画像并由专属团队持续管护。
    At the 2026 Health Industry Innovation Conference in Guangzhou on October 29, the Guangdong enterprise federation's medical and health service platform launched with Yue Xiaoyi as its first project. Operated technically by WeDoctor's digital hospital, it builds a proactive loop from personalised checkups through risk assessment and intervention to follow-up, covering health records, screening, chronic disease management and care coordination. A medical large model and health agents link smart rings and continuous glucose monitors into a digital-twin health profile, with health managers, family doctors and tertiary specialists following up.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-29
item.description: 2026-10-29 简报，共 20 条：Nature：产气荚膜梭菌 Delta 毒素靶向 CD9，驱动坏死性小肠结肠炎与脑损伤；宿主基因如何改写沙门菌感染结局：肠道菌群与色氨酸代谢成关键枢纽；黏膜粘液乳杆菌胞外囊泡经 AMPK 通路改善肠-肝轴，缓解脂肪肝；仿生人结肠三维平台：短链脂肪酸的「交叉喂养」是重塑免疫而非单向抑炎；肌肉衰老的隐藏逻辑：心肌磷脂下降，肌纤维「以力量换保护」；咖啡因经 AMPK 通路延长裂殖酵母「历时寿命」；维泰瑞隆 NAMPT 激活剂 SIR4156：肥胖症 II 期 FORGE-LM 完成约 50% 入组；一次 30 分钟桑拿让白细胞短时激增，机制与运动相似；活性叶酸与精准营养健康国际会议在南昌召开，聚焦三大产业化赛道；Neurology：近 1.3 万人随访 8 年，六种甜味剂与更快认知衰退相关；IJMS 综述：肥胖留下「免疫代谢记忆」，营养到底能改写多少；大规模研究：吃肉与长寿相关，蛋白质来源多样的老人更少虚弱；蔓越莓汁或能对抗龋齿：减缓牙菌斑再生、降低产酸；红毛丹果皮「变废为宝」：鞣花单宁海藻酸钠包埋效率达 55%；β-葡聚糖蘑菇提取物 40 天：男性运动员最大摄氧量提升 14.8%；SlimSEB 复配 84 天 RCT：肥胖者腰围多减 11 厘米，HOMA-IR 降 24.8%；上海试点社区营养服务能力：市-区-社区三级联动、医防融合；新华网：健康关口「往前移」，5500 多家医院设立健康体重管理门诊；杭州萧山北干街道「一吃一练」控糖营：有学员体重减轻近 20 斤；Euvita Health 上线全美「全健康+长寿」平台，整合功能医学与生物标志物
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • Nature：产气荚膜梭菌 Delta 毒素靶向 CD9，驱动坏死性小肠结肠炎与脑损伤
    Nature: Clostridium perfringens delta toxin targets CD9 to drive necrotizing enterocolitis and brain injury
    广州国家实验室、广州医科大学熊小哲团队联合哈佛医学院在《自然》发文，首次证实产气荚膜梭菌分泌的 Delta 毒素是部分重症坏死性小肠结肠炎的关键致病因子：毒素结合宿主 CD9 受体，直接启动肠坏死并继发脑、肺多器官损伤；动物模型中中和抗体显示出保护作用，为毒素检测与疾病精准分型提供依据。
    A team from the Guangzhou National Laboratory and Guangzhou Medical University, with Harvard Medical School, reported in Nature that delta toxin from Clostridium perfringens is a key driver of severe necrotizing enterocolitis. The toxin binds host CD9 to trigger intestinal necrosis and downstream brain and lung injury; neutralizing antibodies were protective in animal models, pointing to toxin testing and precision subtyping.
  • 宿主基因如何改写沙门菌感染结局：肠道菌群与色氨酸代谢成关键枢纽
    How host genes rewrite Salmonella outcomes: gut microbiota and tryptophan metabolism as the hinge
    吉林农业大学团队发现，C19orf18 基因敲除小鼠对沙门菌感染的抵抗力显著增强，其肠道内以黏蛋白为食的阿克曼菌明显富集，色氨酸代谢通路被系统性激活，吲哚、色醇、色胺及下游 AHR-IL22 黏膜保护轴同步升高；补充色氨酸须依赖菌群才起效，直接回补吲哚的保护效果最强。
    Jilin Agricultural University researchers found that C19orf18 knockout mice resist Salmonella infection far better: the mucin-feeding Akkermansia is enriched, the tryptophan pathway is activated, and indole, tryptophol, tryptamine plus the downstream AHR-IL22 mucosal axis rise together. Tryptophan supplementation worked only with an intact microbiota, and direct indole replacement was most protective.
  • 黏膜粘液乳杆菌胞外囊泡经 AMPK 通路改善肠-肝轴，缓解脂肪肝
    Ligilactobacillus mucosae extracellular vesicles ease fatty liver via the gut-liver axis and AMPK
    南昌大学第二附属医院团队从健康人粪便中筛出黏液乳杆菌，发现真正起效的是其分泌的约 129 纳米胞外囊泡而非活菌：囊泡口服后主要分布于胃肠与肝脏，激活 AMPK、下调 SREBP-1c，减少肝内脂滴沉积，并重塑菌群提高阿克曼菌丰度；29 例脂肪肝患者的菌群分析显示乳杆菌丰度显著下降。
    A Nanchang University Second Affiliated Hospital team isolated Ligilactobacillus mucosae from healthy stool and found the active agent is its ~129 nm extracellular vesicles rather than live bacteria. Orally, the vesicles concentrated in gut and liver, activated AMPK, lowered SREBP-1c and hepatic lipid droplets, and reshaped microbiota toward more Akkermansia; patients with fatty liver showed markedly lower Lactobacillus abundance.
  • 仿生人结肠三维平台：短链脂肪酸的「交叉喂养」是重塑免疫而非单向抑炎
    Biomimetic 3D human colon platform: short-chain fatty acid cross-feeding reshapes immunity rather than simply suppressing inflammation
    研究团队搭建无需微流控硬件的仿生人结肠三维共培养平台，可同步回收细菌层与上皮层分别测序：菌群共存后上皮表达的 5566 个基因中仅 41 个显著改变，细胞因子谱呈「重组」而非单纯促炎或抑炎——TNF-α、IL-8 与抗炎 IL-10 同时升高，提示短链脂肪酸诱导了一种「警觉但受控」的免疫状态。
    Researchers built a biomimetic 3D human colon co-culture platform needing no microfluidics, sequencing bacterial and epithelial layers separately. With microbiota present, only 41 of 5,566 epithelial genes changed, and the cytokine profile was reorganised rather than simply pro- or anti-inflammatory: TNF-α, IL-8 and IL-10 all rose, suggesting short-chain fatty acids induce an alert-but-contained immune state.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 肌肉衰老的隐藏逻辑：心肌磷脂下降，肌纤维「以力量换保护」
    The hidden logic of muscle aging: falling cardiolipin makes fibres trade strength for protection
    哥本哈根大学团队发现，随年龄下降的心肌磷脂使受损线粒体产生更多活性氧，经 ERRγ 驱动快肌纤维向慢肌纤维转换——这不是单纯衰竭，而是用力量换取抗氧化防御；小鼠心肌磷脂回补至正常约三分之二即逆转肌萎缩并完全避免早亡，而外源抗氧化剂反而让肌肉更差，提示「清除活性氧」可能适得其反。
    University of Copenhagen scientists showed that age-related cardiolipin loss makes damaged mitochondria release more reactive oxygen species, and ERRγ then drives a fast-to-slow fibre switch — not pure decline but a trade of power for antioxidant defence. Restoring cardiolipin to about two-thirds of normal reversed wasting and prevented early death in mice, while antioxidants made muscles worse.
  • 咖啡因经 AMPK 通路延长裂殖酵母「历时寿命」
    Caffeine extends chronological lifespan in fission yeast via the AMPK pathway
    伦敦玛丽女王大学细胞老化与衰老实验室以裂殖酵母为模型发现，咖啡因并非直接抑制 TORC1，而是经 Ssp1、Ssp2 与调节亚基 Amk2 强力激活能量感受器 AMPK，重塑代谢节律并加速有丝分裂，显著延长细胞在非分裂状态的历时寿命；该通路与二甲双胍靶点重合，但结论仍限于单细胞模型，不能外推到人群。
    Using fission yeast, Queen Mary University of London researchers found caffeine does not directly inhibit TORC1 but strongly activates the energy sensor AMPK through Ssp1, Ssp2 and the Amk2 subunit, resetting metabolic rhythm and extending chronological lifespan in the non-dividing state. The pathway overlaps with metformin's target, but the findings remain confined to a single-cell model.
  • 维泰瑞隆 NAMPT 激活剂 SIR4156：肥胖症 II 期 FORGE-LM 完成约 50% 入组
    Vitalityrex NAMPT activator SIR4156: Phase II FORGE-LM in obesity reaches about 50% enrolment
    维泰瑞隆宣布，其同类首创口服 NAMPT 激活剂 SIR4156 联合司美格鲁肽的全球 II 期 FORGE-LM 试验已完成约 50% 目标患者入组。该药通过恢复 NAD+ 稳态改善线粒体功能与细胞能量代谢，临床前显示优先减脂、保留瘦体重、减少肌肉萎缩，瞄准减重保肌与停药后脂肪反跳等需求。
    Vitalityrex said its first-in-class oral NAMPT activator SIR4156, combined with semaglutide, has enrolled about half the target patients in the global Phase II FORGE-LM randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial in obesity. By restoring NAD+ homeostasis the drug aims to preserve lean mass and limit muscle wasting during weight loss and fat regain after stopping treatment.
  • 一次 30 分钟桑拿让白细胞短时激增，机制与运动相似
    A single 30-minute sauna sends white blood cells surging, much like exercise
    芬兰团队对 51 名平均 50 岁成人测试发现，30 分钟桑拿（中途短暂冷水冲淋）后各类循环白细胞均上升，中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞在 30 分钟内回落至基线，提示热暴露把免疫细胞从组织「动员」入血以增强免疫监视；部分细胞因子变化与体温升幅相关，但能否带来长期免疫获益尚未证实。
    In 51 adults averaging 50 years, a Finnish team found a 30-minute sauna with a brief mid-session cold shower raised every measured circulating white blood cell type, with neutrophils and lymphocytes returning to baseline within 30 minutes — suggesting heat mobilises immune cells from tissues to improve surveillance. Some cytokine shifts tracked temperature rise, but lasting benefit is unproven.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • 活性叶酸与精准营养健康国际会议在南昌召开，聚焦三大产业化赛道
    International conference on active folate and precision nutrition opens in Nanchang, targeting three industrial tracks
    由南昌大学主办的 2026 国际产学研用合作会议（江西）——活性叶酸与精准营养健康国际会议在南昌举行，来自新加坡、比利时等多国专家围绕活性叶酸基础研究、临床与产业化应用展开研讨，聚焦辅食营养品、主粮强化小麦粉、调制乳粉三大赛道；同期三场签约覆盖原料供给、主粮强化与特医食品。
    Hosted by Nanchang University, the 2026 International Industry-University-Research Conference (Jiangxi) on active folate and precision nutrition drew experts from Singapore, Belgium and elsewhere to discuss basic, clinical and industrial applications of active folate, focusing on complementary foods, fortified wheat flour and formulated milk powder, with three signings across raw materials, fortification and FSMP.
  • Neurology：近 1.3 万人随访 8 年，六种甜味剂与更快认知衰退相关
    Neurology: in nearly 13,000 adults over 8 years, six sweeteners linked to faster cognitive decline
    巴西圣保罗大学团队分析 12772 名成人约 8 年数据，低/无热量甜味剂摄入最高组（日均 191 毫克）整体思维与记忆衰退速度比最低组（20 毫克）快 62%，相当于多衰老约 1.6 年；阿斯巴甜、糖精、安赛蜜、赤藓糖醇、山梨糖醇、木糖醇六种均相关，塔格糖未见关联，糖尿病人群关联更强。
    Analysing 12,772 Brazilian adults over about eight years, University of São Paulo researchers found the highest low- and no-calorie sweetener intake (191 mg/day) was associated with 62% faster decline in overall thinking and memory versus the lowest (20 mg/day), equal to about 1.6 extra years of ageing. Aspartame, saccharin, acesulfame-K, erythritol, sorbitol and xylitol were linked; tagatose was not.
  • IJMS 综述：肥胖留下「免疫代谢记忆」，营养到底能改写多少
    IJMS review: obesity leaves an immunometabolic memory — how much can nutrition rewrite it?
    综述基于 47 项核心研究指出，肥胖会在脂肪组织、循环与造血系统中留下持久的细胞、转录与表观遗传印记：减重后脂肪组织免疫状态并不完全正常化、脂肪细胞程序持续存在、T 细胞 DNA 甲基化改变长期保留。饮食干预可降低炎症基调并调节相关通路，但尚无任何膳食模式被证明能在人体消除已建立的免疫代谢记忆。
    Based on 47 core studies, the review finds obesity leaves persistent cellular, transcriptional and epigenetic imprints across adipose tissue, circulation and haematopoiesis: after weight loss, adipose immune status does not fully normalise, adipocyte programmes persist and T-cell DNA methylation changes remain. Diet can lower inflammatory tone, but no dietary pattern has been shown to erase established immunometabolic memory in humans.
  • 大规模研究：吃肉与长寿相关，蛋白质来源多样的老人更少虚弱
    Large studies link meat intake with longevity, and diverse protein sources with less frailty
    文章汇总多项队列证据：2216 名中国老人 4 年随访中 541 人出现虚弱，蛋白质来源越多样（肉、鱼、蛋、豆并用）虚弱比例越低，以肉鱼为主要来源者约为最低组的一半；4.8 万名女性长期随访显示，中年蛋白质摄入较高者晚年身体功能与认知状态更好。作者强调关键在于膳食结构均衡，而非单一食材。
    The article pools cohort evidence: among 2,216 older Chinese adults followed four years, 541 became frail, and greater protein-source diversity (meat, fish, eggs, legumes) tracked with lower frailty, with meat-and-fish-dominant diets about half the rate of the lowest group. In 48,000 women, higher midlife protein intake predicted better late-life function and cognition; balance, not any single food, is key.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • 蔓越莓汁或能对抗龋齿：减缓牙菌斑再生、降低产酸
    Cranberry juice may fight tooth decay by slowing plaque regrowth and acid production
    芝加哥伊利诺伊大学开展 22 人（14 名儿童、8 名成人）随机对照试验：含漱并饮用纯无糖蔓越莓汁后，牙菌斑再生速度慢于对照，儿童与成人菌斑产酸均下降；起效成分可能是原花青素，而含糖蔓越莓混合果汁未显示同等效果。研究仅观察 30 分钟、样本小，尚不能证明长期防龋。
    In a 22-person randomised trial (14 children, 8 adults) at the University of Illinois Chicago, swishing and drinking pure unsweetened cranberry juice slowed dental plaque regrowth and reduced acid production in both age groups, unlike a sweetened 27%-juice cocktail. Proanthocyanidins are the likely actives, but the 30-minute, small-sample design cannot prove cavity prevention.
  • 红毛丹果皮「变废为宝」：鞣花单宁海藻酸钠包埋效率达 55%
    Rambutan peel upcycled: alginate encapsulation of ellagitannins reaches 55% efficiency
    墨西哥科阿韦拉自治大学团队用海藻酸钠包埋红毛丹果皮鞣花单宁（含老鹳草素等），在 3000 ppm 多酚、2% 海藻酸钠与 5 mM 氯化钙条件下包埋效率达 55%；包埋物 ABTS 与 DPPH 抑制率分别为 76% 与 65%，细胞存活率超 75%，但储存与消化稳定性及人体效果尚未验证。
    At the Autonomous University of Coahuila in Mexico, sodium alginate encapsulation of rambutan peel ellagitannins (geraniin, corilagin) reached 55% efficiency at 3,000 ppm polyphenols, 2% alginate and 5 mM calcium chloride. The encapsulated material retained 76% ABTS and 65% DPPH inhibition with cell viability above 75%, though storage, digestive stability and human efficacy remain untested.
  • β-葡聚糖蘑菇提取物 40 天：男性运动员最大摄氧量提升 14.8%
    Beta-glucan mushroom extract for 40 days raises VO2max 14.8% in male athletes
    印度团队先以缺氧心肌细胞比较三种成分，牛磺酸把代谢活性恢复至 97.27% 最强；随后 50 名 18–22 岁男性运动员每日补充 320 毫克富 β-葡聚糖蘑菇提取物 40 天，相对最大摄氧量提升 14.8%、力竭时间延长 54.9 秒，白细胞与红细胞部分指标改变而体成分不变。
    An Indian team first compared three compounds in hypoxic cardiomyoblasts, where taurine restored metabolic activity best at 97.27%. Then 50 male athletes aged 18–22 took 320 mg/day of a beta-glucan-rich mushroom extract for 40 days: relative VO2max rose 14.8% and time to exhaustion lengthened 54.9 seconds, with shifts in white and red cell indices but no body-composition change. The single-arm design is hypothesis-generating only.
  • SlimSEB 复配 84 天 RCT：肥胖者腰围多减 11 厘米，HOMA-IR 降 24.8%
    SlimSEB 84-day RCT: obese participants lose 11 cm more waist, HOMA-IR falls 24.8%
    印度团队开展随机双盲试验，87 名超重或肥胖的 2 型糖尿病风险者每日服用含 15 亿 CFU 益生菌、消化酶与桑叶、绿茶、肉桂、吡啶甲酸铬的复配制剂 84 天：肥胖组体重多减 4.51 公斤、腰围多减 11.03 厘米，HOMA-IR 降 24.8%（安慰剂 4.3%），LDL 下降而对照组上升。
    In an 84-day randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, 87 overweight or obese adults at risk of type 2 diabetes took a blend of 1.5 billion CFU probiotics, digestive enzymes, mulberry leaf, green tea, cinnamon and chromium picolinate. Obese subjects lost 4.51 kg and 11.03 cm more waist than placebo, with HOMA-IR down 24.8% versus 4.3% and LDL falling where placebo rose; no serious adverse events.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 上海试点社区营养服务能力：市-区-社区三级联动、医防融合
    Shanghai pilots community nutrition services with city-district-community coordination and integrated prevention
    上海市卫健委印发《上海市社区营养服务能力提升试点工作方案》，在浦东、静安、徐汇等 8 个区试点，建立市-区-社区三级联动、医防融合、分级管理、全程连续的营养服务体系，开展营养评估-干预-随访全流程管理，并要求把高血压、2 型糖尿病、高脂血症、肥胖症的膳食运动指导要点嵌入社区医生工作站。
    Shanghai's health commission issued a pilot plan for community nutrition capacity in eight districts including Pudong, Jing'an and Xuhui, building a city-district-community, prevention-integrated, tiered and continuous nutrition service system covering assessment, intervention and follow-up, and requiring dietary and exercise guidance for hypertension, type 2 diabetes, dyslipidaemia and obesity to be embedded in community physician workstations.
  • 新华网：健康关口「往前移」，5500 多家医院设立健康体重管理门诊
    Xinhua: health gateways move upstream as 5,500-plus hospitals open weight-management clinics
    报道指出，我国已启动为期 3 年的「体重管理年」活动，5500 多家二级、三级医疗机构设立健康体重管理门诊，慢性病综合防控战略持续推进。国家卫生健康委有关负责人表示，推动健康关口前移是防治慢病的关键一环，每个人要真正意识到自己是健康第一责任人，培育良好健康的生活方式、进行有规律的生活安排。
    China has launched a three-year weight-management campaign, with more than 5,500 secondary and tertiary hospitals now running healthy weight clinics as part of its chronic disease strategy, Xinhua reported. A National Health Commission official said moving the health gateway upstream is key to chronic disease control, and individuals must recognise themselves as first responsible for their health through regular, healthy routines.
  • 杭州萧山北干街道「一吃一练」控糖营：有学员体重减轻近 20 斤
    Hangzhou community glucose-control camp pairs subsidised meals with group exercise
    杭州萧山区北干街道天悦社区「善聚天悦·科学控糖」项目启动，将连开两期、每期 14 天的补贴控糖餐，采用「一吃一练」模式：社区食堂统一供餐、餐后集体练南无拳。首期学员中有人糖化血红蛋白降至 5.79 并逐步减药，也有人数月内体重减轻近 20 斤，项目由慈善资金与社会力量共同支持。
    Tianyue community in Hangzhou's Xiaoshan district launched a subsidised glucose-control programme running two 14-day rounds that pairs centrally prepared low-glycaemic meals with post-meal group exercise. Past participants report glycated haemoglobin falling to 5.79 with medication reduced, and one woman losing nearly 10 kg over several months; charity funds and social partners support the scheme.
  • Euvita Health 上线全美「全健康+长寿」平台，整合功能医学与生物标志物
    Euvita Health launches US whole-health and longevity platform integrating functional medicine and biomarkers
    美国 Euvita Health 宣布推出全国性全健康与长寿平台，把医生主导的功能医学、深度生物标志物检测、注册营养师支持、睡眠优化、体能指导与循证补剂整合进同一远程医疗体系。其核心 BiomarkerIQ 平台结合检测结果、病史、生活方式与个人目标生成可执行健康路线图，并由多学科团队定期复评调整。
    US-based Euvita Health launched a nationwide whole-health and longevity platform combining clinician-led functional medicine, advanced biomarker testing, registered dietitian support, sleep optimisation, fitness coaching and research-backed supplements in one telehealth service. Its BiomarkerIQ engine turns labs, history, lifestyle and goals into an actionable roadmap that a multidisciplinary team reviews and adjusts over time.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-28
item.description: 2026-10-28 简报，共 20 条：《新英格兰医学杂志》：炎症性肠病不是一种病，3.5%患者存在抗IL-10自身抗体；同样是蛋白质，来源不同结局不同：牛肉蛋白加重、豌豆蛋白减轻小鼠肠道炎症；给肠道「大扫除」：抗菌肽pileup被激活后可强制老废肠细胞脱落；肠道菌群可解释约15%的生物学衰老速度差异，青春双歧杆菌关联最明显；梅奥诊所：衰老细胞远比想象中多样，SenMayo基因集可跨组织稳定识别；Arrowhead皮下注射RNAi新药：健康志愿者脑脊液tau蛋白最高降73%；《柳叶刀·健康长寿》：衰弱与活动能力下降不只是肌肉问题，而是整套运动系统衰老；Klotho抗衰疗法卡在「半衰期」：微囊化细胞持续递送或成破局方案；Nature Communications四大队列：EDISEA饮食指数让表观遗传衰老减速约4年，死亡风险降20%；一颗青花菜两种营养：花球与芽苗功能性成分时空图谱绘出「精准营养分布模型」；「土豆米」抗结肠炎：抗性淀粉经菌群—短链脂肪酸—胆汁酸轴起效；为什么有人喝甜饮料更易脂肪肝：低睾酮叠加高果糖，经肠道丙酮酸放大肝脂沉积；IFF推出产GABA益生菌HOWARU GutABAlite：六周空腹胰岛素降约18%、HOMA-IR降约20%；每天一勺菊粉改善膝骨关节炎疼痛与肌力，依从性远优于数字物理治疗；更年期补充剂进超市：澳洲Coles引入MTick认证，首批200余款产品2027年初上线；不补菌、改「吸附」：丹麦Bactolife结合蛋白进入美国肠道健康市场，人体数据年底出炉；广东发布县域医共体三年行动方案：2028年基层诊疗量占比力争65%以上；德阳举办糖尿病诊疗暨体重管理技术培训班：190名基层人员统一诊疗与体重管理规范；新疆「1+1+1」家庭医生团队：县级专家下沉包联，健康服务嵌入基层治理；杭州萧山试点「萧慧减」体重管理智能体：135人30天人均减重3.5公斤
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 《新英格兰医学杂志》：炎症性肠病不是一种病，3.5%患者存在抗IL-10自身抗体
    NEJM: IBD Is Not One Disease — 3.5% of Patients Carry Antibodies That Neutralize IL-10
    研究分析逾4900名炎症性肠病患者，发现约3.5%体内存在可中和白细胞介素-10的自身抗体，健康对照中未检出；这一自身免疫反应也解释了已知最强遗传风险位点如何致病。作者认为IBD实为多种生物学机制不同的疾病集合，应按病因分层治疗，英国估计1.5万至2万人携带此类抗体。
    Analyzing more than 4,900 people with IBD, researchers found about 3.5% carry antibodies that neutralize interleukin-10, with none detected in healthy controls; the autoimmune reaction also explains how the strongest known genetic risk factor drives disease. The authors argue IBD is really a set of biologically distinct conditions that should be treated by cause, with an estimated 15,000 to 20,000 patients in the UK carrying these antibodies.
  • 同样是蛋白质，来源不同结局不同：牛肉蛋白加重、豌豆蛋白减轻小鼠肠道炎症
    Same Protein, Different Outcome: Beef Worsens and Pea Protein Eases Gut Inflammation in Mice
    美国胃肠病学协会旗下《细胞与分子胃肠病学》研究，在多种IBD小鼠模型中比较牛肉、鸡蛋、乳、大豆、豌豆五种蛋白配方：牛肉蛋白组结肠炎最重，豌豆蛋白组仅轻度炎症，雌雄与不同模型结果一致；未诱导结肠炎时单喂牛肉蛋白并不致病，提示菌群、肠屏障与胆汁酸是中间环节。
    Published in CMGH, the study compared beef, egg, dairy, soy and pea protein diets across several IBD mouse models: beef-fed mice had the most severe colitis while pea-fed mice showed only mild inflammation, consistent across sexes and models. Beef protein alone did not trigger inflammation without a colitis trigger, pointing to the microbiome, gut barrier and bile acids as intermediaries.
  • 给肠道「大扫除」：抗菌肽pileup被激活后可强制老废肠细胞脱落
    Spring-Cleaning the Gut: Antimicrobial Peptide pileup Forces Aged Intestinal Cells to Shed
    《Current Biology》果蝇研究鉴定出抗菌肽pileup：肠细胞线粒体老化、活性氧升高时，HIF-1α经ATG1被激活并指令老化细胞表达pileup，后者破坏细胞膜并触发JNK通路促其脱落。敲除pileup及其3个同源基因后，肠道堆积肿瘤样细胞、屏障崩溃、果蝇显著早亡，提示抗菌肽还承担内部「保洁」功能。
    A Current Biology study in fruit flies identified the antimicrobial peptide pileup: when intestinal cells suffer mitochondrial decline and rising reactive oxygen species, HIF-1α is activated via ATG1 and instructs aged cells to express pileup, which disrupts their membranes and triggers JNK-driven shedding. Knocking out pileup and its three homologs caused tumor-like cell accumulation, barrier collapse and early death, suggesting antimicrobial peptides also serve as internal janitors.
  • 肠道菌群可解释约15%的生物学衰老速度差异，青春双歧杆菌关联最明显
    Gut Bacteria Explain About 15% of the Variation in Biological Aging Pace
    夏威夷大学团队分析123名成人的粪便与血液样本，发现肠道菌群组成可解释约15%的生物学衰老速度差异（DunedinPACE指标），且独立于实际年龄。青春双歧杆菌与较慢衰老关联最强，解糖琥珀酸弧菌则与加速衰老相关，提示菌群可作为精准健康与长寿干预的可调控靶点。
    Analyzing stool and blood samples from 123 adults, University of Hawaii researchers found gut bacterial composition accounted for roughly 15% of the variation in biological aging pace measured by DunedinPACE, independent of chronological age. Bifidobacterium adolescentis was most strongly linked to slower aging, while Succinivibrio dextrinosolvens tracked faster aging, suggesting the microbiome is a modifiable target for precision health and longevity.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • 梅奥诊所：衰老细胞远比想象中多样，SenMayo基因集可跨组织稳定识别
    Mayo Clinic: Senescent Cells Are Far More Diverse, and SenMayo Identifies Them Across Tissues
    梅奥诊所Kogod衰老中心在Nature系列期刊发表多项研究，指出衰老细胞的特征随组织位置与诱导因素而异，远比既往认知多样；团队开发的SenMayo基因集可跨组织、跨实验体系更一致地识别衰老细胞，并在老年人骨活检中得到验证，去除衰老细胞后该特征减弱，为SenNet人体衰老细胞图谱与靶向疗法奠定基础。
    In a series of papers in Nature journals, Mayo Clinic's Kogod Center on Aging showed senescent cells vary by tissue location and by the process that induced them, far more than previously assumed. Their SenMayo gene set identifies senescent cells more consistently across tissues and systems and was validated in bone biopsies from older adults, with the signature fading after senescent cells were removed, laying groundwork for the SenNet human atlas and targeted therapies.
  • Arrowhead皮下注射RNAi新药：健康志愿者脑脊液tau蛋白最高降73%
    Arrowhead's Subcutaneous RNAi Drug Cuts CSF Tau by Up to 73% in Healthy Volunteers
    Arrowhead公布RNAi药物ARO-MAPT的1/2a期中期数据：皮下注射可穿透血脑屏障，最高剂量组健康志愿者第105天脑脊液总tau蛋白平均下降73%（个体最高85%），停药90天后效应仍维持，支持每三个月给药；不良反应多为1级，无严重事件。能否转化为认知获益仍需2027年患者数据验证。
    Arrowhead reported interim Phase 1/2a data for its RNAi drug ARO-MAPT: subcutaneous dosing crossed the blood-brain barrier and lowered mean cerebrospinal fluid total tau by 73% at day 105 in the highest-dose healthy-volunteer group (up to 85% in one participant), persisting 90 days after the last dose and supporting quarterly dosing. Adverse events were mostly grade 1 with no serious events; whether this translates into cognitive benefit awaits 2027 patient data.
  • 《柳叶刀·健康长寿》：衰弱与活动能力下降不只是肌肉问题，而是整套运动系统衰老
    Lancet Healthy Longevity: Frailty Is Not Just Muscle Loss but Aging of the Whole Motor System
    《柳叶刀·健康长寿》新研究提出，衰老导致的力量与活动能力下降是脑、神经、肌肉整套运动系统的退变，肌肉量仅能解释小部分力量衰减；即使肌肉尚在，神经募集信号也已减弱，爆发力下降早于肌肉萎缩。作者建议把肌少症重新定义为运动系统衰老疾病，评估加入起身速度、行走中交谈等指标，并排查镇静与抗胆碱药物的抑制影响。
    A new Lancet Healthy Longevity paper argues that age-related loss of strength and mobility reflects degeneration of the entire brain-nerve-muscle motor system, with muscle mass explaining only a small part of strength decline; neural recruitment weakens even when muscle persists, and power fades before atrophy. The authors propose redefining sarcopenia as a motor-system aging disease, adding measures such as rising speed and talking while walking, and reviewing sedative and anticholinergic drugs.
  • Klotho抗衰疗法卡在「半衰期」：微囊化细胞持续递送或成破局方案
    Klotho Therapy Stuck on Half-Life: Encapsulated Cell Delivery as a Way Forward
    《Frontiers in Aging》综述指出，Klotho表达随年龄下降，与肾、心血管、神经退行及代谢疾病密切相关；但重组Klotho蛋白血清半衰期仅约7.5小时且易被肾脏清除，基因与细胞疗法又面临免疫清除，临床转化受限。文章提出用Cell-in-a-Box微囊化包裹产Klotho细胞，实现持续分泌与免疫保护，作为抗衰老与疾病修饰的递送新策略。
    A Frontiers in Aging review notes that Klotho declines with age and is tied to renal, cardiovascular, neurodegenerative and metabolic disease, yet recombinant Klotho has a serum half-life of only about 7.5 hours and is rapidly cleared by the kidney, while gene and cell therapies face immune rejection. The authors propose encapsulating Klotho-producing cells with Cell-in-a-Box technology to achieve sustained secretion and immune protection as a new delivery strategy for anti-aging and disease modification.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Nature Communications四大队列：EDISEA饮食指数让表观遗传衰老减速约4年，死亡风险降20%
    Four Cohorts in Nature Communications: EDISEA Diet Index Slows Epigenetic Aging by About 4 Years
    《Nature Communications》基于四大队列构建EDISEA饮食指数，把饮食与分子层面的衰老速度直接挂钩：依从性高者表观遗传衰老约减速3至4年，全因死亡风险降低约20%，肾、脂肪与肠道等器官特异性衰老差距更优，40个皮质区域厚度增加。可操作方向很简单——多喝茶、多吃全谷物与水果，少碰油炸食品、酒、加工肉与含糖饮料。
    Built on four cohorts and published in Nature Communications, the EDISEA dietary index links diet directly to molecular aging pace: higher adherence was associated with roughly 3 to 4 years slower epigenetic aging, about 20% lower all-cause mortality, better organ-specific aging profiles in kidney, fat and gut, and thicker cortex in 40 brain regions. The practical message: more tea, whole grains and fruit; less fried food, alcohol, processed meat and sugary drinks.
  • 一颗青花菜两种营养：花球与芽苗功能性成分时空图谱绘出「精准营养分布模型」
    One Broccoli, Two Nutrient Profiles: Mapping Functional Compounds Across Florets and Sprouts
    中国农科院蔬菜花卉所采用同基因型不同发育阶段的纵向代谢组学策略，绘制青花菜花球与芽苗功能性成分时空图谱：芽苗富萝卜硫苷与叶酸，花球富维生素C及己酸、庚酸，后者在花球期较芽苗期最高提升上千个百分点；共检出9种短链脂肪酸。研究建立「精准营养分布模型」，为不同人群膳食选择与定向育种提供依据。
    Using a longitudinal metabolomic comparison of the same genotype at different developmental stages, CAAS researchers mapped functional compounds in broccoli florets and sprouts: sprouts are rich in glucoraphanin and folate, while florets are rich in vitamin C plus hexanoic and heptanoic acids, which rose by orders of magnitude at the floret stage, with nine short-chain fatty acids detected. The resulting precision-nutrition distribution model informs dietary choices for different populations and targeted breeding.
  • 「土豆米」抗结肠炎：抗性淀粉经菌群—短链脂肪酸—胆汁酸轴起效
    Potato Rice Eases Colitis via the Microbiome–SCFA–Bile Acid Axis
    深圳大学吴奇院士与香港中文大学团队以「分子编织」工艺把带皮鲜薯与谷物粉重组成耐嚼、耐储的土豆米，煮熟后保持5型抗性淀粉结晶。小鼠长期食用后菌群α多样性提升，急性结肠炎模型中症状减轻、上皮屏障完整、短链脂肪酸升高并恢复胆汁酸稳态；菌群清除与粪菌移植实验证实其作用依赖肠道菌群。
    Using a molecular-weaving process, Shenzhen University's Wu Qi and CUHK colleagues reshaped peeled fresh potatoes with cereal flour into chewy, shelf-stable potato rice that retains type-5 resistant starch after cooking. Long-term feeding raised gut microbial alpha diversity in mice and, in acute colitis, eased symptoms, preserved epithelial barrier integrity, increased short-chain fatty acids and restored bile acid homeostasis; antibiotic clearance and fecal transplant experiments confirmed the effect is microbiome-dependent.
  • 为什么有人喝甜饮料更易脂肪肝：低睾酮叠加高果糖，经肠道丙酮酸放大肝脂沉积
    Why Sugary Drinks Hit Some Livers Harder: Low Testosterone Plus Fructose via Gut Pyruvate
    日本宇都宫大学团队发现，低睾酮与高果糖摄入单独作用时肝脏甘油三酯变化有限，两者叠加则脂肪堆积显著加重、脂肪肝恶化；抗生素清除菌群可削弱该效应，机制指向肠道菌群改变使肠内丙酮酸升高，丙酮酸与果糖协同促进肝细胞中性脂质沉积。提示果糖危害存在显著个体差异，雄激素状态是重要修饰因素。
    Researchers at Japan's Utsunomiya University found low testosterone and high fructose each produced only modest liver changes alone, but together sharply increased fat accumulation and worsened fatty liver; antibiotics blunted the effect, and the mechanism traced to microbiome shifts raising intestinal pyruvate, which acts synergistically with fructose to promote neutral lipid storage in hepatocytes. Fructose risk thus varies markedly between individuals, with androgen status a key modifier.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • IFF推出产GABA益生菌HOWARU GutABAlite：六周空腹胰岛素降约18%、HOMA-IR降约20%
    IFF Launches GABA-Producing Probiotic HOWARU GutABAlite: Fasting Insulin Down ~18%
    IFF发布产GABA益生菌HOWARU GutABAlite（短乳杆菌LBR-6108）：随机双盲安慰剂对照人体研究显示，补充六周后日均葡萄糖暴露下降，空腹胰岛素与胰岛素抵抗指标HOMA-IR分别呈约18%与20%的下降趋势，并在肠道增加有益短链脂肪酸；停补后效应减弱，提示需持续补充。
    IFF introduced HOWARU GutABAlite (Levilactobacillus brevis LBR-6108), a GABA-producing probiotic: in a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled human study, six weeks of supplementation lowered daily glucose exposure and showed trends of roughly 18% lower fasting insulin and about 20% lower HOMA-IR, alongside increased beneficial short-chain fatty acids in the gut. Effects diminished after supplementation stopped, implying a need for continued intake.
  • 每天一勺菊粉改善膝骨关节炎疼痛与肌力，依从性远优于数字物理治疗
    Daily Inulin Eased Knee Osteoarthritis Pain and Improved Strength With Far Better Adherence
    诺丁汉大学团队在《Nutrients》发表随机研究：膝骨关节炎患者每日补充菊粉（菊苣根来源益生元）后疼痛减轻、肌力改善，且依从性远优于数字物理治疗组——单纯菊粉组脱落率仅3.6%，物理治疗组为21%。研究者认为改善肠道菌群可能成为关节炎管理的补充路径，尤其适合难以坚持运动处方的患者。
    In a randomized trial published in Nutrients, University of Nottingham researchers found daily inulin — a prebiotic fiber from chicory root — reduced knee osteoarthritis pain and improved muscle strength, with far better adherence than a digital physical therapy program: only 3.6% of the inulin-only group dropped out versus 21% on physical therapy alone. The authors suggest improving gut health could become an additional arthritis management strategy, especially for patients who struggle to sustain exercise programs.
  • 更年期补充剂进超市：澳洲Coles引入MTick认证，首批200余款产品2027年初上线
    Menopause Supplements Move Into Supermarkets as Australia's Coles Adopts MTick
    澳大利亚连锁超市Coles与英国GenM的MTick认证合作，把更年期支持类产品纳入日常货架：认证覆盖睡眠、骨骼、补水、肠道、皮肤与整体健康等更年期表现，首批200余款认证产品将于2027年初先行上线线上专区、随后进店，Swisse、Lifespace等品牌在列。渠道方强调超市是补充而非替代药房。
    Australian supermarket chain Coles is expanding its menopause-support range through a partnership with UK-based GenM's MTick certification, covering products for sleep, bone health, hydration, gut health, skin and overall wellbeing among the 48 signs of menopause. More than 200 certified products will launch on an online menopause hub in early 2027 before moving in-store, including brands such as Swisse and Lifespace; the retailer stresses supermarkets complement rather than replace pharmacies.
  • 不补菌、改「吸附」：丹麦Bactolife结合蛋白进入美国肠道健康市场，人体数据年底出炉
    Not More Probiotics but Binding Proteins: Bactolife Enters US Gut Health Market
    丹麦Bactolife以精密发酵生产Helm结合蛋白，机制是靶向结合肠道内有害蛋白代谢物、阻止其接触肠壁，而非直接补充或喂养菌株；产品已通过Healthgevity的GUTgevity进入美国市场，先面向健康从业者。公司称三项人体干预研究正在进行，首项2026年底完成，届时才有支持肠屏障与免疫的人体证据。
    Danish biosolutions firm Bactolife produces precision-fermented Helm binding proteins designed to bind harmful protein metabolites in the gut before they reach the intestinal lining, rather than adding or feeding bacteria. The ingredient entered the US market via Healthgevity's GUTgevity supplement, initially for healthcare practitioners. Three human intervention studies are underway, the first concluding by the end of 2026, meaning current gut-barrier and immune claims rest on preclinical evidence.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 广东发布县域医共体三年行动方案：2028年基层诊疗量占比力争65%以上
    Guangdong Sets Three-Year County Medical Community Plan: 65% of Care at Grassroots by 2028
    10月27日广东省政府官网发布《紧密型县域医疗卫生共同体高质量发展行动方案（2026—2028年）》：到2027年底100%医共体实现统一法定代表人与覆盖全部基层分院的「分布式检查、集中式诊断」；2028年力争85%以上县域基层诊疗量占比达65%，并落实「三高六病」红黄绿三色分级管理与医保结余留用。
    Guangdong published a three-year action plan for tightly integrated county medical communities: by the end of 2027 all should have a unified legal representative and distributed testing with centralized diagnosis across every township branch, and by 2028 more than 85% of counties should reach a 65% grassroots share of visits. The plan also mandates red-yellow-green tiered management of hypertension, hyperglycemia, dyslipidemia and six related complications, with medical insurance savings retained locally.
  • 德阳举办糖尿病诊疗暨体重管理技术培训班：190名基层人员统一诊疗与体重管理规范
    Deyang Trains 190 Grassroots Clinicians on Diabetes Care and Weight Management
    在德阳市卫健委指导下，德阳市疾控中心于10月22日举办糖尿病诊疗暨体重管理技术培训班，190名来自各县区糖尿病防治指导中心、乡镇卫生院与社区卫生服务中心的专业人员参加；课程涵盖《中国老年2型糖尿病防治临床指南（2026版）》分层管理、肥胖症中西医诊疗路径与糖尿病足诊治指南，统一基层防治与体重管理工作标准。
    Under the Deyang health commission, the city CDC held a diabetes care and weight management training course on October 22 for 190 clinicians from county diabetes centers, township hospitals and community health centers. Sessions covered tiered management in the 2026 Chinese guideline for older adults with type 2 diabetes, integrated Chinese-Western obesity care pathways and the diabetic foot guideline, standardizing grassroots prevention and weight management practice.
  • 新疆「1+1+1」家庭医生团队：县级专家下沉包联，健康服务嵌入基层治理
    Xinjiang's 1+1+1 Family Doctor Teams Bring County Specialists to Villages
    新疆以「1+1+1」「N+1+1」家庭医生团队模式，把县级专科专家、乡镇医护与村医编组，建立二三级医院医师常态化下沉包联机制；签约居民获动态电子健康档案、慢病随访、长处方与转诊绿色通道，新就业群体逐步纳入。拜城县还把健康服务嵌入村公共卫生委员会与基层治理网络，破解随访找不到人、群众不配合的难题。
    Xinjiang is organizing family doctor teams on a 1+1+1 and N+1+1 model that pairs county specialists, township clinicians and village doctors, with a standing mechanism for secondary and tertiary hospital physicians to be assigned to grassroots units. Contracted residents receive dynamically updated electronic health records, chronic disease follow-up, long prescriptions and green-channel referrals, with gig workers gradually included; Baicheng County embeds services in village public health committees to solve follow-up and non-cooperation problems.
  • 杭州萧山试点「萧慧减」体重管理智能体：135人30天人均减重3.5公斤
    Hangzhou's Xiaoshan Pilots AI Weight Agent: 3.5 kg Lost in 30 Days Across 135 Users
    杭州萧山区卫健局在萧山医院试点上线「萧慧减」体重管理智能体，以「AI+医生」打通筛查评估、方案制定与执行跟踪全周期：报告关键指标识别准确率与召回率均达99%，方案须医生审核后执行。试运行135名真实用户30天人均减重3.5公斤，食物AI识别准确率90.2%，并在33名学生中开展儿童体重干预试点。
    Xiaoshan District's health commission launched the Xiaohuijian weight management agent at Xiaoshan Hospital, using an AI-plus-doctor model across screening, assessment, planning and follow-up: report recognition reaches 99% precision and recall, and every plan requires physician sign-off. In a pilot with 135 real users, average weight loss was 3.5 kg over 30 days, food image recognition hit 90.2% accuracy, and a childhood weight program now covers 33 students.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-27
item.description: 2026-10-27 简报，共 20 条：血管老化三联体：细胞衰老、炎性衰老与表观遗传重塑共同驱动动脉粥样硬化；「适量饮酒」再遭质疑：每周14杯酒，酒精相关死亡终身风险达1/25；韩国1170万人数据：「心血管住院风险生物年龄」比传统指标更能预测死亡；肠道古菌并非旁观者：产甲烷菌可显著增强肠道屏障并调节免疫；ASPREE遗传分析：特定基因型老人服低剂量阿司匹林，痴呆相对风险低70%；PNAS：过量RNA堆积可直接损伤线粒体，或参与衰老相关疾病；重新平衡GPCR细胞通讯网络：延缓多种衰老相关疾病的新赛道；长寿医学专家呼吁停止「抗衰」误导：不衰老不可能，延健康寿命才是核心；Genome Medicine：工程益生菌实现「饮食诱导」可编程GLP-1递送，减脂效果优于持续给药；微生物代谢型（metabotypes）：营养干预效果因人而异的菌群基础；高龄大熊猫肠道菌群研究：纤维分解能力保留更强、乳酸菌富集的长寿密码；GSSI研究：精英球员低温训练下汗液钠流失个体差异巨大，呼唤个性化补水策略；JAMA Netw Open：AI分析15万帖文，灰市「减肥神药」retatrutide自报症状与临床试验不同；天冬草根提取物SRI-81八周RCT：改善女性性功能评分与性困扰；碧萝芷（Pycnogenol）3个月RCT：改善低骨密度女性的躯体疼痛与活力评分；NI综述：女性激素健康补剂证据升级——从主观量表走向客观激素指标；第4届国际心血管代谢大会昆明开幕：中外专家共探「AI+精准防治」破解CKM难题；雅培启动「健康大满贯」公众健康促进项目：首站进社区聚焦血糖管理；CMEF观察：轻智汇双签约，AI健康大模型走向「AI+慢病管理+功能保健」产业落地；塔夫茨研究：咖啡带来热量15年涨近40%，植脂末取代糖成最大「隐形热量」来源
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 血管老化三联体：细胞衰老、炎性衰老与表观遗传重塑共同驱动动脉粥样硬化
    The Vascular Aging Triad: Cellular Senescence, Inflammaging and Epigenetic Remodeling Drive Atherosclerosis
    最新综述提出，动脉粥样硬化中存在「血管老化三联体」：细胞衰老、炎性衰老与表观遗传重塑三者形成自我放大的恶性循环，加速内皮屏障失效并使斑块不稳定。作者主张现代预防心脏病学应超越单纯的脂质管理，直接针对血管壁的生物学时钟，并探索衰老细胞清除剂等年龄特异性干预与生物标志物。
    The latest review proposes a 'vascular aging triad' in atherosclerosis: cellular senescence, inflammaging and epigenetic remodeling form a self-amplifying vicious cycle that accelerates endothelial barrier failure and plaque destabilization. The authors argue modern preventive cardiology should go beyond lipid management to directly target the biological clock of the vessel wall, exploring senolytics and age-specific biomarkers.
  • 「适量饮酒」再遭质疑：每周14杯酒，酒精相关死亡终身风险达1/25
    Two Drinks a Day May Be Far Riskier Than You Think: 1 in 25 Lifetime Risk of Alcohol-Related Death at 14 Drinks Weekly
    发表于《Journal of Studies on Alcohol and Drugs》的美国「酒精摄入与健康研究」汇总7200余篇文献并建模：每周饮14杯酒者死于酒精相关原因的终身风险约1/25，每周7杯内多数风险仅小幅上升。研究未在任何饮酒水平观察到整体健康保护效应，为美国膳食指南补充量化阈值。
    The Alcohol Intake and Health Study, published in the Journal of Studies on Alcohol and Drugs, synthesized over 7,200 publications and modeled that people averaging 14 drinks weekly face about a 1 in 25 lifetime risk of dying from alcohol-related causes, while up to 7 drinks weekly raises most risks only modestly. No significant overall health benefit was observed at any drinking level.
  • 韩国1170万人数据：「心血管住院风险生物年龄」比传统指标更能预测死亡
    Korean CDPBA: A Cardiovascular Hospitalization-Risk 'Biological Age' Outpredicts Conventional Mortality Markers in 11.7 Million Adults
    韩国国民健康保险服务等机构基于1170万名40岁以上人群数据，开发出「心血管疾病住院风险生物年龄（CDPBA）」，以未来10年心血管住院风险反推生理年龄。其对全因死亡率预测优于传统方法，男性AUROC达0.849、女性0.871，为衰老量化评估提供了新型心血管维度工具。
    Korean National Health Insurance Service researchers developed the CDPBA 'biological age' from 10-year cardiovascular hospitalization risk in 11.7 million adults over 40. It predicted all-cause mortality better than conventional methods, with AUROC of 0.849 for men and 0.871 for women, offering a new cardiovascular dimension for quantifying biological aging.
  • 肠道古菌并非旁观者：产甲烷菌可显著增强肠道屏障并调节免疫
    Gut archaea are no bystanders: methanogens strengthen the gut barrier and tune immunity
    热心肠日报解读新研究：两种产甲烷古菌可增强肠道屏障并特异性扩增抗炎的调节性T细胞，在结肠炎模型中显著减轻体重下降、结肠缩短与组织损伤，且二者保护机制互不冗余；研究为长期被视为"促炎嫌疑"的肠道古菌正名，提示评估菌群失调不应忽略这群古老居民。
    Chinagut Daily highlights a new study showing that two methanogenic archaea strengthen the gut barrier and selectively expand anti-inflammatory regulatory T cells, markedly reducing weight loss, colon shortening and tissue injury in colitis models with non-redundant mechanisms — rehabilitating gut archaea long suspected of promoting inflammation.

长寿医学 / Longevity Medicine

  • ASPREE遗传分析：特定基因型老人服低剂量阿司匹林，痴呆相对风险低70%
    ASPREE genetic analysis: low-dose aspirin linked to 70% lower dementia risk in a genetic subgroup
    对ASPREE试验1.3万余名参与者的遗传分析发现，血小板计数遗传评分最高的老人服用低剂量阿司匹林后痴呆发生率约1%对安慰剂3.3%，相对风险约降70%；但同组大出血发生率4.4%对2.1%明显升高。研究者强调既往整体试验未见获益，不能据此推荐普遍服用阿司匹林预防痴呆。
    A genetic analysis of over 13,500 ASPREE trial participants found that older adults with the highest platelet-count genetic scores had about 1% dementia incidence on low-dose aspirin versus 3.3% on placebo — roughly 70% lower relative risk — but major bleeding in the same group doubled (4.4% vs 2.1%). Researchers stress overall trials showed no benefit and do not recommend widespread aspirin use for dementia prevention.
  • PNAS：过量RNA堆积可直接损伤线粒体，或参与衰老相关疾病
    PNAS: Excess RNA buildup can directly damage mitochondria, with implications for aging-related disease
    德州农工团队在PNAS报告：痘病毒感染中过量RNA堆积可在免疫显著激活之前直接损伤线粒体、降低细胞呼吸，甚至日常必需的mRNA过量也会干扰产能；研究者推测带负电的RNA可能扰乱线粒体内膜电平衡。该机制为病毒感染、神经退行性变及衰老相关疾病中的线粒体应激提供新解释，并对RNA药物与疫苗设计有提示意义。
    Texas A&M researchers report in PNAS that excess RNA accumulating during poxvirus infection damages mitochondria and reduces cellular respiration even before strong immune activation — and that surplus everyday mRNA can also impair energy production. They speculate negatively charged RNA disturbs the inner-membrane electrical balance, a mechanism that may shed light on mitochondrial stress in viral infection, neurodegeneration and aging, and inform RNA drug and vaccine design.
  • 重新平衡GPCR细胞通讯网络：延缓多种衰老相关疾病的新赛道
    Rebalancing GPCR Cell Communication Networks: A New Avenue to Delay Multiple Age-Related Diseases
    最新研究提出，G蛋白偶联受体（GPCR）随年龄增长发生信号紊乱，与慢性炎症、代谢下降及心血管病、阿尔茨海默病等高度关联。研究倡导网络化干预：借系统生物学与可解释AI同步调节多条GPCR通路，按个体衰老差异定制方案，并与清除衰老细胞、代谢干预等延寿策略互补。
    A new study proposes that age-related dysregulation of G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs), the body's core cell communication system, is closely linked to inflammaging, metabolic decline and chronic diseases. Instead of single-receptor targeting, it advocates network-based interventions using systems biology and explainable AI to rebalance multiple GPCR pathways, complementing senolytics and metabolic therapies.
  • 长寿医学专家呼吁停止「抗衰」误导：不衰老不可能，延健康寿命才是核心
    Longevity Experts Urge an End to 'Anti-Aging' Hype: Extending Healthspan, Not Escaping Aging, Is the Real Goal
    亚太健康长寿国际峰会期间，多位国际专家澄清六个误区：长寿科学目标是延长健康寿命而非单纯寿命；2009-2019年美国健康预期寿命反而下降；迄今无任何药物或补剂被证明延长人类自然寿命，NAD+、肽类等动物实验结果不能直接推及人体，应以循证取代商业炒作。
    During the Asia-Pacific Health Longevity Summit, international aging experts clarified six common misconceptions: the goal is extending healthspan, not lifespan; US healthy life expectancy actually declined from 2009-2019; and no drug or supplement has ever been proven to extend human lifespan — animal results for NAD+ boosters and peptides cannot be extrapolated to humans. They call for evidence over commercial hype.

精准营养 / Precision Nutrition

  • Genome Medicine：工程益生菌实现「饮食诱导」可编程GLP-1递送，减脂效果优于持续给药
    Genome Medicine: Diet-Inducible Programmable GLP-1 Delivery via Engineered Probiotics Outperforms Constitutive Delivery
    《Genome Medicine》研究开发基因工程益生菌，使GLP-1仅在进食时按需释放：肥胖小鼠模型中，饮食诱导型递送在抗脂肪堆积与抗脂肪变性上优于持续递送。机制上，持续给药会富集携带GLP-1降解酶基因的肠道细菌，按需递送则将其丰度降至最低，凸显「宿主-菌群-药物」互作的关键影响。
    A Genome Medicine study engineered probiotics to release GLP-1 only upon food intake: in obese mice, diet-inducible delivery outperformed constitutive delivery against fat accumulation and steatosis. Mechanistically, continuous GLP-1 enriches gut bacteria carrying GLP-1-degrading enzyme genes, while inducible delivery minimizes them, highlighting host-microbiome-drug interactions in peptide delivery.
  • 微生物代谢型（metabotypes）：营养干预效果因人而异的菌群基础
    Microbial Metabotypes: Why the Same Polyphenol Intervention Yields Different Responses in Different People
    西班牙CEBAS-CSIC学者Victoria Selma指出，肠道菌群与膳食多酚是双向关系：鞣花单宁转化为尿石素、异黄酮生成S-雌马酚等有益代谢物，取决于个体特定的菌群构成即「微生物代谢型」。同样的多酚干预在不同人身上代谢谱可截然不同，这正是个性化营养的生物学基础。
    Dr Victoria Selma of CEBAS-CSIC will explain at IPC 2027 that the gut microbiota and dietary polyphenols interact bidirectionally: beneficial metabolites like urolithins, S-equol and resveratrol derivatives depend on an individual's microbial metabotype. The same polyphenol intervention can yield very different metabolic profiles across people — the biological foundation of personalized nutrition.
  • 高龄大熊猫肠道菌群研究：纤维分解能力保留更强、乳酸菌富集的长寿密码
    Gut Microbiome of Geriatric Giant Pandas: Preserved Fiber Degradation and Enriched Lactobacilli Offer Longevity Clues
    针对高龄大熊猫的肠道菌群研究发现，老年个体不仅保留了更强的纤维分解能力，肠道中还富集多种有益乳酸菌，呈现与人类健康老龄化相似的菌群特征。研究者认为，这一动物模型为「通过调控肠道菌群延缓衰老」提供了新证据，也提示选择合适的发酵食品与膳食纤维策略或有助于维持老年期的肠道功能。
    A gut microbiome study of geriatric giant pandas found that aged individuals retain stronger fiber-degrading capacity and enrich multiple beneficial Lactobacillus species, mirroring microbial signatures of healthy human aging. The authors argue this animal model supports microbiome-targeted strategies — such as fermented foods and dietary fiber — for maintaining gut function in later life.
  • GSSI研究：精英球员低温训练下汗液钠流失个体差异巨大，呼唤个性化补水策略
    GSSI Study: Large Individual Variation in Sweat Sodium Losses of Elite Soccer Players in Cool Conditions Underscores Personalized Hydration
    百事Gatorade运动科学研究所参与的团队发表于《Nutrients》：36名精英男足球员在凉爽环境高强度训练中，汗率与汗钠流失个体差异巨大，碳水摄入普遍低于每小时30克建议值。低温环境易低估补水需求，应基于个体出汗与钠流失数据制定个性化补液补钠方案。
    A Nutrients study involving PepsiCo's Gatorade Sports Science Institute tracked 36 elite male soccer players during high-intensity training in cool conditions: sweat rates and sodium losses varied hugely between individuals, and carbohydrate intake often fell below 30 g/hour. The authors warn cool environments breed complacency and call for personalized fluid and sodium plans.

营养补剂 / Dietary Supplements

  • JAMA Netw Open：AI分析15万帖文，灰市「减肥神药」retatrutide自报症状与临床试验不同
    JAMA Network Open: AI Mining of 150,000 Reddit Posts Reveals Unexpected Self-Reported Symptoms from Gray-Market Retatrutide
    宾夕法尼亚大学团队用大语言模型分析约4万用户的近15万条Reddit帖子，首次系统考察未批准三受体激动剂retatrutide灰市使用者的自报副作用，登《JAMA Network Open》。意外发现「食欲增加」成最常见主诉；作者强调这是假设生成而非因果证据，灰市制剂成分剂量也难保证。
    University of Pennsylvania researchers used large language models to analyze nearly 150,000 Reddit posts from ~40,000 users, the first systematic look at gray-market retatrutide, published in JAMA Network Open. Unexpectedly, increased appetite was the most common self-reported symptom, contrary to its appetite-suppressing design. The authors stress this generates hypotheses, not causal evidence, and gray-market products vary in content.
  • 天冬草根提取物SRI-81八周RCT：改善女性性功能评分与性困扰
    Eight-Week RCT: Standardized Shatavari (SRI-81) Improves Female Sexual Function Scores and Reduces Sexual Distress
    《International Journal of Women's Health》三臂双盲试验纳入135名女性：每日300mg天冬门（Shatavari）八周后，总FSFI评分改善34%、满意度提升64%、性困扰降29%，均优于安慰剂；联用南非醉茄改善更广。样本量小、周期短，需谨慎解读。
    A three-arm randomized double-blind trial in the International Journal of Women's Health enrolled 135 women: 300 mg/day standardized Shatavari (SRI-81) for eight weeks improved total FSFI scores by 34%, satisfaction by 64% and cut sexual distress by 29% versus placebo; combining it with KSM-66 ashwagandha produced broader improvements with a 44% reduction in distress. Modest sample size warrants caution.
  • 碧萝芷（Pycnogenol）3个月RCT：改善低骨密度女性的躯体疼痛与活力评分
    Three-Month RCT: Pycnogenol Improves Bodily Pain and Vitality Scores in Women with Low Bone Density
    维尔茨堡大学在《Frontiers in Nutrition》发表首个针对低骨密度人群的碧萝芷人体试验：67名女性每日200mg服用三个月，躯体疼痛与活力评分较安慰剂分别改善约25%与14%，骨吸收标志物CTX-1较基线降约11%（与安慰剂差异不显著），需更长期对照研究确认骨获益。
    The first human trial of Pycnogenol in low bone mineral density, from the University of Würzburg in Frontiers in Nutrition, randomized 67 women to 200 mg/day for three months: bodily pain and vitality scores improved about 25% and 14% versus placebo, and the bone-resorption marker CTX-1 fell about 11% from baseline, though not significantly versus placebo. Longer controlled studies are needed.
  • NI综述：女性激素健康补剂证据升级——从主观量表走向客观激素指标
    NI Roundup: Women's Hormonal Health Supplement Science Shifts from Subjective Scores to Objective Hormonal Measures
    NutraIngredients盘点显示，针对更年期、月经周期与多囊卵巢综合征的女性激素健康补剂研究正快速升温：从益生菌到NAD+前体，越来越多干预进入临床验证，且试验设计从主观自评量表转向客观激素测量，为女性全生命周期的精准补剂方案提供更高等级循证支撑。
    NutraIngredients' roundup of the latest science shows women's hormonal health supplement research — spanning menopause, menstrual cycle and PCOS, from probiotics to NAD+ boosters — is intensifying, with clinical trials increasingly moving beyond subjective self-reporting toward objective hormonal measures, strengthening the evidence base for precision supplement strategies across a woman's life stages.

健康管理 / Health Management

  • 第4届国际心血管代谢大会昆明开幕：中外专家共探「AI+精准防治」破解CKM难题
    4th International Cardiometabolic Congress Opens in Kunming: Chinese and Foreign Experts Explore AI-Driven Precision Prevention for CKM
    第4届国际心血管代谢大会在昆明开幕，中外专家围绕心血管-肾脏-代谢综合征（CKM）探讨「AI+精准防治」。数据显示中国心血管死亡人群约70%伴代谢异常。治疗正从单纯降脂走向「降脂+抗炎」，残余胆固醇、脂蛋白(a)等新靶点与多组学、AI将支持更早更精准的个体化防治。
    The 4th International Cardiometabolic Congress opened in Kunming, with experts from China, Germany and Italy exploring AI-driven precision prevention for cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome. Data show about 70% of Chinese cardiovascular deaths involve metabolic abnormalities. Therapy is shifting from lipid-lowering alone to combined lipid and inflammation targeting, aided by novel targets, single-cell multi-omics and AI for earlier, more personalized risk management.
  • 雅培启动「健康大满贯」公众健康促进项目：首站进社区聚焦血糖管理
    Abbott Launches 'Health Grand Slam' Community Program in Beijing, Spotlighting Glucose Management
    雅培「健康大满贯」项目首站落地北京景山街道，围绕血糖管理、心血管健康、医学营养、肠道健康与疾病诊断设置互动体验专区。宣武医院专家指出，从传统CGM到准确度更高的iCGM，连续精准的血糖数据可帮助患者更从容地做健康管理决策，也为医生制定方案提供更可靠依据；该项目将陆续走进全国多个城市和社区。
    Abbott's 'Health Grand Slam' program debuted at Jingshan Subdistrict, Beijing, with interactive zones on glucose management, cardiovascular health, medical nutrition, gut health and diagnostics. Xuanwu Hospital experts noted that moving from CGM to higher-accuracy iCGM provides continuous, precise glucose data for better self-management decisions and more reliable treatment planning; the program will tour more cities and communities.
  • CMEF观察：轻智汇双签约，AI健康大模型走向「AI+慢病管理+功能保健」产业落地
    At CMEF, Qingzhihui Signs Dual Partnerships to Push AI Health Models into Chronic Disease and Functional Health Scenarios
    第94届CMEF与药交会期间，轻智汇与赛升健康、康乃心分别签约：共建「AI+慢病管理+功能保健」业务链路，探索药企向主动健康延伸；并融合医疗级可穿戴与心电一张网，打造「硬件监测—AI评估—居家康复—随访复核」闭环，方案已覆盖诊后居家管理、体重管理与基层AI随访等场景。
    During the 94th CMEF and the 93rd National Pharmaceutical Trade Fair, Qingzhihui signed strategic partnerships with Saisheng Health and KangNaixin: building an 'AI + chronic disease management + functional health' chain with a pharma partner, and integrating medical-grade wearables with an ECG network into a closed loop of monitoring, AI assessment, home rehabilitation and follow-up. Its solutions already cover home chronic disease care, weight management and grassroots AI-assisted follow-up.
  • 塔夫茨研究：咖啡带来热量15年涨近40%，植脂末取代糖成最大「隐形热量」来源
    Tufts Study: Calories in Coffee Up Nearly 40% Over 15 Years, with Non-Dairy Creamer Overtaking Sugar as the Top Add-In
    塔夫茨大学发表于《JAND》的研究分析NHANES三万成年人数据：2003-2018年咖啡饮用量基本不变（约13盎司/天），但来自咖啡的热量从43千卡增至60千卡、涨近40%。非乳制奶精摄入翻倍以上，取代糖与牛奶成为最大添加热量来源，咖啡的健康益处可能被「隐形热量」抵消。
    A Tufts University study in JAND analyzed NHANES data from 30,000 US adults: between 2003 and 2018 coffee intake stayed flat at about 13 ounces daily, yet calories from coffee rose nearly 40% from 43 to 60 kcal/day. Non-dairy creamer consumption more than doubled, overtaking sugar and milk as the leading source of added calories — a hidden-calorie entry point worth attention in health management.

item.title: 全球健康与长寿每日简报 · 2026-10-26
item.description: 2026-10-26 简报，共 20 条：人民网起底抗衰产品乱象：NAD+针剂超适应症使用、二甲双胍抗衰尚无定论；脑脊液游离DNA甲基化检测可区分痴呆类型，准确率达85%；综述：肺动脉高压难愈的幕后推手是肺部血管细胞“早衰”；血液GDF-15水平越高，骨骼和肌肉衰老得越快；补硒经GPX4阻断巨噬细胞铁死亡，可对抗镉污染导致的卵巢纤维化；线粒体肽MOTS-c激活脂质自噬，有望改善糖尿病肾病；孕期加速生物衰老，产后是关键“恢复窗口”，两胎间隔过短或叠加衰老负担；中疾控团队获美国国家医学院健康长寿全球竞赛大奖第三名；USC研究：地中海饮食与更高水平线粒体微蛋白humanin、SHMOOSE相关；The Innovation Nutrition：决定免疫治疗疗效的是“饮食-菌群轴”，而非肥胖本身；关闭Mitch蛋白可让人体细胞燃烧更多脂肪并阻止新脂肪细胞生成；NHLBI综述：整合多组学、可穿戴与实施科学的全生命周期精准营养框架；康涅狄格大学研究：CBN睡眠软糖成分在小鼠中出现耐受与戒断迹象；随机交叉试验：脂质体维生素D3急性吸收提高约1.9倍；RCT：晨间南非醉茄+红景天两周改善健康成人压力与睡眠；石榴提取物Pomanox 12周RCT：改善面部色斑、皮肤水合与弹性；经济参考报：AI赋能基层医疗数字化提速，数字家医多地落地；海南政协建言：数字疗法适老化改造与老年慢病专项数据库建设；湖南日报调查：AI减重工具走红，但“把体重管理交给算法”存在健康盲区；三亚海棠区把老年健康科普送到家门口：慢病、防跌倒与科学用药进社区
item.content:encoded:
功能医学 / Functional Medicine

  • 人民网起底抗衰产品乱象：NAD+针剂超适应症使用、二甲双胍抗衰尚无定论
    People's Daily investigates anti-aging product hype: off-label NAD+ injections and unproven metformin claims
    人民网健康频道刊文梳理抗衰产品乱象：医美机构把药品级NAD+注射剂包装成“抗衰营养针”超适应症、超剂量给健康人群使用，而2026版专家共识仅面向特定老年心血管病患者；专家强调高剂量NAD+在动物实验中反而增加斑块与炎症，二甲双胍抗衰延寿在人类中亦无确定结论，提醒公众勿把基础研究等同于临床疗效。
    People's Daily examines anti-aging product hype: aesthetic clinics market pharmaceutical-grade NAD+ injections as "anti-aging drips" for healthy people, off-label and at unapproved doses, while the 2026 Chinese expert consensus covers only specific elderly cardiovascular patients. Experts note high-dose NAD+ raised plaque burden and inflammation in animal studies, and metformin's longevity benefit in humans remains unproven — basic research must not be equated with clinical efficacy.
  • 脑脊液游离DNA甲基化检测可区分痴呆类型，准确率达85%
    Cerebrospinal fluid cfDNA methylation profiling distinguishes dementia types with 85% accuracy
    最新研究显示，脑脊液中的游离DNA甲基化特征能够准确区分不同类型的痴呆症，准确率高达85%。这意味着未来医生有望借助液体活检技术在疾病早期精准识别阿尔茨海默病与帕金森综合征等不同病因，减少“认错病”带来的治疗延误，也为痴呆的精准分型与个体化干预提供了新的功能医学检测工具。
    New research shows that cell-free DNA methylation signatures in cerebrospinal fluid can accurately distinguish different types of dementia with up to 85% accuracy.
